chapters.title: Chapter 501: Undying Mythic Halo
paragraphs: After a long kiss which still left them wanting more, their lips parted, the two wanted to continue but it was not the time yet.
Getting off the throne, they straightened their clothes.
"Do you have any news of Yennefer?" Vanessa asked, her expression turning sad.
The two didn’t really share a very close bond but she was now one of Vritra’s women and the one who saved his life.
So she too had already started to consider Maeve and Yennefer a part of the family.
"No, there is absolutely no clue about her right now." Vritra said, worry filling his heart.
"I have tried to search for both of you all this time, and wasn’t able to find anything either." Vanessa sighed.
"She is still alive, and I will definitely find her." Vritra spoke resolutely.
Together the two walked out of the hall, as Vritra began to explain the things that happened during and after the war.
About the Yate family, the games and more, he didn’t hide anything from her.
"The Yates... I had heard about them, very soon they would have ceased to exist." Vanessa had some inside info, that not even most of the Yate members would know.
And she got this news from the World Information Centre.
"So you know about the marriage promise between the two families, but why aren’t the Fords worried about the punishment?" he asked, looking at his mother’s palace.
It was as if the entire hidden city of charms had teleported to the midst of the continent, thankfully it didn’t get destroyed during the war.
"I am sure they are worried but they must have some way of getting out of it, though by paying a heavy price." Vanessa answered.
"Anyway, on my way here, I heard the feud between the succubus race, the humans and the phoenix race, it is just an act right?"
Vritra knew all his women pretty well, there was low to little chance of them fighting.
"Yes, if we don’t act then we would be too big of a threat for the righteous and evil organizations, we would either have to choose a side or get attacked by both."
Just like how things went with Vritra, if he had joined hands with one side, his burden would certainly have been lessened.
But still, he was happy with all his choices, he would never want to be a part of those groups.
"Okay, so who do you want to surprise first?" Vanessa paused and turned to face him, gazing intoxicatingly at his handsome face.
She really wanted to pounce at her son but held back, after all Vritra was doing the same.
He must be craving her just as much, if not more.
"Let’s meet Fiona then" before Vritra could finish, a barrier surrounded the two, stopping any sight or sound to leak outside.
Then Yasmine’s figure appeared beside Vritra, standing in her human form.
"Mom, I am really glad you are alright, in that war sigh..." Yasmine mumbled, she could really feel motherly care from her.
Although the two shared more than one relation but she was still Yasmine’s mother-in-law.
"Yeah I heard about the war, they will pay for doing all that, every single one of them." Vanessa gave Yasmine a hug.
"Haven’t you returned to the dragon kingdom yet? There shouldn’t be any problems with your current strength." Vanessa spoke, seeing that Yasmine was still just a soul.
"I am planning to go there right after meeting the others." Vritra nodded, he also needed to pay Dago a visit.
Yasmine wanted to get her body back so she could actually be present with her husband but also didn’t want it, since in that case, she can’t be with Vritra at all times.
After talking for a few more minutes, Vanessa spoke:
"Let’s head to the phoenix kingdom then, Fiona went there just a couple days ago."
Yasmine disappeared as the barrier also dissipated, then Vanessa passed on some orders to Layla.
After which, both Vritra and Vanessa flew into the sky, disappearing from sight.
"H- He really was her son... Vritra? HE IS BACK?!!" Layla spoke in shock, wasn’t he already dead?
But holding back her doubts, she got to work.
Inside a red luxurious palace, a lot of people were entering and leaving.
It seemed to be some sort of festival, with countless shops present in the streets and decorations adoring the whole place.
But even in such a big event, the Empress was nowhere to be seen.
Only a few people had actually seen her, and only two words popped in their minds.
Beautiful and fire, after Vritra’s disappearance, although all of his women were greatly affected.
But all others were mature enough to control their emotions and keep up their act for the final goal.
Though Fiona was different, even though knowing he was probably still alive, she was too hurt and filled with rage.
In the past year, after she became the Empress, she had personally killed countless creatures.
Whether it be demons or anyone else who made any mistakes, she would just burn them alive.
All the members of the phoenix race were just afraid of her, yet none dared to challenge her power.
The cute girl had become extremely violent and deadly, always seemed to be full of rage, like a volcano that could erupt at any moment.
Vanessa explained all of it to Vritra, it made him sad and worried, but he hoped he could heal her over time.
He preferred her to be just like how she was, even Diana had matured up, he needed cuteness.
Yet another event in which the queen was absent, but who would dare say anything.
If anything, she was actually a great leader, removing any sort of threat, and winning any wars she participated in.
Currently, the phoenix race could be ranked even above the dragon race, just because of her.
Fiona’s strength had grown tremendously, most of the time she was busy hunting.
Inside a big bath, the faint sound of water dropping could be heard.
A woman with long red hair, a sizzling hot body and a dangerous aura sat in the bathtub.
Scooping some water over her palm, she dripped it over her shoulder, her milky skin seemed to be glowing.
Her face was devoid of any emotions, mind buzzing with noises, eyes filled with flames.
A few months ago, while exploring an unknown inheritance, Fiona almost died.
She was so close to death, that she had actually resigned herself to her fate, just hoping to reunite with Vritra even if that’s the way.
But barely and somehow, she actually survived the biggest challenge of her life, even dozens of lords could’ve easily died in there.
Just like the level of its dangerous nature, the reward Fiona received was just as high.
She got one of the Mythic Halo, the fourth ranked, Undying Mythic Halo.
A Mythic Halo which could never be extinguished, it would continue to burn for eternity, being extremely deadly.
Nor could its wielder be killed as long as the flame had at least an ounce of energy, it was one of the most sought-out Mythic Halos.
Blood red flames burned around her body, perfectly in her control.
WHOOSH
There was a faint noise, alerting the dangerous Empress of phoenixes, as she got ready to eliminate the threat.

chapters.title: Chapter 502: Broken
paragraphs: Whoosh
Fiona heard a faint noise, like always, she was on high alert.
Her body flashed out of the tub, a long dress forming around her body, the red flames intensifying as the water evaporated.
Fiona took a step towards the door, she didn’t expect anyone to be able to breach through all the security.
Intense killing intent suddenly began to flow out of her body, the temperature of the palace and even the place several kilometres around her began to rise.
It seemed killing was the only way she could keep whatever sanity of hers was left.
A faint hope of Vritra’s return kept her going.
TAK
She heard a noise from behind. Fiona turned but found no one, her expression completely unreadable.
Then a shadow appeared behind her, as Fiona felt a faint caress over her neck.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM
The roof of her palace was blasted away, as intense waves burst out of her body.
But yet again, no one was present there.
A frown appeared over her face; there was no fear but her killing intent kept growing stronger.
’Is it someone from the Golden Moon or... a demon?’ she wondered, but couldn’t think of anyone who could be this strong and fast.
Just while she was wondering this, the same shadow flashed behind her again.
This time, she clearly felt two arms sliding onto her waist, but the moment she attacked, the other person disappeared.
After the vast explosion, the people were already in a panic, while the guards couldn’t get close to Fiona’s room because of the flame.
"..." Fiona’s eyes narrowed dangerously, wondering the intent of the attacker, and she couldn’t sense any killing intent.
"Who are you?" her voice sounded cold, despite the burning hot temperature around her.
This time, the shadow appeared before her, its hand extended towards her face.
Fiona didn’t waste time as a layer of flames appeared around her body like a protective armor, that was all she could manage to do before the stranger’s hand touched her.
And then, he playfully tapped her nose, as his hand below the wrist started burning.
Fiona jumped back, finally getting a clear look at her attacker, ready to turn him into ashes with her next attack.
But then she froze, her gaze locked onto the man before her, her mind suddenly going silent as all the noises disappeared.
Vritra stared at the flames burning menacingly over his palm, it could barely hurt him.
Mythic halo was extremely strong but Fiona’s strength was still low, so she couldn’t display its full power.
Still, Vritra couldn’t make the flame die down, but with his arsenal of skills, it wasn’t really hard.
Using Null and Internal Shuffle, his arm distorted a bit for a moment before returning to normal and the red burning flame actually disappeared.
But that was far from the cold Empress’s worry. Her mind, body and heart were all in sync, extremely shocked.
"D..." she tried to speak but couldn’t. The blood red flames disappeared. She still couldn’t understand if it was reality, an illusion or just one of her dreams.
Dragging her body forward, she stopped right before him. Vritra looked quite different yet she could feel it was him.
Taking a shuddering breath, both her trembling hands rose slightly, as she gently cupped his face.
Feeling his skin and warmth against her palms, her lips trembled. She wanted to speak but couldn’t.
"Fiona, I am back." Vritra leaned forward, pressing his forehead against hers.
She had greatly changed in just a span of over two years. Fiona actually looked grown up and mature.
Nothing like the young girl she was.
’She has gone through a lot, how many lives did she take to possess such killing intent in such a short time.’ Vritra pulled her closer, tightening his embrace.
Fiona finally seemed to come out of her shock, as she finally reacted, her arms wrapped around him with a desperate fervour.
"Darling?!!" her voice came out choked, eyes becoming teary. It all happened so suddenly she didn’t know how to react.
She had dreamt of him countless times, meeting him only to be disappointed when she woke up.
The red flames that were slowly swallowing her entire palace disappeared.
The guards still didn’t dare to approach; they waited outside her room, ready to follow any order.
Vanessa appeared beside the two, smiling faintly she spoke: "Yes, honey is indeed back, this is not a dream."
Fiona had cried so many times, that tears stopped coming out, but again after a long time she couldn’t stop herself from crying.
"I am here, everything will be fine now." Patting her head, Vritra spoke, kissing her forehead.
The redhead was stuck to him tightly, afraid that if she let go he might disappear again and she would have to live through that trauma again.
Vritra glanced around, her palace was going to need to be rebuilt, she had really become quite reckless.
Holding his sobbing wife, Vritra directly felt the countless emotions she was feeling, her body weakly trembling in his arms.
Vritra used natural hypnosis to make the guards leave.
Fiona just stayed in his embrace, refusing to be separated even after dozens of minutes.
"I missed you a lot, I know you have been through a lot, I am sorry for all that." Vritra muttered, although it wasn’t something he could handle.
It took a long time for Fiona to finally calm down, but she was barely speaking now.
Seeing such a drastic change in her filled Vritra with endless rage.
"Darling, this is the last time. If you disappear again then I will follow you, even if it means death." Fiona said, her face buried in his chest.
"... I will try not to, but fate itself is jealous of me, but I will always return." Vritra replied, gently caressing her cheek.
A weak smile appeared over her face. Leaning onto him, she pressed her red lips against his.
It was a soft kiss, a short kiss yet filled with immense love.
As their lips parted, Fiona looked into his eyes, then hugged him even tighter.
The flashes of her nightmares kept popping in her mind, she would hate nothing more than losing him again.
"So you have become an Empress..." Vritra spoke in a low voice, his lips brushing against her ear.
"Mhmm..." The redhead nuzzled closer to his neck, her soft lips brushing his warm skin.
"You have also become a lord huh."
"Mmm." Fiona just hummed, inhaling his scent.
"You have done great, my lovely wife, you don’t have to punish yourself anymore, okay?" he spoke.
"Hmm." She nodded, feeling as if she was finally home, as if her soul had finally returned to her body.
"I love you." He said, pressing his lips against her soft moist lips once again.
Fiona already seemed a little better than before but it would need more time to properly heal her, to bring back her joyful and cute personality.
Vritra continued to chat with her for a little longer, though it was mostly him speaking.
Even as she separated from him, Fiona tightly held his arm, as if staying separated from him scared her.
Now it was time to meet Maeve and Diana, since both the ladies were together in the capital right now, so he could surprise them at once.

chapters.title: Chapter 503: The Wolves
paragraphs: The sky was eerily dark, the surrounding completely silent even though it was the time of the day.
Hundreds of graves could be seen present in a graveyard that spread over a couple of kilometres.
There was a guard sitting near the door, sleeping peacefully over his chair, with a cap covering his face.
The sound of wind echoed like ghostly wails, it truly felt like a setup of a horror movie.
CHIK CHIK
The sound of footsteps broke the silence, moving over wet soil.
Then two figures, wearing red robes with hoods, walked towards the guard.
Their faces were covered in shadows, giving the two ladies a mysterious and dangerous look.
Stopping in front of the slumbering man, one of them called out: "Is he here?"
"H- Huh?"
BAM!
Startled, the man fell off his chair, falling into the dirt.
Then with a grimace, he got up and began wiping away the mud, finally his face was visible.
There were long and deep scratches over his face, the scars looked terrifying enough to scare most.
"Ughh Who are you? What are you doing here at this time?" the middle aged man once again sat back up on his seat and gazed at the two women.
"Tell us, is he here?" the same woman repeated her question.
"Huh? He who? Are you here to search for someone’s grave? Or did you bring a body to bury?" the man spoke, yawning.
"..." After a slight pause, the other woman stepped forward and pinkish energy waves burst out of her body.
The man jumped back, his pupils changing colours.
"What exactly do you want? The demons and gods are not welcome here." The claws of the man started growing, his body trembling as if about to undergo a drastic transformation.
"Funny, you phrase it as if we are asking for your permission."
Removing back their hoods, the two women took a step forward, their beautiful faces covered by masks.
Of course, it was Maeve and Diana, the two heard a flying rumour, and if it turns out to be true then they might have a chance of finding Vritra and Yennefer.
"Looks like you already knew we would be coming here." Diana muttered, scanning the graveyard.
It was the territory of the Gravion organization, they were famous for digging out graves and the special ability of their leader.
Grrrrrr...
The man growled, his face twisted and body’s size growing rapidly, his clothes were torn as hair started growing all over him.
Within moments, his body transformed into a werewolf, with height over seven feet.
"Guess we would have to hunt down a few puppies before we catch your leader, it would have been easier if he just talked to us." Maeve spoke, ready for the war.
Just then, dozens upon dozens of eyes started glowing in the darkness, surrounding the two women.
More than forty werewolves locked onto them, the bestial beings emitting a bloody aura.
The werewolf race had a really close connection with the dead, few could even raise the dead, possessing all sorts of bizarre skills.
One of the specially big werewolves, whose size was nearly nine feet, stepped forward, standing over its hind legs.
HOOOOWWWWWLLLLLLLLL
Then raising its head high, the beast let out a loud howl, making the entire graveyard shudder.
CRACK
In the next instant, the sound of something breaking rang out then a hand plunged out of the soil, as a dead suddenly jumped out of its grave.
Its body looked grotesque, rotten flesh, broken and twisted bones, and a pungent smell.
Within moments, the same scene replayed again and again as more than two hundred corpses jumped out of their graves.
"..." Diana rolled her eyes, these fools actually used such skill before her?
Without wasting any time, the leader of the pack let out another howl while making a deep and long gash over his own arm.
Blood flew out of his arm, disappearing into the bodies of all the corpses as they seemed to undergo a mutilation.
"Alright that’s enough play around, we don’t have any time to waste. Just call the leader of Gravion out, we don’t wish to start a war." Maeve spoke.
But the leader of the pack didn’t stop, the corpses grew in size, their bodies becoming more grotesque.
Not wanting to waste any time, Diana raised her hand, as a blinding light consumed everything.
As a goddess, even if not the true one, she had the easiest and fastest growth of all.
The holy energy disintegrated all the corpses within moments, not even ashes were left behind.
Rrrrrr...?
The leader let out a surprised growl, knowing fully well that their group stood no chance against these two.
"W- Why do you want to see our leader?" the bigger wolf spoke in a thick hoarse voice.
"Like we said, we aren’t here to fight. We just want to know something." Diana said, staring directly at him.

"But you do know our leader has to pay a great price to find your answer right? Based on the level of information, his life force would be consumed." The leader said cautiously, but he had a feeling that the two were desperate to obtain whatever this answer was.
Desperate enough to kill them all or pay a really heavy price to know it.

"Of course, and we have already prepared a good enough compensation for your leader, no matter how many years he loses, the treasure we brought will provide him with more than that." Maeve spoke, trying to act calm, but the two couldn’t hide their urgency.
It has already been more than two years six months, yet they couldn’t find Vritra.
They weren’t even sure if he could still return, hope of finding him was the only force pushing them forward.

"Hmm... That does sound good, but that will only be filling up his life force, we would need an additional treasure to make it worth the effort." The leader of the small pack now seemed relaxed and more confident.
Sigh
The two ladies heaved a sigh of relief, negotiation was better than direct rejection after all.
"Do you have something in mind?" Diana questioned, though they did prepare a few valuable treasures just in case.
After staying silent for a few moments, the pack leader spoke:

"Yeah, you see, our leader loves young beautiful women and even with the masks on, I feel you are two of the most beautiful women I have ever come across. So if one of you can be his woman, then he will be happy to give you that answer."
Maeve and Diana frowned, killing intent surging out of their bodies, they almost blasted the whole pack to pieces.
But finding Vritra was priority, so controlling their rage, they didn’t attack immediately.
Taking their silence as agreement, the leader let out a growling laugh.
But before Diana or Maeve could speak, someone else did.
"Oh, that’s such a good offer, I have the same question. So, can you bring me to your leader if I were to give this beautiful lady to him?"
All the gazes suddenly moved upwards, where a man wearing a purple outfit and a mask was standing in air. He was holding onto a woman by her leg, the blonde woman hanging upside down.
"P- P- Pitiful one? Noooooooooooo"

sentences.text: The sky was eerily dark, the surrounding completely silent even though it was the time of the day.
Hundreds of graves could be seen present in a graveyard that spread over a couple of kilometres.
There was a guard sitting near the door, sleeping peacefully over his chair, with a cap covering his face.
The sound of wind echoed like ghostly wails, it truly felt like a setup of a horror movie.
CHIK CHIK
The sound of footsteps broke the silence, moving over wet soil.
Then two figures, wearing red robes with hoods, walked towards the guard.
Their faces were covered in shadows, giving the two ladies a mysterious and dangerous look.
Stopping in front of the slumbering man, one of them called out: "Is he here?"
"H- Huh?"
BAM!
Startled, the man fell off his chair, falling into the dirt.
Then with a grimace, he got up and began wiping away the mud, finally his face was visible.
There were long and deep scratches over his face, the scars looked terrifying enough to scare most.
"Ughh Who are you?
What are you doing here at this time?" the middle aged man once again sat back up on his seat and gazed at the two women.
"Tell us, is he here?" the same woman repeated her question.
"Huh?
He who?
Are you here to search for someone’s grave?
Or did you bring a body to bury?" the man spoke, yawning.
"..." After a slight pause, the other woman stepped forward and pinkish energy waves burst out of her body.
The man jumped back, his pupils changing colours.
"What exactly do you want?
The demons and gods are not welcome here." The claws of the man started growing, his body trembling as if about to undergo a drastic transformation.
"Funny, you phrase it as if we are asking for your permission."
Removing back their hoods, the two women took a step forward, their beautiful faces covered by masks.
Of course, it was Maeve and Diana, the two heard a flying rumour, and if it turns out to be true then they might have a chance of finding Vritra and Yennefer.
"Looks like you already knew we would be coming here." Diana muttered, scanning the graveyard.
It was the territory of the Gravion organization, they were famous for digging out graves and the special ability of their leader.
Grrrrrr...
The man growled, his face twisted and body’s size growing rapidly, his clothes were torn as hair started growing all over him.
Within moments, his body transformed into a werewolf, with height over seven feet.
"Guess we would have to hunt down a few puppies before we catch your leader, it would have been easier if he just talked to us." Maeve spoke, ready for the war.
Just then, dozens upon dozens of eyes started glowing in the darkness, surrounding the two women.
More than forty werewolves locked onto them, the bestial beings emitting a bloody aura.
The werewolf race had a really close connection with the dead, few could even raise the dead, possessing all sorts of bizarre skills.
One of the specially big werewolves, whose size was nearly nine feet, stepped forward, standing over its hind legs.
HOOOOWWWWWLLLLLLLLL
Then raising its head high, the beast let out a loud howl, making the entire graveyard shudder.
CRACK
In the next instant, the sound of something breaking rang out then a hand plunged out of the soil, as a dead suddenly jumped out of its grave.
Its body looked grotesque, rotten flesh, broken and twisted bones, and a pungent smell.
Within moments, the same scene replayed again and again as more than two hundred corpses jumped out of their graves.
"..." Diana rolled her eyes, these fools actually used such skill before her?
Without wasting any time, the leader of the pack let out another howl while making a deep and long gash over his own arm.
Blood flew out of his arm, disappearing into the bodies of all the corpses as they seemed to undergo a mutilation.
"Alright that’s enough play around, we don’t have any time to waste.
Just call the leader of Gravion out, we don’t wish to start a war." Maeve spoke.
But the leader of the pack didn’t stop, the corpses grew in size, their bodies becoming more grotesque.
Not wanting to waste any time, Diana raised her hand, as a blinding light consumed everything.
As a goddess, even if not the true one, she had the easiest and fastest growth of all.
The holy energy disintegrated all the corpses within moments, not even ashes were left behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 504: The Thieves
paragraphs: As Vritra, Fiona and Vanessa entered the capital, he instantly sensed that the two weren’t in there.
Normally, Vanessa and Diana could have sensed him, but Vritra hid it from them since he wanted to surprise them.
The three were flying at high speed, Vanessa on his left while Fiona on his right, holding his hand.
Slowing down, Vritra spoke: "They aren’t in the capital, I sense them from that direction."
Vritra pointed in the opposite of Phoenix Kingdom, near the new Cloud City.
"Hmm they did inform me about going to find some clue about you and Yennefer, maybe they had gone to check that." Vanessa said.
"Okay, you two wait for me in the capital, I will bring them with me." Vritra said, imagining surprising them.
"Hmm be careful honey." Vanessa said, despite knowing about his current strength, she still couldn’t help but be worried.
"..." Fiona’s fingers remained intertwined with his for a few lingering moments, then she reluctantly let go.
"I will be back asap." Vritra kissed the two ladies goodbye, he wanted his entire family to be together.
Only if he could find Yennefer now too.
In the next instant he disappeared, after staying there for a few more seconds, Fiona and Vanessa flew away.
Vritra was heading in the direction of the Cloud City, but suddenly he paused, seeing something familiar.
"Oh right, I felt I was forgetting something." He finally remembered, before the war in the Cloud City began, when the game was about to start, many people had disappeared.
Shitless, Onest, Xie and many other demons weren’t there in the arena, they had disappeared, and at that time Vritra didn’t have any time to worry about them.
Only now he remembered.
Bullo was running over the street, a familiar scene, except the bull was a lot stronger than before.
The street was turning into a mess, and Bullo seemed to be chasing someone.
Vritra looked ahead and saw dozens of priests running for their life.
"Sigh still the same troublemakers they are." Vritra shook his head, he continued to look around but didn’t see the monk.
But soon his gaze landed on a building that seemed to be a temple, and... it was on fire?
Just then...
BOOOOOM!
The top of the building exploded, on the other hand, Bullo crashed into the priests, tossing them all over the place.
Even among the panic and screams, the clear sound of bones breaking rang out.
Finally, he saw the two guys, Shitless and Onest, both flying up from the temple, evil looks on their faces as they stole something from there.
Of course Shitless couldn’t fly, so he was dragged along by Onest.
"Haha looks like they got quite professional in all this time." Yasmine laughed at the sight.
Vritra suddenly flashed in front of the two, his arms were crossed in front of his chest, looking at them with a suspicious look.
"What have you stolen? Where are you going?" he questioned, his voice neutral.
{Sin Point Gained: Shaken +1}
"!!!" Onest was baffled as he froze just as the man suddenly flashed before his eyes.
"Y- You! You are...?" Onest was speechless, staring at the person with wide eyes before questioning: "A- Are you from Golden Moon?"
Knowing that escaping might be impossible against this strong of an opponent, Onest weighed his option.
Shitless was being dragged along by his clothes, so he was hanging downwards.
With difficulty he turned his head and saw the person who had stopped them.
"P- Pitiful one?!!" somehow like always, he recognized Vritra at the first glance.
The monk’s eyes and mouth were wide open, before becoming teary.
"You are baaaaaccckkkkk!! sobbbbb"
"Huh? Pitiful one, why are you calling him by the title of that psycho...!!" Onest spoke in confusion before understanding something and staring back at the extremely handsome guy before them.
"Wait- Huh? You are... Are you really Vritra?!! Oh damn, why do you look so different- no that’s not important, how did you rise from the dead? Uh..."
Onest spoke in shock, his mind failing to make any proper thought.
He clutched his head to calm down but accidentally let go of Shitless.
Uwaaaahhhh...
Shitless let out a terrified scream, his body falling from such a high height.
Rolling his eyes, Vritra made a small platform made of dust which safely appeared under Shitless before bringing him back up.

"Yes it is me. But more importantly, I didn’t expect you to fall so low, I can understand for Onest but Shitless you even started stealing from temples now?" Vritra said, shaking his head in disappointment.

"No pitiful one, that is not the case. I am definitely not like that, I can piss over a temple but I wouldn’t fall as low as this thief." Shitless got to his feet and rubbed off the dust and his shock before speaking truthfully.
"What? Why are you speaking as if I am a disgusting, low piece of shit who is the scum of this planet?" Onest questioned, before scratching his head and wondering why he said all that.
"Well at least you know, anyway what is going on?" Vritra asked again.
He didn’t really care about temples and such, but the continent now belonged to his women so he wouldn’t like if someone was causing trouble there.
"Oh, this task was given to us by goddess, this was a fake temple and a base of Golden Moon where they collected information and funding.
So we destroyed it haha haven’t I become very evil during this time?" Shitless asked proudly.
"I see, so that’s how it is. Well good job then." Vritra remained silent for a moment then he took the bags from Shitless and threw them towards Onest.
"Return to the capital, I will meet you there. Sir Shitless, why don’t you come with me?"
Vritra spoke nicely, giving the monk goosebumps, whenever he was called by that title, Shitless was thrown into trouble.
"Uhm... I still have some work-"
"Come on, let’s go, I am not really asking for your consent." Vritra turned, as the platform started moving on its own, dragging the pitiful Shitless along.
"So what happened during that day, were you guys thrown into prison or something?"
Onest watched as the two flew away, it seemed the peaceful times were about to come to an end.
"He looks unimaginably stronger now, he has truly become a monster now." Onest muttered, feeling cold shivers, even though the two were on the same team.
Then he turned and flew back.
Vritra and Shitless chatted along the way, Shitless told him how their group was thrown into prison outside the continent just when they were about to distribute the glyphs.
While Vritra gave bits and pieces of info about himself.
And it wasn’t long before they arrived at the graveyard, which was located in the forest just outside the Cloud City.
"W- why are we going there?" Shitless felt ominous energy coming from there, and even more from Vritra whose mind must be cooking something far too evil.
"..." Vritra quite easily located Maeve and Diana, but stayed quiet for a minute, only after the pack leader put his condition did he decide to intervene.
They have already signed death contract by saying such words for his women, it seemed the entire Gravion organization was about to perish.

chapters.title: Chapter 505: The Deadly Answer
paragraphs: "Can you accept her?" Vritra said as he threw Sonia towards the pack leader.
The werewolves had already relaxed a bit but they became alert as a man appeared out of nowhere.
"Same question?" The big wolf caught the blonde before putting her down.
"..." Maeve and Diana stared up at him questioningly, feeling something strange about him.
"Who are you?" Maeve asked, how does he even know what they were here to ask.
"You will know about that soon." Shrugging, Vritra answered.
The two even looked at the blonde woman but also couldn’t recognize her.
’It seems they really are here to get some answer and not to hunt our leader.’ The big wolf thought, then he looked at Sonia, who looked rather beautiful as well.
So he decided to let his leader make the choice, growling, he added: "Fine, follow me, I will bring you all three to meet my leader. But don’t you dare try to do anything."
"Alright, let’s go." Vritra landed over the ground, inside the graveyard.
With his senses he could easily find the hidden path, but he waited.
The pack leader moved to one of the graves and pushed it down, as the ground trembled and stairs leading underground appeared as the land shifted.
All the other werewolves remained outside, while the pack leader led the three into the passage.
After a few twists and turns they found themselves in front of a stone door.
"Don’t try anything funny." The big wolf had already transformed back into his human-like form.
"As long as your leader can answer, I won’t." Vritra said, he seemed really weak, so the wolf didn’t take him all that seriously.
DRRRRRR...
The stone door was pushed open and inside sat a shady-looking guy with a slim body, though for his physique, his height was a bit too high.
In front of him was a table, where a round glass ball was present, like the ones shamans use to scam people.
"This is the leader?" Maeve and Diana both questioned sceptically, there was no one else there though.

"Yes, this very man is our leader, the Gravion himself! Be respectful, he knows the answer to everything." The werewolf spoke before explaining the situation to his leader, whose face instantly became full of lust.
The slim leader of Gravion was instantly attracted by the names of treasures and women, he glanced over Maeve and Diana but found that the two were too strong.
Finally his gaze landed over Shit- Sonia, who also looked quite good.
"Okay I understand, so if I find answer to your question, you will give the treasure to increase my life, this woman and additional treasures?" the leader’s voice had such a high pitch.
"Yes, you can get all that, if you can find the answer." Diana added in a hurry, this seemed her only hope.
"Alright, then spell out your question, and you better not go back on your word after getting the answer." The leader said, but being on the weaker side, he couldn’t really put up any conditions.
"Tell us, where Vritra and Yennefer are, o- or at least when will they return." Maeve said slowly and nervously.
"Yes, go ahead but first tell where Yennefer is." Vritra interrupted, wondering if Gravion was actually genuine.
"Alright, move back, let me do my thing." Gravion said, while gloating since finding people was one of the easiest uses of his ability.
He was thinking of how to extort more treasures and money from these rich guys.
Vritra, Maeve and Diana took few steps back while the other wolf moved out of the door.
Their organization was quite small and weak, they had only gathered a little of their reputation because of their leader’s ability.
Not to mention, the ability itself was the reason why this weak bastard even became the leader.
Placing his palms over the glass orb, Gravion began to mutter strange incantations, as his pupils rolled back and only the white remained visible.
Strange energy began to swirl around him and patterns formed over his face and inside the orb.
Vritra felt that those patterns looked a bit similar to the ones he had seen on monk Shitless.
Currently, he was standing beside the local pack leader outside the door.
"... Zirwtwa sigozag homwdj..." Gravion was muttering strange things, but after a minute or so the scene on the orb changed.
Vritra focussed and saw that it was displaying a place where countless black tornadoes flooded the space and somewhere in between those tornadoes...
He saw something familiar.
’Is that the love pill that I had thrown? It is broken? Back then I couldn’t do anything to it, how did it break?’ Vritra was surprised by several things.
Wondering how this was related to Yennefer.
"O- Oblivion tornado realm..." Gravion muttered in a barely audible tone, but Vritra heard it clearly.
The leader of the organization really seemed to be losing his life force while using this special ability.
Vritra’s hopes increased, he might really allow a few members of the Gravion if he can find clues about Yennefer.
A few more seconds passed, that much information seemed to be the only thing he was able to find.
Now Gravion moved to the next question.
His orb was consumed with darkness, as his brows knitted tightly, sweat started pouring down his body.
Gravion seemed to be struggling, suddenly out of nowhere, he coughed out blood and let out a terrified scream.
His life force started to be drained rapidly, growing older at a visible rate.
The leader’s hair grew grey before falling off his head, his teeth fell off, body shrunk even more and skin became wrinkled.
"!!!" everyone around them was shocked to see the sudden change, but before they could react...
THUD
The old man’s head smashed into the orb, all his life force had been consumed while searching for just 1 answer.
Finding Vritra’s whereabouts just might have been the biggest mistake of his life.
"Wait-" Maeve and Diana felt all their hope shatter as the guy died right before their eyes.
Just what sort of answer was it that costed this guy so much, how come information related to Vritra be so deadly.
None of them knew but he was already a Demi God, he was connected to the Divine and some unknown entity who was even stronger.
"D- D- Dead?!! Gravion is dead!! HOOOOUUUUUUUU" The pack leader let out a mournful howl, before looking at them with rage.
"So this was why you came here? How did you kill our leader, none of you are getting out of here alive!!" Without Gravion, their pack would be nothing.
"Oblivion tornado realm..." Vritra muttered, while remembering that sight, maybe this is really related to Yennefer.

"Good, well you all were going to die anyways, so there is no need to feel sad. He just went first, you will follow soon. No one who speak like that to my women can be allowed to live." Vritra spoke, his gaze passing over the two ladies.
"Huh? Who are you calling your wome- Oh wha-? Y- You are... Dear?!!" Diana and Maeve of course felt angry over Vritra’s statement, after another failure.
But finally he removed his mask and the barrier that hid his presence, as the goddess felt that connection with him.
The connection formed because of Nihilanima.

"As long as your leader can answer, I won’t." Vritra said, he seemed really weak, so the wolf didn’t take him all that seriously.
DRRRRRR...
The stone door was pushed open and inside sat a shady-looking guy with a slim body, though for his physique, his height was a bit too high.
In front of him was a table, where a round glass ball was present, like the ones shamans use to scam people.
"This is the leader?" Maeve and Diana both questioned sceptically, there was no one else there though.
"Yes, this very man is our leader, the Gravion himself!
Be respectful, he knows the answer to everything." The werewolf spoke before explaining the situation to his leader, whose face instantly became full of lust.
The slim leader of Gravion was instantly attracted by the names of treasures and women, he glanced over Maeve and Diana but found that the two were too strong.
Finally his gaze landed over Shit- Sonia, who also looked quite good.
"Okay I understand, so if I find answer to your question, you will give the treasure to increase my life, this woman and additional treasures?" the leader’s voice had such a high pitch.
"Yes, you can get all that, if you can find the answer." Diana added in a hurry, this seemed her only hope.
"Alright, then spell out your question, and you better not go back on your word after getting the answer." The leader said, but being on the weaker side, he couldn’t really put up any conditions.
"Tell us, where Vritra and Yennefer are, o- or at least when will they return." Maeve said slowly and nervously.
"Yes, go ahead but first tell where Yennefer is." Vritra interrupted, wondering if Gravion was actually genuine.
"Alright, move back, let me do my thing." Gravion said, while gloating since finding people was one of the easiest uses of his ability.
He was thinking of how to extort more treasures and money from these rich guys.
Vritra, Maeve and Diana took few steps back while the other wolf moved out of the door.
Their organization was quite small and weak, they had only gathered a little of their reputation because of their leader’s ability.
Not to mention, the ability itself was the reason why this weak bastard even became the leader.
Placing his palms over the glass orb, Gravion began to mutter strange incantations, as his pupils rolled back and only the white remained visible.
Strange energy began to swirl around him and patterns formed over his face and inside the orb.
Vritra felt that those patterns looked a bit similar to the ones he had seen on monk Shitless.
Currently, he was standing beside the local pack leader outside the door.
Zirwtwa sigozag homwdj..." Gravion was muttering strange things, but after a minute or so the scene on the orb changed.
Vritra focussed and saw that it was displaying a place where countless black tornadoes flooded the space and somewhere in between those tornadoes...
He saw something familiar.
’Is that the love pill that I had thrown?
It is broken?
Back then I couldn’t do anything to it, how did it break?’ Vritra was surprised by several things.
Wondering how this was related to Yennefer.
"O- Oblivion tornado realm..." Gravion muttered in a barely audible tone, but Vritra heard it clearly.
The leader of the organization really seemed to be losing his life force while using this special ability.
Vritra’s hopes increased, he might really allow a few members of the Gravion if he can find clues about Yennefer.
A few more seconds passed, that much information seemed to be the only thing he was able to find.
Now Gravion moved to the next question.
His orb was consumed with darkness, as his brows knitted tightly, sweat started pouring down his body.
Gravion seemed to be struggling, suddenly out of nowhere, he coughed out blood and let out a terrified scream.
His life force started to be drained rapidly, growing older at a visible rate.
The leader’s hair grew grey before falling off his head, his teeth fell off, body shrunk even more and skin became wrinkled.
"!!!" everyone around them was shocked to see the sudden change, but before they could react...
THUD
The old man’s head smashed into the orb, all his life force had been consumed while searching for just 1 answer.
Finding Vritra’s whereabouts just might have been the biggest mistake of his life.
"Wait-" Maeve and Diana felt all their hope shatter as the guy died right before their eyes.
Just what sort of answer was it that costed this guy so much, how come information related to Vritra be so deadly.
None of them knew but he was already a Demi God, he was connected to the Divine and some unknown entity who was even stronger.
"D- D- Dead?!!
Gravion is dead!!
HOOOOUUUUUUUU" The pack leader let out a mournful howl, before looking at them with rage.
"So this was why you came here?
How did you kill our leader, none of you are getting out of here alive!!" Without Gravion, their pack would be nothing.
"Oblivion tornado realm..." Vritra muttered, while remembering that sight, maybe this is really related to Yennefer.
"Good, well you all were going to die anyways, so there is no need to feel sad.
He just went first, you will follow soon.
No one who speak like that to my women can be allowed to live." Vritra spoke, his gaze passing over the two ladies.
"Huh?
Who are you calling your wome- Oh wha-?
Y- You are...
Dear?!!" Diana and Maeve of course felt angry over Vritra’s statement, after another failure.
But finally he removed his mask and the barrier that hid his presence, as the goddess felt that connection with him.
The connection formed because of Nihilanima.

chapters.title: Chapter 506: Reunited
paragraphs: "Master!!" Maeve’s mind and senses tingled, it really was him.
The two ladies stared at him wide-eyed, thinking if they were stuck in some illusion but he seemed as real as the word go.
"Now who are you?" the pack leader glared at him, ready to transform.
"Sure, but you will have to pay with your life to get that answer." Vritra’s lips curled up.
With just a thought, the leader’s limbs began to turn into dust, the slow transformation feeling extremely painful.
HOOOWWWWLLLLLLL
He let out a terrified and pain filled scream, his body sinking low.
Vritra glanced towards Shitless and decided to send him back, since his work was complete now.
"Thank you Shitless."
"Muahaha Anytime, pitiful one." Returning to his original form, Shitless let out an evil laugh, this wasn’t as bad as he had expected.
Then he disappeared.
"Wait here for a moment, I will be back." Vritra spoke, looking at the dazed women, before disappearing along with the pack leader.
Holding his throat, Vritra appeared outside, where the panicked werewolves were about to rush down into the passage.
"Stop, if any of you want to leave then do so in the next three seconds, if I find anyone in the graveyard after 3 seconds, then you will be dead."
The werewolves looked at each other and then Vritra, unable to make a choice.
But a slight flash of killing intent was enough to make most of the werewolves run for their lives.
"Three, Two, One and time over." Vritra looked over the few werewolves who were yet to leave.
Then along with the leader, he threw the bunch out of the planet, as they died in space.
"Good riddance, what a bunch of weirdos." Yasmine spoke, shaking her head.
Finally it was time to meet his wives.
They walked out of the underground space in a hurry and arrived beside him within moments.
Both stared at his face, he certainly looked a lot different, but it was definitely him.
"M- Master, is it really you?" Maeve’s tail was moving left and right in a hurry in her nervousness, she looked as charming as always.
"Yes, foxie, it is me." Vritra smiled, enjoying their reactions.
"..." Diana was still staring at him in shock, she even pinched Maeve’s arm to check if it was a dream.
But judging from her gasp, it certainly was not.
Finally, coming to their senses, Maeve was the first to throw herself into his arms, as she too started crying.
She complained about freezing her and throwing her away at that time.
The goddess too couldn’t handle her emotions, as the two women wrapped by each of his arms, stayed in his embrace.
Vritra consoled them for dozens of minutes; both were overjoyed at reuniting with their husband.
A while later, the three headed back to the capital, both women were clinging to his arms as they flew.
Vanessa, Fiona, Onest and Shitless were seated in a large hall, waiting for Vritra and the two women.
Some time after Shitless returned, the three walked into the hall.
Vritra sat over a chair and all his women were seating as close to him as possible.
He once again went over all the events, telling them the main events.
"I can’t believe you came back from the dead, and far more stronger than before." Onest muttered, his strength had grown quite a lot too in the last two years, but he was still not at the lord rank.

"Fiona, that undying mythic halo, you are able to handle it right?" Vritra asked, since the mythic halos had their consciousness so they can’t be completely trusted unless a bond had formed between the two.
Especially after seeing the 1st ranked the creation mythic halo kill the Divine, when they had been so close before.
"Yes darling, we did form a bond, this mythic halo is rather peaceful unlike its destructive nature." Fiona answered.
"That’s good."
"Honey, what are your plans going forward?" Vanessa asked, resting her head over his shoulder, seated over his armrest.
"First of all, I am going to the dragon realm, and also search for Yennefer." Vritra said, finding her was far more important than his revenge.
Though he will make every single one of them pay.
"Hmm I guess we can now stay low for a while, recently we have been angering golden moon and many other organizations a bit too much." Diana said, holding his hand tightly.
Fiona was sitting over his lap, and the others knew she needed this healing the most.

"Yeah, let them enjoy their tragically short life, let them believe that they have scared us. We will strike when they least expect it, whether it be the golden moon or the twilight, none of it deserve to exist." Vritra muttered, cold and terrifying look on his face.
"Anyway, why don’t we continue our talking over some food? It’s been so long since we ate together." Vritra suggested.
"Yes, let’s do that." Diana had a big warm smile over her face as she ordered the maids to prepare everything for them.
And soon, the whole group sat around a table, eating together.
Shitless and Onest left soon after, giving them privacy, the two were no longer afraid of anything.
Vritra really loved spending time surrounded by his women but he had to leave again.
Yasmine had waited long enough and now it was finally time, she was going to get her body back.
Who could even stop them anymore, unless the gods decide to directly kill him.
"Don’t be sad, you all, I will be back really soon. I will even bring you to the dragon realm after I have dealt with the problems." Vritra said, looking over the pitiful expressions of his women.
They had grown so much stronger already but he was happy to see that they were still the same.
Of course, not all, Fiona did change but her love for him had only increased.
Vritra gave goodbye kisses to them all one by one, each woman savouring his taste.
As Fiona’s lips separated from Vritra’s, he took a step back and patted her head.
"I will open a portal for you all soon, so we can have a tour of the dragon kingdom together." Vritra said, he took another step back and his body broke into countless glittering particles.
Just like that he was gone.
The dragon kingdom was a separate realm, most races or organizations wouldn’t dare to attack this realm because of the terrifying strength of dragons.
The previous two leaders were really terrifying, Yasmine and her father, both were powerful and great leaders.
Under them, the dragon kingdom only flourished, they killed countless demons.
But the new leader, Dago, was also feared initially because of Yasmine’s reputation but after the deadly war over two years ago.
He became a joke.
Others were beaten by Vritra as well but none was as miserable as him, he literally turned Dago into a shield.
Swinging him around.
The dragon emperor still had nightmares of that day, he hated Vritra to the core and wished he could kill him all over again.
Dago had become famous after a video of him getting beat up spread all over the place.
He was a complete joke and fool now.

chapters.title: Chapter 507: Into the Dragon Kingdom
paragraphs: Near the outer perimeter, two dragons in human like form yawned while flying around on their usual patrol duty.
No one really attacked this realm so this was the easiest and most boring job.
Even the demons wouldn’t enter.
"Sigh hey, have you heard, our emperor is soon going to marry." The first guard spoke, rubbing his head.
"I did hear the rumours, who is he going to marry anyway? Some dragon lady or from another race?" the second guard questioned.

"With how low his reputation is, you believe any dragon would want to marry him? Of course he would have to scam some other lesser race, using the dragons’ overall power as backing." Answered the first.
"Guessed it, so who is he going to marry?"
"I heard he will be participating in that coming marriage trial of the Ford family and had sent marriage offers to various ladies."
The two continued to gossip.
A figure appeared before them suddenly, they glanced at him lazily and paused.
"Is Dago in the palace?" Vritra questioned casually.
"Yes, he is hidden in the palace, it wouldn’t be hard to find him once you enter." The second guard answered, yawning again.
"Okay thanks, enjoy your shift." Vritra said before flying into the dragon realm.
"Huh? Did something happen? Oh right, like I was saying, even that fat woman from Star family had rejected him, can you believe it? Hahaha that fat woman, even she tsk tsk"
The laughter of the two rang out.
Vritra paused upon entering the dragon realm, as he took in the majestic sight.
There were big statues, well built big houses, the whole place was quite beautiful.
"Wow, this place looks beautiful."
The dragons were flying in the air, the sky was full of different colours, it was such a great scene.
"Yeah it still looks quite similar to when I last saw it." Yasmine appeared outside, after so many years she was back to her home.
She looked at the statues of her parents, her mother and father’s statues stood just beside her own statue.
Seeing them, she suddenly felt sad.
"Wifey, let’s go." Vritra extended his hand, looking tenderly at her.
Yasmine took in a deep breath, then she smiled and took his hand.
"So where is your room?" Flying towards the centre, where Vritra could clearly see the biggest and most magnificent building, he asked.
"I am not even sure if my stuff still would be in my room, not to mention if my room even stands now?" Yasmine said, most things were still the same but many things had changed as well.
Dragons live a very very long life, so a few years weren’t much for them, still these past few years had been like centuries for her.
First, she got to the lowest of her life, and finally met her beloved husband, her soulmate.
"Look, that is the arena where I killed a demon for the first time."
"And that mountain, my father used to bring me there every once in a while when I was young. There is a beautiful fountain, let’s go there together."
Yasmine couldn’t stop as she excitedly pointed at various things and kept telling him about her life.
She was really happy that Vritra was finally knowing all that about her.
Before long, the two had arrived near the palace.

"Looks like Dago had broken our original palace and built a new one, we will have to ask him where he had put all my stuff first." Yasmine said, she couldn’t sense it, which meant the Dago must have hidden it all away.
"Let’s go then." Vritra landed on the ground, as Yasmine disappeared for the time being.
The entire palace was made of gold and some shiny red metal, with intricate patterns which resembled Dago’s dragon form.
He was quite self obsessed it seemed, so the humiliation must have been detrimental for him.
All the dragons passing by looked at him and ignored, his skill Lost was really wonderful.
Pausing one of the men, he questioned: "Where is Dago?"
"Oh the emperor, you can find him locked in his chamber, if you go straight from here and then take two rights and three left, you will find it." The man answered calmly.
As Vritra walked away, he scratched his head and wondered what just happened.
Sitting over his bed, Dago was holding dozens of spears, and in front of him, there were dozens upon dozens of Vritra’s images drawn over a wall.
"KILL KILL KILL! I am going to kill you, how dare you ruin everything!!"
BANG
He threw the spear as another hole appeared in the wall.
Dago could no longer show his face to anyone, even the servants laughed upon seeing him.
Not to mention, someone actually found a clip of the entire war, and in that they cut the part of Dago getting beat up and treated as a weapon and spread it.
Since most people had died, Dago felt everything would be fine, since the survivors wouldn’t go out of their way to spread news of him.
And even if someone like Red did, who would believe such rumours.
Now though, everything was over.
"I will find every person related to him, I will bring the entire dragon army and slaughter every single one of them. If only he was still alive then... then I would..."
"You would do what if he were still to be alive?" a voice sounded beside him.
"I will crush him, cut him to pieces, torture him, feed him off to beasts, I will slaughter his family in fron—" but as his rage subsided, Dago paused, and wondered who had spoken.
He had ordered everyone not to enter.
As he looked to the side, he saw a devilishly handsome guy leaning against the door frame, arms crossed over his chest.
"Who are you?!!" Dago’s rage bubbled over, he couldn’t even marry anyone anymore.
While previously, he was flooded with marriage proposals, even from the big five families but he ignored them all in his arrogance.
Yet now, even the worst sort of woman wouldn’t agree to marry him.
"You didn’t recognize me? Haa and here you were talking big about killing me and whatnot." Vritra shook his head.
Then Yasmine appeared beside him, looking at her cousin with a faint smile.
"Long time no see, cousin, I heard you had been quite miserable recently. Honestly, this news made me laugh." Yasmine said with a chuckle.

"Y- Y- Yasmine? How are you still alive? Didn’t you die along with that demon— huh what? Wait then, i- is he really Vritra?" the dragon emperor jumped off his bed, staring at the face of his biggest enemy, his nightmare.
’It is him, it really is him!! How is he still alive, how come he didn’t die even after receiving the god’s punishment?’
Dago wondered but this was for the better, he can now kill his greatest adversary with his own hand.
"How did you survive? Well it doesn’t matter, a demon like you must have used some wrong way to resurrect yourself.
But this time, after I kill you, you wouldn’t even want to come back to life." Dago said angrily but after a moment remembered why he actually hated Vritra.
’Wait, what if he is still just as powerful? He beat me up so easily before, but maybe he lost his strength after dying, something like Yasmine maybe...’

While previously, he was flooded with marriage proposals, even from the big five families but he ignored them all in his arrogance.
Yet now, even the worst sort of woman wouldn’t agree to marry him.
"You didn’t recognize me?
Haa and here you were talking big about killing me and whatnot." Vritra shook his head.
Then Yasmine appeared beside him, looking at her cousin with a faint smile.
"Long time no see, cousin, I heard you had been quite miserable recently.
Honestly, this news made me laugh." Yasmine said with a chuckle.
"Y- Y- Yasmine?
How are you still alive?
Didn’t you die along with that demon— huh what?
Wait then, i- is he really Vritra?" the dragon emperor jumped off his bed, staring at the face of his biggest enemy, his nightmare.
’It is him, it really is him!!
How is he still alive, how come he didn’t die even after receiving the god’s punishment?’
Dago wondered but this was for the better, he can now kill his greatest adversary with his own hand.
"How did you survive?
Well it doesn’t matter, a demon like you must have used some wrong way to resurrect yourself.
But this time, after I kill you, you wouldn’t even want to come back to life." Dago said angrily but after a moment remembered why he actually hated Vritra.
’Wait, what if he is still just as powerful?
He beat me up so easily before, but maybe he lost his strength after dying, something like Yasmine maybe...’

chapters.title: Chapter 508: Crazy Emperor
paragraphs: Dago paused, somehow, if Vritra’s strength was still as high as it was during the war, then...
’Wait, is he actually here to kill me? Then his strength...? This is not a dream right?’ Dago was terrified for a moment.
But then he remembered that this was his realm, the dragon kingdom.
Even if Vritra’s strength was as high as it was during the war, he would at least have a way to escape, while throwing all the dragons as cannon fodder at him.
’Right, who says I even need to test his strength on my own. And there are already so many types of traps and protections I have already set up.’
The dragon emperor was so scared of Vritra that at the same time he increased the safety of this realm to the maximum.
Spending most of resources to make sure of his safety.
ROOAAARRRRRRRR
Pulling in a large amount of air, Dago let out a loud roar that reverberated across the entire realm.
All the dragons were alerted, clearly understanding the meaning behind this roar.
It was the highest level of emergency.
"..." Vritra just stood there, leaning back against the door frame.
He didn’t seem the least bit affected while Yasmine disappeared, she didn’t want to get in the way of her husband’s fight.
"Coming here was a mistake, you insulted me and attacked me when I was not ready, now you are going to pay for it." Dago said as dragon scales started appearing over his body.
He transformed into the dragon partially, his body size growing to near eight to nine feet.
Within moments, the sounds of dozens upon dozens of dragons rushing towards the chamber rang out.
His personal protectors and most of the guards all flooded the hallways, surrounding the building completely.
No matter how shitty their emperor was, without him, it would be extremely easy for other races to attack them.
They would be divided.
"Emperor, what’s wrong?" one of the protectors appeared inside the chamber, looking around in a hurry.
But there was no one around, only the tall emperor in his partial dragon form standing there.
"Kill him!! He is the man who killed thousands of our brethren, now we won’t let him escape!!" Dago shouted while pointing towards Vritra while daring not to attack himself.
"Huh? What’s going on here? Is there an enemy? Are we under attack?" more dragons rushed into the chamber but there was no infiltrator.
"Have you all gone mad?!! Look right there, IT IS VRITRA ARCLIS, he is standing right against the door. Don’t just stand there and kill him right away." Dago shouted desperately.
While all his men were scratching their heads, there really was no one.
"Don’t tell me, our emperor has finally gone mad." One of the commanders muttered in a low voice.
"It seems so, Vritra died more than two years ago, how could he be here? It seems he just woke up from another nightmare."
"He is seeing illusions now too, is he really fit to rule us all anymore?"
Such discussions broke among all the guards, these words only made Dago more mad.
"Hahaha Poor Dago, they all treat you like a fool, I can’t believe you have fallen so low. Tch tch." Vritra said with a shake of his head.
"There is no way they would trea—" Dago was about to shout when one of his protectors interrupted.
"Emperor, are you ill? Are you sure you didn’t just see him in a dream? There is no one here and Vritra is already dead.
No one can survive the god’s punishment, remember, our previous empress also passed away because of such an attack." The first protector said, looking at the emperor with pity.
"God punishment? Didn’t Yasmine also survive that, then why can’t he?" Dago interrupted, remembering seeing Yasmine back in the war and just now.
But why would they even believe him, there was no evidence.
And no one else said anything about the late empress.
It seemed his mind had finally snapped.
"Aaaaaahhhhh Damnit, he is standing right there, why won’t you believe me. Right, he must be using some skill to hide his presence.
You— yes you, go ahead and attack that door frame, right now." Dago shouted while pointing to the door.
The protector shook his head but still followed the emperor’s order, turning around, he shot forward a ball of flames.
BOOOOM
One side of the door exploded, pieces of the metals flying in all directions.
Yet it seemed to pass through Vritra’s body while he remained unmoving.
’H- Huh? Is he really just an illusion? Otherwise how could the attack go through his body?’ Dago now started to question his own sanity.
"Wait, he must be using spatial abilities, he did possess them. Really, Vritra is right there."
"Emperor, I think you need to rest, I will ask someone to repair this damaged door as soon as possible.
Please rest, if you need I can also call some physicians." Another protector added before turning and leaving along with the guards.
A lot of dragons had died in the war too, so they already didn’t like Dago’s decision making and command.
Now this seemed to be the final nail in the coffin, they looked at him as if he was some lunatic.
"Aww Gonna cry? Hahaha feeling helpless? Weren’t you trying quite hard to stop me back then, why don’t you come forward and attack me yourself?" Vritra said.
"You bastard, you are just an illusion, get out of my brain. You can’t hurt me!" Dago shouted, trying to calm his mind.
He returned to his original form and took in several long breaths.
"Is that so?" chuckling, Vritra finally moved.
He teleported exactly in front of the dragon emperor and then...
SLAP
"Does that hurt you? Do you believe now that I am real or need more evidence?" Vritra muttered after slapping him.
A clear handprint appeared over his cheek, and pain surged from his face.
’Real real real, this is fucking real. I am not hallucinating. He is going to kill me.’ Dago was terrified, he needed no further proof of his existence and strength.
With all his might, the emperor’s body shot towards the sky, as he broke through the ceiling.
He was going to use his best escaping method, though he would be teleported thousands of kilometres away or even into a random realm.
But it was still better than death.
’I can think about my revenge and reputation later on. Damnit, why my father had to leave now of all times?’ Cursing in his mind, Dago reached a really high point.
All the guards who were about to return to their duties or home, paused as they heard the loud noise.
Then they saw Dago floating high in the sky.
"What is he doing up there?"
’It is time for the payback for all he had done. He even tried to kill wifey.’ Vritra thought, as his gaze narrowed.
Then he flew up and flashed before Dago in an instant.
His body transformed, horns growing above his head, flames consisting of countless colours burning around him.
He looked like a devil sent straight from hell to take back Dago’s soul.
"Hah, I am leaving, and you won’t be able to find me after this." Dago muttered, in his fist was a small blackish glyph.

chapters.title: Chapter 509: The Great Escape- Or is it?
paragraphs: BANG
Right after crushing the glyph, his body began to glow and mix with nature itself.
"..." Since the process had already started, Vritra knew it was difficult to stop it.
If he tried he might just end up killing Dago, so he just watched him disappear silently, which only made Dago more arrogant.

"The next time we meet, our circumstances wouldn’t be the same. At that time, I will drag you all over the continent, and show everyone that I am not scared of anyone..." the dragon emperor’s voice became fainter and fainter and soon he disappeared.
All the people watching it from the ground were shocked, did their leader just run away because of a nightmare?
Thousands of kilometres away, inside a random temple where dozens of men and women seemed to be praying to a large corpse.
All of them had pale greenish skin, and big bodies.
A light flashed, interrupting the group, and then Dago appeared in the midst of the group.
"Oh where am I?" he wondered and his nose wrinkled upon smelling the stench.
Looking back he saw a corpse hanging by heavy chains.
Tch, how disgusting...
Turning, he shot out flames that soon consumed the entire corpse and it turned to ashes within seconds.
The group of more than a hundred stared at the scene in bafflement, unable to react.
But seeing their god’s body being treated like that, they were all filled with madness.
Their jaws opened wide, displaying countless sharp teeth as they all pounced at him.
"Hmph you puny things think you too can beat me up! Fuck, why is everyone looking down on me nowadays, let me take all my anger out on you all."
Dago punched the air, blasting away the bodies of more than ten creatures, their bodies turning broken and bloodied.
"Hey Dago, what were you saying again you were going to do to me when we meet?" suddenly a chilling voice sounded from somewhere around.
Dago let out a terrified scream, almost feminine as he jumped back and looked around, soon seeing Vritra seated over a wall.
Two big horns were present on his head, his body still burning with the same flame.
"H- How is this possible!! This is bullshit, I- I have to run..." Dago was truly going mad, he was so terrified that his body seemed to have aged a few centuries within a few seconds.
"Alright enough playing around, now it is time for you to get your punishment." Vritra muttered, then he jumped off the wall but midway his body just disappeared.
Dago only felt a light tap over his chest and in the next moment aggravating pain flooded his senses, blood spurted out of all his holes at once.
All his strength disappeared.
Not far away, Vritra stood while holding a small round core, which was full of powerful mana, it was orange in colour.
"Not bad, I will take this as compensation." Vritra put it away, he felt that this might be somehow useful to Yasmine, if not then he would just absorb it.
COUGH COUGH
Dago fell to his knees, blood clouding his scent, he felt so much pain as his core itself was ripped out of his chest.
"Noooooo ughhhh cough cough ahhhhhh" his physical body was certainly quite strong as well but now he can’t even fight the weakest lord.
"Alright, now time to destroy your physique." Vritra spoke, he walked closer to the fallen Dago and placed his palm over his shoulder.
The green creatures were all terrified of Vritra so they didn’t dare interfere, hiding in the corners.
"W- What are you cough ahhhhh s- stooooppppp I am sorrryyyyyyy I didn’t even do cough a- anything..." Dago could only beg now, he had even lost his chance to use any treasure or special skill.
Without the core, he was so weak.
Vritra didn’t know much about his titan race, but he had a strange feeling.
A titan’s speciality was certainly its physical body, so if he was correct then...
As soon as Vritra concentrated, Dago’s body started undergoing a strange transformation.
Scales appeared all over his body, but for some reason it felt very painful.
He wasn’t even trying yet his body was undergoing the dragon transformation on its own.
But then something even more terrifying happened, as the scales rapidly began to move onto Vritra’s body before disappearing into his skin.
Dago wriggled and screamed, this felt even more painful than getting his core ripped away.
After all this time, Vritra was ripping away his very physique.
"Aaaaaaaahhhhhh noooooooooo d- don’t stop iiiiitttttt!! I am sorrryyyyy uwaahhhhhhh cough cough it hurtssss fucckkk spare me, just once f- for Yasmine’s sake she is my s- sister!!"
Dago was ready to sink to any length if it meant surviving.
If only this excruciating pain could stop.
But Vritra didn’t pause, since it was the first time he was devouring a physique so he wasn’t as efficient.
Though there was no worry, he had a live subject.
’So titan race can devour physiques, nice, I wonder what else I can do with my physique and bloodlines.’ Vritra thought, while feeling his physique strengthening.
Since he was already a demi god, the changes wouldn’t be as big but still Dago was quite strong.
After over an hour, which seemed to have pulled Dago’s very soul out of his body, the extraction was complete.
’Once I get used to it, then I will be able to devour the physiques even faster.’
He thought now looking at the pitifully weak man, his strength was even weaker than an average human.
"What a sight, so Dago how are you feeling?" Vritra muttered, he really enjoyed stealing and punishing his enemies.
"Y... You bastard h- how cough could you ughhh i... i..." Dago could no longer even speak as he lay sprawled over the floor.
"You all, come here and have a bite of the dragon emperor’s body. But don’t kill him." Vritra said, as he jumped back and sat relaxed on the wall.
The scared creatures, urged by Vritra and natural hypnosis, slowly crawled forward but after seeing the hateful Dago who burnt their god...
They all went into madness and attacked him again.
BITE BITE
CRUNCH CRUNCH
Dozens of them started tearing apart at his body, pulling his limbs, flesh, even tearing apart his belly.
Initially Vritra planned to torture Dago further but seeing that sight, he felt this much was enough for him.
Even after losing his core and physique, Dago wasn’t able to die no matter what sort of injuries he received.
He kept screaming until his throat was ripped away, his jaw also got devoured.
This was a tragic end, it reminded Vritra of a zombie movie.
He continued to watch it for a few more minutes.
And only after confirming Dago’s death did he finally decide to leave, now finally, Yasmine will have her body back.
Of course even the soul was devoured by his soul wraiths. And his storage glyphs were taken away by him.
Now all of them were already in the lord rank.
As for the place where Dago had hidden her stuff, Vritra already located it back in the palace.
He flew back, appearing into the dragon kingdom within moments.
He directly went towards the dead emperor’s chamber.
Staring towards the ground, he kicked the floor hard.
BOOOOOOM

chapters.title: Chapter 510 Love and Obsession
paragraphs: BOOOOOOM
The entire palace started shaking but no one really paid it any mind since it happened quite often now.
Cracks spread over the floor, and soon a big room made of some strong metal appeared.
Instead of searching for its entrance, Vritra had decided to just force his way inside.
"Let's go." Vritra jumped onto the metallic room, then used his dimensional book as his body directly passed through it.
Dago hadn't really put too much effort into protecting it, maybe he just wanted it to be forgotten.
Landing inside, Vritra found himself in a large room which was filled with a lot of stuff.
All of this belonged to Yasmine and her parents, though Dago must have already taken any treasure he found.
Vritra put the storage glyphs he had found on a table, then called out.
"Wifey, check if the thing you are searching for is here or not."
Yasmine appeared outside, looking at all those things she felt emotional, memories of her childhood resurfacing.
"Sigh yes hubby, it is indeed here." She moved towards an ordinary looking vase, picking it up, she muttered faintly.
"Can you wait outside for me?"
"Okay, be careful." Vritra took one long look at her before flying out, he sealed the room with a barrier.
Then walking into Dago's chamber he looked around and seeing his images pierced by the spears, he chuckled.
"He surely hated me."
Hoping that nothing goes wrong in the process, he stood there attentively, ready to barge into the room if anything seemed off.
Yasmine had already explained to him about the way she would get her body back, it was with the help of a treasure her parents had left behind.
