'She is real, the empress is really back!!' There was no longer any doubt about it now.
Vritra just stood beside her with his arms crossed, enjoying seeing her fierce side.
For now, he was just her bodyguard.

"Now go and inform the council members about the meeting. Tell them to be present in the council hall in ten minutes. Anyone missing will be punished severely." Yasmine said as the pressure disappeared.
"Y- Yes empress, I will do that immediately." The old guy nodded and hurried away.
The guards were all frozen in fear, they didn't dare stand even after the pressure disappeared.
"G- Greetings empress." They all said together.
"Leave." Yasmine turned to look at Vritra, then the two headed towards the council hall.
"Good job, wifey." Vritra patted her head when the two were out of everyone's sight, and the dragoness snuggled into his arms.
"Hehe we need to put some fear in them or they will try to suppress me." Yasmine replied, as the two entered the council hall which was not far away.
While chatting, the two waited, and before ten minutes, the hurried footsteps of several men sounded.
Yasmine got off his lap and sat on another seat, clearing her throat as her face became expressionless.
And then, exactly thirty men rushed into the council hall. First they looked at Yasmine.
It seemed none of them could still believe she was back. After seeing her, they took their seats.
Yasmine waited until exactly ten minutes were over, then she looked at the members and questioned:
"Where are the rest two members?"
"U- Uhm Empress, I tried calling them but it seems they are busy with some other work, so they didn't have the time to come here." The same bald old guy from before said.
"I see, so they are busy with important stuff huh." Yasmine nodded, then she glanced at Vritra.
"Can you—"
"I see, so they are busy with important stuff huh." Yasmine nodded, then she glanced at Vritra.
"Can you—"
But Vritra spoke before she could finish. "Of course my Queen, it is my pleasure."
In the next instant, under the gazes of all thirty men and a few more guards who were standing outside the door, Vritra disappeared.
"Who was he? I don't remember seeing him ever before."
"Did he use teleportation? But his strength didn't seem all that high, is he even at the general rank yet?"
"Forget him, is she really even the empress? Wasn't she killed by the god's punishment all those years ago? How is she still alive?"
"Yeah, what if this is a scheme by the demons, you go and ask her."
"H- Huh? Why would I? You do it yourself."
The members whispered among themselves, looking doubtfully at Yasmine.
Only ten seconds had passed when a loud crunching sound rang out near the entrance of the room.
They all turned and saw Vritra standing with the two members of the council lying mangled on the floor.
Both their arms were broken.
"How dare you!! Who gave you the permission to hurt a council member, guards arrest this criminal right away!" One of the men stood up and shouted.
But all of them were internally shocked at Vritra's prowess. How did he subdue two powerful dragons within moments and even drag them here?
Even breaking their arms. Their physique was supposed to be their speciality.
"Ughhh what's going on?"
"Ahhh my arms, haa wasn't I just eating breakfast?"
The two men didn't even know what had happened.
"..." Without saying anything, Vritra returned to his seat and sat down.
"Get to your seats right this moment. The next time anyone disturbs me, they will be killed." Yasmine's chilly voice sent shivers down their bodies.
All the members sat silently, even the two quickly took seats.
Though there were also a few among these members who weren't useless fools and actually cared about the good of their kingdom and race.

"I am Yasmine Firehart, your empress. I know you have doubts about me, but I don't care. If you have a problem then you are allowed to challenge me to a life death fight. Anyone has any questions?" After speaking she looked around.
"..." But none dared to speak. It was definitely her. She had always suppressed the council with her strength.
"Good. Now that all of you believe me, let me introduce you all to someone special. He is my husband, Vritra." She announced, as all of them gasped in surprise.
They were still confused and baffled by her return out of nowhere, and now this.
But they had heard that name somewhere before...
"Oh right, wasn't that demon also called Vritra? But he was killed so the two couldn't be the same person." Someone muttered.
Yasmine didn't explain further. She continued: "If you are wondering where Dago is, then stop worrying, he is already dead."
Another wave of shock passed at this news. It seemed Yasmine planned to give them all a heart attack.
"Empress, shouldn't we wait for the council head to return?" One of the men said calmly.
The council head and the thirty third member was none other than Dago's father, which was why he even became the emperor.
"Yes, he is already on his way back. Council head should be back soon." Another added.

"There is no need for that. You can inform him of all the changes. Anyway, firstly, announce it to the kingdom and the world that I am back. Secondly..." Yasmine started giving one order after another.
And the council members weren't really happy with most of her decisions.
If all of them attacked her at once, they most probably could defeat her, but they stayed seated because of her husband's presence.
Previously it was because of a treasure she possessed, but it was already used, which was why her weakened soul even managed to escape against the god's punishment.
As Yasmine continued to order the members, they heard a distant sound of lightning thundering and a wild roar.
It seemed Dago's father was back and he somehow already knew about his son's death.
Someone was probably channelling the sound of this place to him or using some other method.
Now the council members had to make a choice. Either join the council head and fight against Yasmine...
Or submit to her and be her high ranked slaves until their death.
The choice was pretty simple actually.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 Docile
paragraphs: For the members to choose between freedom and slavery, the choice was pretty simple actually.
All thirty two of them instantly decided to keep seated, of course they chose to live.
Soon the angry middle aged man got close to the council hall, shouting even more ferociously.
"How dare you kill my son!! This is revolt, you can not be Yasmine, she would never have killed her kind." Pausing in the air outside the hall, he waited.
"Haa Does any of you want to challenge me like him?" Yasmine gazed over all the men who just shook their heads.
Some were just afraid while few felt Yasmine was a way better ruler, they were tired of working under Dago.
"Good, hubby, let's go." Yasmine said, and the two walked out of the hall.
Dago's father was quite surprised at first, Yasmine still looked the same as always.
He couldn't imagine how she could have survived through all that.
Then he looked at Vritra but felt no danger, so he shifted his attention back to the dragoness.
"Who the hell are you? You will be punished for killing my son, what are you all doing just sitting inside? Have you all submitted to her already?" he screamed in frustration.
"..." but none replied.
"So you are planning to stand against me? No way, you would accept me as the ruler?" Yasmine asked calmly.
On the other hand, Rago was going mad with rage, he just wanted to kill her.
The news of his son's death had shaken him to the core.
"Hubby, can you take care of him?" Yasmine said, it would be a waste to kill a powerful lord ranked dragon, so they would do something else.
"Yup." Vritra smiled and took a step forward, standing before his wife.
"And who the fuck are you?" Rago asked, squinting his eyes hard but failed to recognise him.
"You don't need to know that, also no one will remember you after you are gone. Psyche..." Vritra called out lazily as a shadowy figure suddenly rushed towards Rago.
"Wha" but before he had a chance to react, Psyche appeared before him and had placed both its palms over his head.
Rago's eyes turned completely white, his body seemed stiff but no matter how much he tried he couldn't get himself free.

Aside from Psyche's ability to possess people, now that it was so powerful after devouring so many lords, it could even erase a person's entire existence and redesign it in whatever way the wraith wanted.
"..." the struggle lasted only for a few seconds, and soon, Rago was gone.
He died but his body and soul remained, the real Rago though was already dead.
A couple minutes passed and Rago opened his eyes, the rage was all gone, only calm was left now.
Psyche disappeared, returning to the wraith storage.
"E Empress, you are back!" Rago muttered in surprise, seeming completely docile now.
"Hubby, this ability is quite handy." Yasmine muttered, she wanted to give her husband a passionate kiss right there and then but couldn't do it so openly.
"E Empress, you are back!" Rago muttered in surprise, seeming completely docile now.
"Hubby, this ability is quite handy." Yasmine muttered, she wanted to give her husband a passionate kiss right there and then but couldn't do it so openly.
The three headed back inside and when all of them saw the docile Rago, they shivered, had they tried to fight, would they be turned into something like that too?
Going forward the rest of the meeting went quite smoothly, Yasmine explained all the things she needed to change.
And all council members agreed, although reluctantly.
Vritra just sat there silently, observing the reactions of all the members.
There were a few who seemed strange, like they still couldn't accept or didn't want to accept that she had returned.
And he had a feeling that they might try something.
Maybe they were in cahoots with the demons?
Vritra just couldn't trust anyone, so he put all his soul wraiths to trail them.
All wraiths, except the new Chimera, that wraith was too destructive and could only be used in battles.
It wasn't long before the meeting ended, Yasmine dismissed them all, as the members got to work.
The next few days would be quite busy for them all and even Yasmine.
"Haa Hubby, let's call mom and others here, let's take a tour of our kingdom together." Yasmine suggested, she snuggled close to him while sitting over his chest.
"Yeah, I did promise to call them here. But firstly, about that Titan race and that Oblivion tornado realm... where can I find the information about them?" he asked.

"Hmm You can try at Maeve's organization, though I doubt they would know much. My safest bet would be one of the top five families, the Star family, who possess a vast amount of knowledge and information.
It is just all that information that made them rise to such a level." She replied, pressing her face against his neck, giving soft kisses.
"Alright, let's go there after this." Vritra nodded, after discussing a few more things, the two left the hall as well.
"Looks like I need a new palace, I don't want to live in that place. Sigh it will take quite long." Yasmine sighed, Dago had rebuilt the whole palace, breaking the old one.
Even with special abilities the whole process would take quite long.
"Not really, you see I can create it really quickly. Do you want the palace to look exactly like before?" Vritra questioned, as he walked in front of the palace.
"Uhm Yes." The dragoness nodded, she was yet to see the extent of his strength or how much his dust manipulation had improved.
"Alright, just wait a minute." Vritra remembered the palace from bits and pieces of Yasmine's memories he had seen before.
Then closing his eyes, Vritra extended both his hands and got to work.
First, he made the existing palace turn to dust, everything inside, the beds, portraits, gems, everything.
Of course, the servants had already been asked to leave the place.
Under Yasmine's gaze, the whole palace crumbled, turning to dust.
And in the next instant it started to assemble, the dust taking different forms.
Vritra's control had grown to such an extent that he was even able to turn the dust particles into all sorts of metals or other things.
She continued to watch as room after room, all the materials, everything was getting built just as she remembered.
He wasn't missing even a detail, of course he didn't possess any memory of few places so he asked her about it.
Within a couple of minutes, a brand new palace was standing before them, it was completely ready down to the very last detail.
The beds, the bathroom, there was everything.
"Whoa Hubby, that... was so cool." Yasmine stared at the palace in shock, it instantly brought back so many memories from her childhood.
She giggled and jumped into his arm, giving a kiss on his lips.
"Alright, let's bring them here first."
Vritra concentrated and opened a portal using the Null, connecting it to the exit of the dragon realm while the other was connected to the women's location.
Thankfully they were all together.
Fiona, Diana, Maeve and Vanessa, all excitedly entered the portal as Vritra called them.
"Wow, this place is really beautiful." Maeve muttered, looking around at the dragon kingdom.
It was the first time she was here after all, as a demon, if she entered she would have been killed.

chapters.title: Chapter 519 Family Time
paragraphs: The demoness looked around.
Comparing her demon realm to this place, Maeve could only sigh.
"O Oh so you are the dragon empress!" her gaze then landed on Yasmine. Maeve had heard a lot about her, but this was the first time she was actually meeting her.
Though the fox demon did see her once during the war.
"Hello Maeve, just call me Yasmine."
"You are finally back!" Vanessa had a smile on her face as she gave Yasmine a hug. Diana and Fiona followed.
The three had quite a close bond already.
"Thank you Mom, Diana and Fiona." Yasmine was just as happy to finally meet her family.
"..." Fiona silently went to Vritra's side and held his hand, only then did she feel a little better.
"Have you already reclaimed your position?" the goddess asked. They were ready to help if needed.
"Yes, thanks to hubby, it all went really smoothly." Yasmine said.
Gazing at his women, Vritra wondered how much their strengths differed.
'First will be Yasmine and Fiona, especially with the Undead Mythic halo, then Mom and Diana and Maeve at third place.' He roughly estimated.
Of course if they were to actually fight seriously, the result might differ slightly.
"Now how about we go for a tour of this kingdom, there is a lot I want to show you all." Yasmine said, she was really happy to have such a good family.
The dragoness was no longer alone, only if Yennefer was here as well, then their family would be truly complete.
The group then travelled to different parts of the enormous dragon kingdom, as Yasmine excitedly brought them over to all the places with special memories.
They ate together, staying in a big room of the new palace together.
Vritra decided to use this free time to give more attention to his family, thankfully there was no danger yet.
Though he was still keeping a close eye on many of the dragons, to ensure Yasmine's safety.
At night Vritra was even busier as he had to satisfy several ladies, out of them, the dragoness would go for the highest number of rounds.
The next couple of days actually passed peacefully, Yasmine worked too but she spent most of her time with her family.
On the night of the third day, Vritra sensed something buzzing in his inventory.
Taking it out he found it to be a communication glyph, he was getting a message from Gunter.
Lying over his bed, naked under the sheets along with all his women after another long passionate session.
He opened the message and heard it.

"Art, can you return tomorrow? Actually we will be leaving to meet the Ford family tomorrow and your presence is necessary." Gunter said before his worried voice sounded: "Cough And you are fine right, contact me immediately if you are in any problem."
On the other hand, Vritra just sent an 'Okay', before putting the glyph away.
In the Yate family, he actually had a good image of Gunter in mind.
"You will be leaving again tomorrow?" Fiona asked, the corners of her lips sinking, she looked so cute and beautiful.
"Hmm I need to find about Yenni, I know she is safe for now but for how long? I have to hurry." Vritra replied, kissing her forehead and pulling her closer.
"Mhmm" Fiona nodded, he had already explained the whole story to them.
"For now, we will be returning to our cities. Now that you are back, we need to change several things and use less aggressive approach." Vanessa mumbled, her boobs pressing against Vritra's cheek.
In the last couple of days, he had certainly drunk his fill of his favourite milk.
This was definitely one of the things he had missed most.
"I will leave my wraiths with you all just in case." Vritra added.
They continued to chat for a while longer and soon fell asleep, comfortably and in each other's warmth.
The news of Yasmine's return had spread like wildfire, whether it be inside the dragon kingdom or in the outside world.
By now almost everyone knew that the supposedly dead empress was back.
She took over the dragon realm within minutes, her name still brought the same level of fear to all.
The people of the kingdom were overjoyed, although Yasmine's punishments were very harsh but their lives were much better.
And they didn't need to be afraid as long as they didn't commit any crimes.
They thanked gods that Dago was gone and the most talented entity to ever exist was back.
All organizations had different reactions to her return, some were happy, some apathetic, while many seemed to hate it.
The demons didn't react immediately in any way.
Nor did anyone else attack, but many did send gifts.
The next day, they woke up late, ate together and spent a few hours and only then Fiona, Diana, Maeve and Vanessa left.

chapters.title: Chapter 520 Pitiful One
paragraphs: Looking at the big clothes shop, Vritra landed on the ground and headed inside. Instantly several maids rushed up to him, leading him inside.
Everyone in the realm already knew about his return.
After climbing to the 2nd floor, Vritra found Gunter and his wife, Ava seated together.
"Son, you are here!!" the couple spoke at the same time, as Ava rushed forward to give him a hug.
She still looked weak but was healing rapidly, it wouldn't be long before she was perfectly fine.
"Oh um yes, but why did you call me here?" Vritra questioned, as Ava took a step back.
She looked at him with teary eyes, he had grown so much and looked so good, to the point she found it difficult to recognise him.
Strangely though, Ava didn't really remember how he actually looked.
"Hadn't your father informed you yet? The Ford family is organizing an event for you tomorrow, there you will be meeting your future bride." Ava answered, before adding:
"This will be a really important event for you, so we need you to look the best."
'An event, I wonder what their motive is...' Vritra thought, wondering how exactly this would give him information about Yennefer.

"It seems they will be announcing the marriage arrangement to the world, maybe also introducing you to everyone and maybe some other motives. Hubby, this will be fun." Yasmine spoke, floating around him.
'Well it doesn't matter what they have planned, my motives are pretty clear.'
While conversing with her, he got pulled towards one of the seats by Ava.

"But why are they holding the marriage trials for that Tiny girl if you two are already engaged? Was it because Art had disappeared? Maybe they will also cancel the trials now." The dragoness spoke to herself.
Vritra didn't really need any clothes, with Goop present in his arsenal, he could turn it into any type of outfit.
The excited couple brought him from one shop to another, purchasing various things, but Ava got tired and so the shopping finally ended.
Vritra returned to his room and didn't really have much to do for the rest of the day.
But just a few minutes after Yasmine came out of the fourth dimension, there was a knock on the door.
"Enter." Vritra sat up while Yasmine disappeared once again, before he opened the lock from inside using dust manipulation.
"Cough Hello nephew, I heard about tomorrow's event." A meek middle aged man entered the room.
Vritra remembered seeing him a few days back in the arena, he was one of the few who hadn't jumped to fight him but was still against him.
"Why are you here?" Vritra's face had no emotion, yet his gaze alone made the middle aged guy shiver.

"U- Uhm... P- Please forgive me for my rude behaviour back then, after seeing y- your capability, I believe there would be no better ruler than you. I brought some gifts, I hope you can accept these."
He took out several objects from his storage glyph and put them over the table.
"Hmm, is there anything else?" after a few moments passed Vritra questioned, seeing the guy linger there hesitatingly.
"Uhm just know that I fully support you now, I- I heard about your marriage announcement." He continued slowly. Previously, this was kept a secret so only a few knew about it.
"So?" raising a brow, he asked him to continue curiously.

"Sigh this must be hard on you, making this big of a sacrifice for the family, just know that I will help you in whatever way I can." The guy looked at him with a pity filled gaze, sighing as he stood up.
"Huh? What do you mean?" Vritra's confusion only increased.
"It's okay, I know you don't want to marry her either and this marriage is being forced upon you, but just stay strong." Finally he left, patting his chest with sadness.
Art's uncle couldn't believe he was opposing a guy like him, someone who was sacrificing himself for their good.
It filled him with grief and self loathing.
Vritra was left sitting in the room confused, what sort of woman was his fiance supposed to be, that even his enemies would start pitying him.
KNOCK KNOCK
Just then, another knock sounded interrupting his thoughts.
"Enter..." Vritra said, and then another of his uncles from one of the branch families came with his wife.
"Sigh Art, I know it is tough on you, we are sorry for thinking of you wrongly before. Please accept these gifts and find it in your heart to forgive us." The man said.

"Your Fiance... Sigh that woman, I understand she has a really bad reputation and is well not good enough for you, but thank you for doing this for the family." The woman said with genuine warmth in her eyes.
Vritra: "..."
Yasmine: "..."
And that was the start, soon more of his uncles and aunts came to visit him with all sorts of gifts.
Even the ones who got severely injured by him before, they were brought there by servants and showed concern towards him.
Soon, his room was flooding with gifts, most of the family members had come to visit Vritra.
'There is something very seriously wrong with the situation, why are even people like them pitying me? They can't even move, and I am the one whose future is bleak?'
Vritra rubbed his forehead, telling the guards not to let anymore members inside the room.

"Whatever might be the case, it's not like you need to marry. We will disappear right after getting the necessary information." Yasmine said as she appeared back and lay down on the bed, her head resting over his lap.

"...Yeah, but when has anything been that simple in my life? Let's see how tomorrow goes, I will be meeting the Ford family... sigh if only Yennefer was here, I wouldn't need to wait to punish that giant guy." Vritra thought, sighing.
The rest of the day passed uneventfully, many others went to meet him.
Even Gunter came to provide moral support, while apologizing.
It left Vritra wondering how bad the woman would be for everyone to react like that.
Was she that ugly, or ill mannered or something even worse?
He just stopped thinking and let his dragon waifu heal him, locking the room and surrounding it with barriers.
The two spent some intimate time, and like before, there was just no end to Yasmine's hunger.
She always wanted more of him, thankfully Vritra wasn't one to get tired easily, he could keep on going and even surpass her libido.
Time passed really quickly as the two talked or were busy fucking, the two only stopped when it got late at night.
So late, that just after an hour, the sun rose high.
Vritra slept peacefully inside the room with his gorgeous wife in his arms, their naked bodies pressed tight.
Since the room was covered by barriers, no voice got inside and others weren't even able to open the door.
And so, the main character of the Ford family's event was late, sleeping still while the event was about to start.
Though he woke up around nine, after having his quality sleep, only then did he notice the crowd gathered outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 521 The Damned Event
paragraphs: Inside the ford realm, the whole place was decorated, the streets, shops, houses, as if there was a big festival.
A lot of guests kept entering the realm, after all it was going to be a really important day for the Ford family.
Though all these decorations would also work for the marriage trials so they didn't hold back and spent quite a lot.
The event was supposed to start early in the morning, so most of the important figures had already showed up though many were yet to arrive.
Sir Giant, wearing fancy clothes, was meeting the guests and welcoming them.
His grandson, Shen, the monarch of the family, was busy with the arrangements and security.
While Rich was meeting with his future partners, he wasn't the richest person alive on the planet for nothing.
"Has the Yate family not arrived yet?" Sir Giant excused himself and walked to the side, before asking one of the men who was managing things at the event.
"N- No sir, they are yet to arrive. We have clearly informed them of the time, maybe since the event was planned too abruptly, they didn't have enough time to prepare.
It is after all a big day for them, their long lost son's marriage."
The manager said, though he felt afraid but he tried to calm Sir Giant.
"Sigh yeah, we had to do it in a hurry for our own reasons. Let's... just wait." He said, before walking to entertain the guests.
But if the Yate family gets too late, not only would they be making fun of themselves but even dragging the Ford family along.
So, Sir Giant asked someone to go check if they had encountered some problem.
More and more guests filled the vast venue.
The event was organised inside an enormous building, large enough to house thousands of people.
The decorations inside seemed even more lavish, one side was the food while the other was the seating arrangement and a platform; maybe for some important announcement.
By now, more of the guests were becoming aware of Yates absence, soon the place was filled with low murmurs.
Even the soft music playing couldn't stop the murmurs from reaching the ears of Ford family members.
"Don't tell me the Yates decided to not come. I know relation between the two was getting bad but it seems even the pretences are gone now."
"What even was the reason for this event? Is it related to Tiny's marriage trial? But then why was it said in the invitation that even the Yates are a part of this event?"
"Haa I tell you, those Yates had forgotten their place.
Once they used to be high and mighty, ruling over all other four families but now they are just a shadow of their past selves.
It seems this time they are finished."
"Have you heard the son of Monarch, Art Yate has returned? Haha I actually pity them, of course with youngsters like those they are bound to fail."
Various talks filled the hall from all sides and with each passing minute, it was getting worse.
There was only so much the Fords could do to handle the big crowd, and with so many important figures, they couldn't forcefully suppress them.
More than thirty minutes passed the designated time to start the event.
And things were starting to get restless, even the Fords were getting angry by now.
This was clear disrespect.
Soon the guy Sir Giant had sent earlier returned with news.
"So they actually faced some trouble right? That's why they are late right? I knew it, that Gunter wasn't such a perso-" Sir Giant tried to speak loudly to make the crowd stop.
"Uhmm no sir, from what I have found... it seems they are late solely because young master Art overslept." The guy replied with second hand embarrassment.
"W- What? Overslept?" Sir Giant and the few around were speechless.
"...And why did no one try to wake him up? Is his sleep more important than this event, than both our reputations?
Haa my damned son, why did he have to make that god pact?" Sir Giant cursed, but couldn't do anything since his son was already dead.
But with her reputation, it really was impossible for anyone from important origin to accept to marry her willingly.
And despite everything, Sir Giant couldn't allow her to be married off to someone useless or with bad character.
So tying knots with Art seemed like the best option before, he was also an intelligent, talented, good looking kid.
'Damnit, I did prepare for something to cut that god pact from our side though we would have to pay a really really heavy price.
Which is why I was happy to hear that Art is actually back, now we don't have to pay that price and the marriage can continue like normal.
But it seems the disappearance had made him useless.' Sir Giant, Shen and even Rich, all of them already had a really bad image of Art now in their minds.
They were already imagining a rotten rich brat to show up.

'Maybe I should just cancel this marriage and pay the price, it is worth it, I can't let my doll's life be ruined. Her life is already full of misfortune.' Sir Giant thought, making his decision firm.
Gesturing, he called Rich and Shen closer and covered themselves in a barrier.
"Great grandfather, do you wish to cancel this marriage?" Rich questioned, seeing the angry look on his face.
"Grandfather, I understand your concerns. But let's wait a little more, if they still don't arrive then we will cancel both the event and marriage.
We still have a way to save ourselves but the Yates don't. I am surprised they are taking this whole event so lightly when they should be hurrying more than us." Shen spoke.
He looked like an older version of Rich, if he didn't appear middle aged then people would even call them twins.
Her life was filled with so many problems, they all wished that at least she could be married, this might be her only chance.
But what's the point if her life partner is a spoiled mannerless boy?
"..." Sir Giant nodded, thankfully most didn't know that they were going to arrange the marriage between the two families.
'Otherwise, everyone would have started mocking my doll... this is absurd.' He thought.
The barrier broke, Rich walked away with a smile, so did Shen, but Sir Giant was filled with rage.
Twenty more minutes passed and finally his patience broke, and hence, he decided to cancel the event right there and then.
There was no way he would let someone like that marry her.
Just then, a loud announcement rang out.
"The Yate family is here!"
The crowd parted, giving space to the late main stars of the event.
Gunter was walking at the front of the group with an apologetic look on his face, he seemed quite worried.
There weren't quite a lot of people from the Yate family, after all, most were resting now after getting severely injured by Vritra.
This felt like another slap in the face for the Ford family, after how much importance and respect they were giving the Yates from the beginning.
Even in the invitations, the importance of Yates was clearly shown.
And now, aside from Gunter and a few of his brothers, only servants could be seen.

And things were starting to get restless, even the Fords were getting angry by now.
This was clear disrespect.
Soon the guy Sir Giant had sent earlier returned with news.
"So they actually faced some trouble right?
That's why they are late right?
I knew it, that Gunter wasn't such a perso-" Sir Giant tried to speak loudly to make the crowd stop.
"Uhmm no sir, from what I have found... it seems they are late solely because young master Art overslept." The guy replied with second hand embarrassment.
"W- What?
Overslept?" Sir Giant and the few around were speechless.
"...And why did no one try to wake him up?
Is his sleep more important than this event, than both our reputations?
Haa my damned son, why did he have to make that god pact?" Sir Giant cursed, but couldn't do anything since his son was already dead.
But with her reputation, it really was impossible for anyone from important origin to accept to marry her willingly.
And despite everything, Sir Giant couldn't allow her to be married off to someone useless or with bad character.
So tying knots with Art seemed like the best option before, he was also an intelligent, talented, good looking kid.
'Damnit, I did prepare for something to cut that god pact from our side though we would have to pay a really really heavy price.
Which is why I was happy to hear that Art is actually back, now we don't have to pay that price and the marriage can continue like normal.
But it seems the disappearance had made him useless.' Sir Giant, Shen and even Rich, all of them already had a really bad image of Art now in their minds.
They were already imagining a rotten rich brat to show up.
'Maybe I should just cancel this marriage and pay the price, it is worth it, I can't let my doll's life be ruined.
Her life is already full of misfortune.' Sir Giant thought, making his decision firm.
Gesturing, he called Rich and Shen closer and covered themselves in a barrier.
"Great grandfather, do you wish to cancel this marriage?" Rich questioned, seeing the angry look on his face.
"Grandfather, I understand your concerns.
But let's wait a little more, if they still don't arrive then we will cancel both the event and marriage.
We still have a way to save ourselves but the Yates don't.
I am surprised they are taking this whole event so lightly when they should be hurrying more than us." Shen spoke.
He looked like an older version of Rich, if he didn't appear middle aged then people would even call them twins.
Her life was filled with so many problems, they all wished that at least she could be married, this might be her only chance.
But what's the point if her life partner is a spoiled mannerless boy?
"..." Sir Giant nodded, thankfully most didn't know that they were going to arrange the marriage between the two families.
'Otherwise, everyone would have started mocking my doll... this is absurd.' He thought.
The barrier broke, Rich walked away with a smile, so did Shen, but Sir Giant was filled with rage.
Twenty more minutes passed and finally his patience broke, and hence, he decided to cancel the event right there and then.
There was no way he would let someone like that marry her.
Just then, a loud announcement rang out.
"The Yate family is here!"
The crowd parted, giving space to the late main stars of the event.
Gunter was walking at the front of the group with an apologetic look on his face, he seemed quite worried.
There weren't quite a lot of people from the Yate family, after all, most were resting now after getting severely injured by Vritra.
This felt like another slap in the face for the Ford family, after how much importance and respect they were giving the Yates from the beginning.
Even in the invitations, the importance of Yates was clearly shown.
And now, aside from Gunter and a few of his brothers, only servants could be seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 522 A Fatal Misunderstanding
paragraphs: "Gunter, you are finally here. Welcome!"
Shen walked forward before his grandfather could, worried that this event might turn into a fight.
"Shen, I apologize for being late. Uhm... we were held back because... of some unforeseen problem."
Gunter said while scratching his cheek.
Wondering how it would sound if he said they were late because his son overslept, though he knew they already knew it.
"It's alright, who could ever expect such serious problem to arrive out of nowhere?"
Shen said, he too couldn't hold back his anger despite trying his best.
'Sigh they are our guests, and her future potential in laws, we have to be respectful.'
The monarch of the Ford family quickly regained his composure.
"Anyway, why did so few of you come? Was there another unforeseen problem?"
Shen said, only to curse inside, maintaining a smile.
Gunter perked up, for this he had a really good reason.
"Actually yes, just look at these. Do you think they would have been able to come here in their current condition?"
He hurriedly showed the images of all the bandaged family members.
From youngsters to middle aged guys, there were so many people.
"What? How did your family get in such a bad shape? Did someone attack you? Was it the demons?"
Shen asked, he didn't remember hearing any news.
"Uhm... it was because of internal conflict but now the family is back together, everything is resolved."
Gunter added.
"Sigh Forgive me, please come inside, we were waiting just for you to start the event"
After looking around he only saw the servants and few family members.
He looked over the few young men in the group, and questioned:
"So, which among them is Art?"

'Hmm They look average or maybe even below that. Based on every parameter, all these guys are worse than even the worst person we found during the marriage competitions. I can't believe we have to marry her off to someone from them. The Yates are done it seems, if only the circumstances weren't the same then we wouldn't even look at guys like them. Sigh my poor...'
Shen's running thoughts were interrupted by Gunter.
"Oh, he is none among them. Hmm he is..."
Gunter turned and looked behind the servants.
Sir Giant, Rich and other members of the Ford family had arrived closer now to see the groom.
"There he is, since my wife is still weak so he is helping his mother."
He added with a look of pride.
"I see."
Shen, Sir Giant and Rich all glanced faintly before turning their gaze away, not expecting anything.
But after a moment, their gaze shifted back to the person in a red outfit with white pattern on it, walking along a pale woman.
"Oh!"
Several gasps sounded the moment they actually saw the person they had been waiting for, it was like he had walked straight out of the most beautiful painting.
The world around him seemed to be full of liveliness and colours, he actually looked a bit too good.
"T- That is your son?"
Sir Giant asked in surprise, pointing his finger straight at Vritra.
"Yes, who else, that is Art."
Gunter felt even more proud after seeing their response.
'He... looks quite good at least.'
They thought, their anger dimming a bit.
It wasn't just the Ford family members, but even the crowd stared at him with wide eyes as messages after messages kept popping.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +3,422}
{Sin Point Gained: Enchanted +3,422}
{Sin Point Gained: Praised +3,422}
{Sin Point Gained: Loved +1,725}
There wasn't a single person who hadn't turned to take a look at him, and soon all discussions were about Art.
Many women were planning to propose marriage to him, none of the women could resist his charms.
"Why does it look like he has no strength? I remember him being quite the genius when he was younger."
Sir Giant asked, narrowing his eyes and sensing Vritra's presence.
"Oh that's... of course he isn't powerless, it's a treasure he is using which completely hides his presence and strength."
Gunter made up a lie.
"I see, that makes sense. Anyway, the event is already quite late, please enter, we will be starting soon."
Sir Giant said, drinking his anger up.
It actually didn't look like Vritra was ill mannered, maybe something serious really happened.
All of them had heard that he had just recently returned and had been in a coma for so many days.
Maybe it was some medicine that reacted, making it unable for him to wake up.
And just like that, the three had formed reasons of their own, suddenly not feeling all that angry.
Shen led the Yate family members towards the seat, various things were especially prepared for them.
Gunter and Ava sat together, while Vritra sat on a seat beside them, all others taking seats behind the three.
Or rather four, Yasmine was sitting over Vritra's lap.
"Hehe Sorry for making you late hubby, but you know, now I feel anxious if I can't feel your warmth inside me. I have to keep trying."
The dragoness said, pressing her lips against his cheek.
Her lips touched his skin for a moment before disappearing back.
'Its alright wifey, rather than being here, I would love to spend more time with my wives.'
He thought, sitting with no emotions on his face.
Feeling thousands of eyes focussed on him, his looks had become even better.
So it really wasn't any surprise.
"COUGH"
Shen climbed to the platform, then he made the crowd silent. Thankfully, Vritra's appearance had completely made them forget everything else, so they no longer were mocking anyone.
"Welcome to this grand event, this is very important for us and the Yate family. Well things started a bit rough because of some hindrance, but now let's proceed with this event."
Shen said, looking over all the people.
People started talking among themselves lightly.
"I actually have an important announcement to make. It is related to a marriage between the Ford and Yate family."
As he spoke, the people became even louder, discussing it.
Vritra was looking around, his gaze soon met with Rich who was walking closer to him.
"Hello Art, I am Rich. We had met when we were younger, I heard about your recent return, are you alright?"
Rich paused in front of him and asked with a faint smile.
Vritra nodded and extended his hand, Rich was a friend of his even though the other guy didn't recognise him.
"Yes, I am perfectly fine."
The two shook hands, Rich seemed to have a good opinion of him.
Vritra decided to tell him about his real identity later, there were too many people around.
He could just say he was Art all along or something.
Smiling, he added:
"It seems we are becoming relatives now."
"Yeah, but how strange would it be that a guy younger than me would be becoming my uncle. Sigh, do you mind if I still call you Art?"
Rich questioned, imagining calling him Uncle.
"yeah that's perfectly fine"
Huh wait, what do you mean uncle?"
Just then, Shen made the announcement:
"The important and joyous announcement is that our two families will be becoming in laws. Art Yate will be marrying my sister, Rich's aunt."
Vritra: "..."
Yasmine: "..."

chapters.title: Chapter 523 The Sacrificial Groom
paragraphs: "Art Yates will be marrying my sister, Teresa Ford!!" Shen announced in a loud voice, and instantly silence descended upon the whole place.
Instantly, thousands of gazes full of pity fell over Vritra, and after a few silent seconds, the whole place was full of murmurs.
"That handsome guy is going to marry the witch? Haa poor guy, I guess he is being sacrificed by his family for personal gains."
"Sigh I have even heard she is as ugly as the word could possibly represent, so fragile that she is locked in a room, not allowing anyone near her, fearing that even a touch might kill her."
"Not only that, I heard she is full of physical defects, anyone who stays near her will continue to suffer and even die the most gruesome deaths."
"Tsk tsk I can't believe such a lovely guy would be sacrificed and here I was ready to leave behind my husband and marry him." A woman muttered in disappointment.
'What the hell is going on? I am going to marry Rich and Tiny's aunt?' Vritra was truly surprised by this piece of news.
From the time he had heard about this marriage pact, he thought it was supposed to be the girl named Tiny.
He possessed some knowledge about the Ford family.
Sir Giant's son and daughter in law had died.
But by that time they already had three children, Shen was the oldest while Darius and his sister were born at the same time.
Darius died without ever having married, though Shen married and had two kids, Rich and Tiny.
And the sister remained unmarried, Vritra hadn't really paid her any attention before.
Like many people were mentioning here, there were a lot of rumours spreading about her.
"Hahaha are we getting a new family member? A witch this time?" Yasmine laughed, floating around Vritra.
No one could sense her presence at all.
'Not really, anyway you know anything about her?' Vritra asked, he was sure his wifey was bound to be more knowledgeable than all the people gossiping there.
"Yeah I did hear she was born blind, was really kept locked in a room where no one was allowed to approach her.
Honestly, the Fords have kept most information about her hidden, the rumours you are hearing are probably spread by them which became more absurd the more mouths they crossed."
Yasmine replied, getting serious, she can't allow any harm to fall over her husband after all.
'I see, well whatever might be the case, that giant guy is safe only until I have found the information I need.
Then I will make him feel far worse torment, that helplessness where he is powerless and couldn't protect even the ones he loves.' Vritra thought, masking his anger with an emotionless expression.
"COUGH I can hear you all, please stay quiet!" Shen spoke with suppressed anger.
He hated when people bad mouthed his sister, they did spread a few rumours like her being fragile and bringing bad luck to others just to protect her.
But most of the rumours were born out of nowhere.
"Anyway, because of some unforeseen event, my sister can't come here right now. But I would like to invite my future brother in law, and properly introduce him to you all."
The monarch said while looking towards Vritra.
"Art, go ahead, don't worry. We are all here for you, a and I doubt she is as bad as the rumours make her seem." Ava patted his shoulder, but there was nothing she could do about this.
If the marriage didn't proceed then the entire family would face the god's wrath and most probably all of them would die.
'Well let's just get it over with.' Vritra rolled his eyes and got to his feet.
For a moment, his gaze met with Sir Giant and he barely stopped himself from attacking the old guy, chanting Yennefer's name to keep his calm.
He walked over to the high platform and climbed, stopping beside Shen and facing the large crowd.
"Art Yates, I am happy to turn the friendship between our families into such a close bond. I hope you can take good care of my sister, you see, she is a bit fragile as you already heard." Shen spoke.
Then he added in a low voice that only the two could hear:

"I know you are probably forced into this marriage for your family's sake, but you better not take that anger on my sister, I can accept anything but even a single tear in her eyes. Sigh she is too kind for this world..."
"Oh is that a threat?" Vritra couldn't care less about the woman in question or the marriage itself, but he just didn't like getting threatened by someone so weaker than him.
"Only if you do plan to hurt my sister, physically or mentally, that is. Otherwise we will just be a big happy family. So do you plan to hurt her?" Shen asked, a small smile on his face.
"I don't really hurt women" Vritra was speaking, when he heard his wifey's voice.
"Ouch I still feel sore." She spoke, rubbing her butt. On her milky cheeks, there were clear handprints left by him.
'That's... different.'
"Hmm what about Karen? Hehe I did see you slap her while we were travelling to the White Kingdom." She added.
Sigh...
Vritra knew there was no point quarrelling with his naughty wife.
"I don't hurt women, unless! Unless they go out of their way to annoy me." Vritra completed his sentence.
"I guess that's fine, my sister isn't like any woman you have met in your life. But before the marriage, there are a few things you have to keep in mind."
Shen didn't feel that Vritra was the sort of guy who would really hurt his sister.
And he was a good judge of characters.
"And what are those things?" Vritra asked lazily, still hoping to just be done with all this bullshit.
All the people in the crowd were watching them, wondering what the two were talking about.
"I think Monarch Ford is threatening Art, poor guy is definitely getting forced to do this. Sigh I wish I could save him somehow."
"Is Teresa Ford really that bad?" someone questioned and instantly became the centre of attention.
"Bad is an understatement, that witch is the worst of the worst, a cursed woman. One should stay as far away from her as possible, why do you think she was locked away by her family for?"
"The previous human emperor, Darius, was her brother, both born at the same time. And I heard Darius almost died right at birth."
Ignoring the trash talk about Teresa, Shen gritted his teeth and spoke:

"You are never allowed to touch her, or even be within a few meters of her, she is so fragile that a single touch might kill her..." Shen began to speak, putting so many restrictions that several books could be filled.
It was all, you can't do this, you can't do that.
It really didn't seem like a marriage, more like he was signing himself off as a slave.
And the most this marriage would offer him was getting to see his so called wife from distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 524 Threats
paragraphs: "Do you understand? So, right after marriage, just come here to live with us, that way things will be easier." Shen finished, taking over full twenty minutes.

"Hmm hmm can you repeat? I think I lost you at that single touch, it could do what again?" Vritra asked, the only good thing about this was the thousands of sin points he was collecting by just standing there.
"It's alright, I will later give you the rules book. Make sure you remember all of it."
After speaking, Shen smiled and turned to face the crowd, then patting Vritra's shoulder he spoke: "The marriage will be held one week from now, I invite you all to give your blessings."
After speaking a few more words, Shen asked: "Do you wish to say something as well?"
"..." Vritra pondered and decided to use this chance to stir some trouble and also get sin points.
Cluelessly, he put a finger over his chin, tilted his head and asked: "Um... I can't tell them about the attack we are planning on the other three families after marriage right?"
Shen: "..."
"W- What? They are planning a war against the other top families?"
Vritra had said that out loud, his voice heard by everyone.
"Haha stop joking around, don't take those words seriously. My brother in law loves to joke. We will even be inviting all three families to our special event"
Just as he was speaking, an announcement rang out.
"The Star family has come!"
"The Trant family has come!"
"The Grant family has come!"
The other three families had finally arrived, together, as if waiting for just the perfect moment to make their appearance.

"Oh, are you sure your idiotic brother in law is really just joking? I wouldn't want to turn such a wholesome event into a battlefield." A voice sounded from the entrance, as all heads turned to look back.
The three families were already quite closely connected to one another and used their combined strength to suppress the other two.
The Yate family was already quite weak but the Ford family could be said to be the leading family, so even after getting together, the Star, Trant and Grant families barely opposed them.
Only the monarch of the Star family was a woman, while the monarchs of the Trant and Grant families had quite the robust bodies.
The two strong looking monarchs of the Trant and Grant families were coming along with their children.
Both had several sons and daughters, and it was evident how similar they were to their fathers.
Monarch Trant seemed the type who would think later and attack first, the muscle type who rarely used his brain.
While the Grant monarch seemed the exact opposite, right after stepping into the area, he was on high alert.
They had brought along soldiers and servants, and some gifts as well.
While the monarch of the Star family was yet to marry, and honestly, she was way past the marriage age.
She seemed at the perfect age to retire, and enjoy a life with her grandchildren, except she didn't have any.
The three groups made their way inside, instantly changing the whole atmosphere of the event.
"Go back to your seat and stay close to your father." Shen muttered, whatever might be the case, he had to now protect Art against all threats.
Thankfully, unlike what they had expected, he was quite suited for Teresa.
Sir Giant and others just expected the worst, even ready to break the marriage and face the god's wrath, but now there was no need.
"..." Vritra's appearance attracted the attention of several young ladies who instantly fell for him.
Some kept stealing glances while some were bold enough to ask the monarch to get him for them.
But for now there was some peace.
Soon, it was time to eat. All sorts of dishes flew magically in the air.
Those with higher importance were being served on their seats itself while others would have to go to the left side to eat.
Of course, Vritra and the Yates had the highest privilege.
"Son, are you okay? He didn't threaten you or anything right?" Gunter and Ava both asked with concern.
"Yeah, I am fine." Shrugging his shoulders, he continued to eat.
Many came up to Vritra to congratulate him but it was evident how sorry they all felt.
Some from the other three families came to indirectly mock him for his misfortune.
A couple of hours passed peacefully, many of the guests had already even left the place.
The three monarchs came to congratulate Gunter as well, though it seemed more like a threat.
Vritra decided to do the main thing he was actually here for. After locating Sir Giant, he decided to ask him about Yennefer.
"I will be back in a minute." Vritra excused himself and walked away from the crowd of women who were already head over heels for him.
"Hello, Sir Giant." Vritra called out, as the old guy turned and looked back at him in surprise.
"Art, there is no need for that, we are family now so just call me grandpa." Sir Giant said, he too approved of him.
'But I wonder if he is still as talented as when he was young? What even is his true strength?' he wondered, feeling annoyed that Vritra's strength was hidden by some treasure.
"Okay, I heard you too participated in that war over two years ago." He asked, not displaying any emotions.
"Ah that... yeah, I did participate in that bloody war, doing that might have been the biggest mistake of my life. Anyway, why do you ask?" Sir Giant replied.
His great grandson, Rich, was already quite handsome but Art's charms were off the charts.
'They would look truly good together...'
"I heard Yennefer too participated in the war, but she was never seen again after the war ended. I even heard you were the last person to see her. Do you know where she went?" Vritra questioned.
Sir Giant stared at him for a few moments, hearing that name after a long time, then sighing, he answered.
"No, she only came after Vritra had died, and I left her alone with his corpse. She left with him and just disappeared."
Vritra frowned, this was his only lead and he didn't obtain any information even from here.
This truly made him angry.

'Divine, if you don't tell me something of importance right now, then I will slaughter every single person present here. Then the entire Ford family!' Vritra threatened, of course he wouldn't kill Gunter and Ava but aside from them he would just kill everyone else.
There was silence for a few moments, as energy began to channel throughout Vritra's body in a deadly way.
He was ready to kill all of them.
"Wait, like I said, if you just follow you will" suddenly, the Divine's voice sounded, though it was strained as if he was low on energy.
'Enough of your games, say that one more time and that said bride of mine would be the first to be killed.' Vritra continued.

"...Fine fine, I can just tell you she is safe, you will find her as soon as you meet this said bride of yours. Haa you made me exhaust all my energy, now I won't be here for a while" and he was gone.
Just as Vritra was registering those words, the sky started turning black, and the expressions of all the Fords changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 Unforeseen Event
paragraphs: Just as the divine's voice faded, the sky started to turn dark, the changes were too sudden, taking all the people present by surprise.
Vritra took a look up and he could faintly sense that a vast number of portals were about to open in the sky, though it was quite far away.
'Are we under attack? Who would be attacking, most of the human powers are already here? Is it the dark organizations?' he wondered, and just stood there calmly.
While Sir Giant's expressions changed suddenly, he seemed almost panicked.
Patting Vritra's shoulder, he spoke: "W- Why don't you return to your father's side, I have something important to take care of."
Then he flew away, Shen and a few others from the Ford family followed along.
Vritra didn't move and just continued to observe, beside him, Yasmine who was floating, lying back while facing the sky.
Her head was resting over his shoulder.
"Hubby, are there people already here to crash your wedding?" she asked.
Vritra rolled his eyes, she really seemed to be enjoying the whole marriage drama.
'This Divine is really testing my patience...' Vritra gritted his teeth, but he too couldn't do anything, he didn't know any other way to find Yennefer after all.
He just couldn't understand what exactly Divine wanted from him, but they both needed each other's help.
After a minute, he returned to his seat, the whole place was filled with nervous murmurs.
No one really knew who it was in the sky.
Many guests left in a hurry, the three families wanted to watch a good drama unfold so they stayed.
Many younger and middle aged women would come up to Vritra, hoping to get a chance at him.
After more than thirty minutes had passed, the sky finally started returning to normal.
And soon, Shen and the others landed on the ground, looking a little exhausted.
All sorts of speculation were flowing in the large space, as they momentarily forgot about Vritra's ill fate.
But the members of Ford family didn't tell anything nor did they answer any questions.
After discussing something amongst themselves, Shen once again climbed onto the high platform and announced:
"Because of some unforeseen events, there have been some changes in the plans."
Vritra was already feeling tired of hearing those words, but he listened carefully, who knows when he might get the clue about Yenni.
'Thankfully things are not going to proceed as planned before it seems, so the marriage is being cancelled or delayed?' he hoped.
"The marriage between Art Yates and Teresa Ford will not be happening after a week." Shen said, as many women heaved sighs of relief.
Vritra too would get some extra time this way, and before marriage he just might find Yennefer.
"Sigh What a pity hubby, it isn't everyday that one gets to see their husband getting married to someone else." The poor dragoness sighed pitifully.
Shen continued in the same calm tone:
"Instead the marriage will be held tomorrow, the today's event is over. The guests will be respectfully escorted outside, we have to start the preparations now."
After this new info, everyone fell silent, staring at the monarch in bewilderment.
One week was already too short to prepare for the wedding and now only a day?
"T- That's insane, we can't agree to that." Gunter couldn't take it anymore, following such demands how would it make them look like?
That they couldn't wait to throw their son into misfortune for personal gains.
If it wasn't for that pact then Gunter and Ava wouldn't have even let their son marry some woman who is so much older than him and has such a bad reputation.
"This is not negotiable, if the marriage doesn't happen tomorrow then things might become problematic." Sir Giant intervened.
As the shocked guests were escorted outside, the Ford monarch looked at the three remaining families who wouldn't leave and were waiting for some drama.
"Grant, Trant and Star, why don't you all leave this place peacefully or would you rather challenge our two families?"
Shen said, such things couldn't be discussed in front of outsiders, especially if they are enemies.
"Haa And things were just starting to get good. Won't you even tell us what happened up there?" Monarch Grant asked, getting to his feet.

"Look straight to your left, there, you will find a magical thing. If you step to the other side, you will automatically be outside of our home, so why don't you go play door door with your family?" Shen added, impatiently.
After exchanging unpleasant goodbyes, the three families finally left.
Soon Vritra, Gunter and Ava were inside a room, where Rich, Shen and Sir Giant were also present.
"Tell me, why did you suddenly change the time? It almost feels like..." Gunter paused, not wanting to disrespect the other family or his possible future daughter in law.

"Yeah it does feel like we are throwing Teresa off to you, and Art is already not happy with the marriage. But believe me that isn't the case, I care for my sister more than for my own kids." Shen spoke solemnly.
"But you see, that sudden change earlier, it was a warning of sort.
There are people who don't want this marriage to happen for certain reasons so we have to finish before they arrive here or things might get problematic for both of us." Shen concluded.
"And you can't even explain any of it haa this... I was already feeling guilty by sending my son into this marriage, it makes me feel selfish and a bad father." Gunter frowned.
"It is fine." Vritra interrupted and then he added: "But I won't marry a woman I haven't even seen before."
Divine said he would get a clue the moment he met this woman, so he needed to do just that, marriage wasn't really necessary for it.
"That... Grandpa?" Shen looked at Sir Giant, the other family hadn't put any sort of demand and this was the most basic thing.
Sir Giant pondered for a moment then he asked Rich to go check something.
The young handsome man returned after nearly fifteen minutes, panting lightly.
He replied to Sir Giant, while the old guy's expression remained same.

"... Sorry but meeting her right now might endanger her life, though she will be ready by your marriage tomorrow. You will see her then anyway, and believe me, my little doll is nothing like what rumours say." Sir Giant said seriously.
"Art, what do you think?" Gunter asked, although the family's wellbeing depended on this marriage but he didn't want to force the responsibility on his son.
Especially when Art had been away for so many years, suffering through who knows what, and not receiving anything from the family at all.
"Fine." After a pause, Vritra answered.
"Oh, congratulations hubby." Yasmine whispered near his ear, chuckling and intrigued to see how it all unfolds.
He already had six women, and the dragoness could allow at most two more in his life.
After discussing the arrangements further, the Yates finally left the Ford realm.
The marriage would be held in the night of next day.
"Sigh Why does she have to go through all this? I wonder, if she would have been happier had she been born as a normal human..." Sir Giant muttered, left alone in the room with Shen and Rich.
"I have a feeling that things might change for her soon." Rich said, a rare serious expression appearing on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 526 Supporting Wives
paragraphs: Vritra and the others soon arrived in the Yate realm, still shocked by all the events.
After a talk with him, Gunter and Ava left.
Sitting in his room alone, Vritra pondered the future options. Yasmine was finally out of the book of dimension, she kept hugging and clinging to him to get his attention.
"So wifey, joke aside, what do you think about this situation?" he questioned.
"Hmm this is too sudden and strange but I think it would not be bad if you do go through this marriage." Yasmine nodded.
"Huh? Are you drunk..."
Interrupting him, she kissed his lips and muttered: "Why don't we go meet and tell about this to Mom and others? I am sure they would be a great help."
Vritra stared at her strangely for a few moments then nodded, but he just took her suggestion as a joke.
Even though the dragoness had never objected to any of his relations, she wouldn't so actively want to get another woman in his life.
"Let's go." Sighing, he stood up and walked out. First he decided to inform Gunter about this so he doesn't think that he ran away from fear of the marriage.
"Huh? You are leaving for a while?" He paused, as if understanding something.
"Sigh I understand, just stay hidden for some time. I will do whatever I can to save as many from our family as possib—"
"Wait, I am not running from the marriage, I will be back soon." Vritra said, stopping the monarch.
"Oh okay, tell me if you need anything. Do you want me to send my protectors along with you?" Gunter asked.
"No, I will be fine on my own." After nodding, he turned and walked away, while Gunter couldn't shake the feeling of guilt from his heart.
'If only I can make this right, and let him marry someone he loves, not because he has to fulfil some long formed pact.' Feeling down, he went back into his room, letting his wife console him.
Flying along Yasmine, Vritra sent messages and asked everyone to gather in the City of Charms.
This time, he didn't really enjoy the traveling and quickly arrived in the city.
Fiona, Diana and Maeve too arrived soon.
The five women sat on chairs in front of Vritra, they knew he had something important to tell them.
Though they were already aware about the marriage event with the Ford family.
"What's wrong, honey? You look a little troubled." Vanessa asked, leaning forward and giving a gentle squeeze to his hand.

"Let me explain it to you all." Yasmine decided to break the news, and Vritra allowed her to. After all, she was quite good at handling people and knew how to properly deliver the news so that it wouldn't shock others much—
"Hubby is getting married tomorrow to Teresa Ford." She announced.
Vritra: "..."
All the other four women fell silent, looking between the two in shock.
"Is... that true, darling?" Fiona asked, her eyes already seeming to be full of killing intent.
"Not really, first listen to the whole situation." Vritra then explained everything to them.
"That's fine then honey, you can get married to that girl. You have my support for it." Vanessa was the first to speak.
"Yes dear, it would be nice to have a new sister. We should add a new member in the family every once in a while to keep things light and entertaining." Diana spoke with a faint smile.
"... You can marry her." Fiona spoke, her face not showing any killing intent anymore.
"Yes, I agree to it too." Maeve chimed in.
'What the hell is going on? Are they being sarcastic? They are actually angry right? This has to be an illusion!'
Vritra stood up, doing his best to break the illusion with mental energy but nothing changed.
"See hubby, what did I say? Just marry her." Yasmine added.
"Haa I wasn't here to ask whether I should marry or not to begin with, I was only here to get some sort of plan to find Yenni."
Vritra scratched his head, waiting for any of the women to break the character.
KNOCK KNOCK
Just then, Vritra sensed a familiar presence from outside the door.
"Come in."
Then Onest walked inside, he handed Vritra a glyph and spoke:
"Shitless has gone on some adventure to a nearby temple, he wanted to handle it alone. That temple too belongs to the Golden Moon."
"Okay and what is this for?" Vritra held the communication glyph and waited.
"That monk wanted to tell you something important." Onest answered, appearing just as confused.
Nodding, Vritra inserted some of his mana into the glyph and muttered: "Shitless, are you there?"
"UWAAAAAAH FIRE! I AM FIREEEEEEEE!!"
Suddenly Shitless's screams rang out, after a moment he spoke again:
"Pitiful one, cough I am alright now. Anyway, I approve of the marriage too, go ahead and do— BANG"
There was a loud explosion and then the sound was cut off.
Vritra now was truly on the verge of going berserk.
Nothing was making sense anymore, why was everyone suddenly wanting him to go through the wedding.
"Wifey, swear to me, this isn't some joke from you right? Even bringing Monk Shitless into it?" Vritra asked seriously, he no longer was in any mood to joke.

paragraphs: "That... looks perfect on you, Art, let's go with this outfit." Ava said, excitedly.
Soon all sorts of other things were selected for him, while Gunter was busy selecting gifts and other stuff.
The morning was quite hectic, it seemed the whole Yate realm was busy.
It was decorated quite well, but Ava knew because of whatever Teresa's circumstances are, she can't really touch anyone.
So her son would have to marry or have some concubines later on.
She was sure the Fords wouldn't object to this and even if they did, they would still do it.
"Okay that's all, get all the rest you want, the day ahead will be quite busy."
Soon Vritra was left alone in his room, of course, his dragon waifu floating around like a ghost.
"Sigh" rubbing his temples, Vritra sighed, thankfully he still possessed his old skill Tranquil Mind which kept him calm.
"Yenni, just where have you disappeared off to?" Completely aware that Yennefer was being used to drive him through this line of fate, but Vritra could barely do anything.
He stared at the bracelet on his wrist, still feeling the faint connection with her.
Vritra again tried to use the Null but came out empty handed, just where has she disappeared off that he couldn't find her at all.
Near the entrance of the new Quartz continent, a young man could be seen walking ahead of a group.
His steps were hurried, a big smile on his face, and excitement building with each step.
There were strange symbols over his face which seemed to be made to hide some sort of tattoos.
He looked handsome with long red hair which clearly wasn't his natural hair colour.
"Huff slow down, I can't understand why you are so happy to arrive in this place." One of the guys behind him muttered.
There were three people following him, two guys and one woman, who looked rather dazed.
"Haha of course it is because I can finally meet her again." The guy in the front said, letting out a loud laugh.
"Her? Are you talking about Fiona?" the first guy questioned. He was none other than Rhino.
"Of course, who else could make him that excited?" the other guy shook his head. Others just called him Shorty.
His height was near four feet, and he looked more of a dwarf with his big beard and aged complexion.
Despite being in his early twenties, the guy looked quite older because of a skill of his which changed his physical appearance rather quickly.
The poor guy had the girl he had a crush on call him uncle, and that's how he became a drunkard at such a young age.
The woman was someone Jack had found on his journey after entering the White Kingdom.
She kind of had some special ability but every time she used it, her body turned into nothing more than a walking corpse for a few days.
Jack soon arrived at the gates of the continent and passed through easily.
He was the hero although he had hid the fact after leaving the Dunshire continent, knowing how many would want to do some experiments on them.
Nine Pacts was one such example.
Their teacher, although she had managed to survive after getting rescued by the Golden Moon, was in a very bad condition.
Since her head was severed off, with special skills she was able to get a new body but could barely move it.
Still she was living fine now, with several servants serving her.
But her example was enough to put fear in Jack so he hid his identity and travelled with his friends all over the place.
Many of their classmates had gone on with their new lives, some were even dead, none of them had ever received news about Max.
But the most popular from their class were definitely Vritra and Fiona.

"I can't believe that goddess actually became the human empress, the empress of the entire Quartz continent..." Jack muttered, but it was especially because of this he was sure that he had a big backup in this place.
Vanessa was quite popular as well but Jack or the others didn't think it was actually Vritra's mother who was the succubus empress.
And Fiona, he was sure of it, it was definitely her.
'How did her strength grow so much so quickly?' he ran his fingers through his hair.
To speak the truth, Jack himself had been very lucky, with one opportunity after another falling in his lap.
His strength had skyrocketed after leaving that kingdom where he was humiliated and had the girl he loved stolen.
"Haa the air here is so good, free of that demon." Jack was depressed and heartbroken because of Fiona and Vritra's relation.
But now that Vritra was dead, he clearly had a chance to pursue her again.
And this time he wouldn't be naïve. He would do anything to make her fall for him.
Or so Jack hoped.
BOOOOOM
"Look!! How did that temple explode?" Right after entering, Rhino stepped forward and pointed nearly 500 meters from them.
"Huh? Why is there such a commotion, don't tell me the goddess knew about my arrival through her godly skills and put this grand welcome–"
"FIRE! I AM FIREEEEEE!" Within moments, the group of four saw a bald monk seated over an enormous bull.
His entire body was burning and he was holding two bells in his palms, but instead of suffering any pain, his expression seemed more like... gloating.
"He seems familiar?" Jack scratched his cheek only to wince as pain shot through him.
To hide the tattoos he had to pay a price.
It wasn't just any normal tattoos and most people just laughed at him and refused to remove the tattoos no matter how much money he offered.
They even made rude offers, asking if his mother was still in business like the tattoo said.
Some even asked his own price for a night.
That aside, Jack stood there as he put all his focus and soon remembered seeing this monk once before.
"Right this is the monk I saw peeing over the temple wall– huh? When did he get so close?" Jack was baffled, overconfident in his abilities he didn't really take anything as a challenge.
His level was already above 8th Legion, what was there to be afraid of. He was even sure he would be able to reach the General rank.
But all the others from behind Jack had already run to the side. Shitless muttered something into a glyph tied to a locket.
Right then his expressions shifted, his arms started buzzing and it seemed he was no longer able to contain whatever those burning bells in his hands were.
Without wasting a moment he threw them to the ground, making Bullo jump very high.
Shocked at the turn of events, Jack saw the two bells fall near his feet, but without any fear he just stomped.
His body shot upwards, there was no way he could be that slow–
BANG
But right then, something heavy pressed over his head. Bullo used his head to push itself upwards, hitting Jack's head hard enough to shoot his body back towards the ground.
And then...
BOOOM!!
And that's how the chain of misfortune for the unfortunate hero started, and his ill fated relation with the evil monk.
