chapters.title: Chapter 532 The Grand Wedding
paragraphs: In the Yate realm, most of the people were getting tense since the groom was still missing.
Although Vritra had said that he was going to marry, but hearing the bride's reputation they all felt he might have actually run at the last moment.
"Should we head directly to the Ford realm as Art had told us and wait there for him?" Ava questioned. She was already dressed up and looked quite beautiful, though still a bit weak.
"Haa... if we don't go then how would we look being late even on such an important day? And if we do go, what are we even going to do when the groom himself isn't present..."
Gunter, in the end, decided to wait a little longer.
Everything was already ready, they had prepared as much as possible in this short span of time.
"Haa... not even an hour is left, where has he disappeared off to?" Gunter was walking around the corridor, various thoughts swirling in his mind.
Finally, a figure flashed at the other end of the corridor as Vritra made his way towards the nervous group.
"Oh you are finally back!!" Gunter exclaimed happily, then urged: "Hurry up and get ready, we are leaving, we shouldn't be late on such an important day."
"Okay." Vritra nodded and went into his room where all his clothes were already arranged. He refused to let the maids help him get ready.
Throwing the clothes in his inventory, he just made Goop copy them and within seconds he was ready.
Goop truly was awesome. Whether it be defence, attack or transforming into outfits for him, it could do an excellent job at anything.
"Wifey, how do I look?" Vritra turned and looked at Yasmine who was standing behind him.
"Too tempting..." Yasmine couldn't speak her thoughts out as she stared enchantedly at her husband.
Now that she thought about it, none of his women had a proper ceremony with him yet, and it seemed Teresa might be the first to have it.
'How unfair, but still I am the first wife.' Yasmine consoled herself. Everything aside, she just couldn't tear her gaze away from him.
"That's good then, let's go." Vritra walked out of the room and the reactions all the others showed were more dramatic than the dragoness.
Especially the women. They fell into dreamland, even imagining living with the man of their dreams.
But several hearts were broken as they remembered that this person was soon going to be married.
'How unfortunate...' all had the same thought. That woman was way too lucky.
"Art, you look fabulous. Heh, my son is going to break so many hearts today." Ava chuckled. She gave him a paper charm to keep all negative energy away.
"It's time to leave, thankfully we won't be late." Gunter heaved a sigh of relief as the group of Yate family members walked out of the building.
Large numbers of vehicles were waiting for them, all decorated beautifully. A few were only to carry gifts and stuff.
Vritra, Ava and Gunter sat in one of the vehicles, of course the dragoness was there too, sitting over her husband's lap.
On the other side, in the Ford realm.
The place looked far more beautiful than the previous day, they had spent a vast amount of money on it; especially since the time was too short.
Guests were entering, bringing gifts along.
Sir Giant and Rich stood at the entrance to welcome the guests and wait for the groom and his family.
"Great Grandpa, don't tell me they are going to be late again..." Rich muttered. There wasn't much time before the assigned time.
The wedding could be stretched a bit ahead in time but still, it left a bad impression about the Yates.
"There is still time, I am sure they will be here soon." Sir Giant replied, but more than that he was worried about something else.
The creatures who had left a warning the previous day would never have let the wedding continue normally.
Which was why they had shifted the wedding and hoped to finish it before they could even get here.
Once the marriage was done, everything should be fine.
'We need to hurry up...' Sir Giant rubbed his palms nervously, while smiling and welcoming the guests.
The security was tight, all the Ford strongest warriors managing the place, and they had even called many vagabonds.
Even though there was just one day to prepare, the wedding was quite grand nonetheless.
Even the other three big families were already here along with many other powerful beings and organizations.
"Oh they are here!" Sir Giant soon sensed the approaching fleet of vehicles. He finally relaxed a bit and gave a few commands to the servants.
The Yate family was already inside the Ford realm, they soon got close to the wedding hall.
Instantly the sky was lit with beautiful fireworks; they had prepared for the grand welcome.
Vritra, seated inside, gazed out of the window.
There were even more people in the wedding than the previous day's event, but before that he wasn't even sure about the customs of marriage among humans here.
'Wifey, how different is it from back on earth?' he questioned as their vehicles got welcomed by rain of flowers and all sorts of other things.
"Not that much different, it is rather simple. You see, the heroes that were summoned had changed a lot of customs, marriage is one of them.
Though I guess you won't be kissing your bride, or it might just become the kiss of death for her." Yasmine spoke with a chuckle. She didn't exactly know what Teresa's condition was though.
The Fords were being quite respectful towards them.
The vehicles drove into the hall and parked to the side. Sir Giant and Rich hurriedly came to welcome them personally.
Rich enthusiastically shook hands with him. For some reason, Rich felt as if he was meeting an old friend.
"Art, you look dashing. You actually remind me of someone... anyway, tell me if there is anything you need." Rich said with a big smile.
"Thanks." Vritra nodded and took in the sight of the venue.
"Bring the gifts inside." Gunter said as the various servants started taking them off the vehicles and bringing them all into the wedding hall.
"Come this way." Sir Giant led them inside after sharing pleasantries. Vritra would be called onto the altar later on as the rituals started.
For now, they were brought into a rather luxurious room with various things arranged there for them.
Most of the Yates went into the wedding hall, only the three went into the room.
"The preparations are done so well. I was a bit worried because of the lack of time but you have clearly done a very good job." Ava spoke as she sat down over a comfortable sofa.
"Thank you, aunty—" Rich said, but then Ava's son was her uncle in relation.
But he just decided to keep things like before.
The Fords were in a hurry so before long the wedding ritual started.
First Shen welcomed everyone and spoke a few heartfelt lines and finally invited the Priest to start the wedding.
Vritra sat there while scratching his forehead. Was he ever even going to see the bride?
What even was the point of marriage?
Now he started to question the hidden meaning behind this marriage, there was definitely some motive.

One was Sir Giant, the old guy, walking beside his granddaughter.
He was walking around a meter away from her, gazing at Teresa with an adoring expression while also being careful of any danger.
'So how long has it been since she stepped out?' Vritra wondered. It seemed she really was so weak that a touch might kill her.
Otherwise, Sir Giant wouldn't be acting like that.
Teresa was wearing a beautiful white dress, but it was all that was visible.
From head to toe she was completely covered. Her arms were covered by long white gloves, her face covered by a veil.
Even her eyes weren't visible.
But there were rumours that she was blind, and that too got verified soon...
"Be careful, there are stairs ahead." Sir Giant said. After a pause, the bride slowly climbed the stairs.
And finally stepped onto the altar.
'What the hell is this?' Vritra really felt like cursing out loud. What sort of marriage was this?
Didn't they tell him he would get to see her during the marriage? Absolutely nothing was visible; the dress was slightly loose so even her figure wasn't clear.
'Well at least she isn't a monster or twisted as the rumours say.' She was as tall as Yasmine and might even be older.
Her strength too was at the Lord rank, but he didn't feel that level of strength from her.
Sir Giant paused near the stair, standing there defensively for any sort of change.
"Please stand over this board, uh yeah... just two steps ahead." The priest said.
'So she is blind?' Vritra wondered. The dress was specially made to stop anyone from seeing her real appearance.
Though Vritra could easily see through, in the end he didn't.
Her dress stretched nearly a meter behind her. Despite being completely covered, she looked quite graceful.

sentences.text: 'If she marries me, does it change something?' Vritra wondered, but there was no way to know.
They were hurrying it so much and acting as if as long as the marriage completed, things would be fine.
'Or maybe, like it was with wifey, we kind of form some eternal bond or something...'
He turned to Rich and asked: "Rich, where is your aunt?"
"Oh uhm, she is getting ready." He replied after a brief pause.
"I see, so I suppose the events from the previous day were because of her.
Does someone want to take her away?
And you hurrying the wedding, just getting married changes things?" Vritra continued with his questions.
Sir Giant listened from the side and was impressed.
'Quite observant and smart, not bad, but it would be great if he has the talent and strength to match it.' Sir Giant thought, but now he couldn't worry about that.
"...Yeah, there was some trouble but it isn't much.
You will know everything after you two are married anyway." Rich said with a troubled expression.
He couldn't disclose anything.
Or it might put his aunt in danger.
"..." Vritra remained silent.
He knew there was no chance of getting any real answer, but from the reply, it seemed he was correct.
'What can those other people want that could be obtained by marriag—'
Vritra's thoughts were interrupted as a maid arrived in the room and informed:
"Sir, the groom will soon be called to the altar."
"Alright, you may leave." Sir Giant said.
After talking a bit more, the men left, leaving the three alone.
"What's wrong, Art?" Ava asked with worry, seeing the pondering expression.
"It's nothing." He shook his head.
Outside in the enormous hall, the priest stood in white robes over the altar, holding a book in his hands.
"Art Yate, the groom will now be arriving here." The priest muttered.
He was an aged man, appearing to be in his seventies.
He had lived far longer though, and was the priest in most of the biggest Ford marriages.
Among the vast number of guests, some were genuinely happy while others had ulterior motives.
Especially the three families: the Grant, the Trant, and the Star, who were all searching for a way to cause chaos.
But they couldn't do much unless an opportunity arrived.
The eyes of all the guests shifted back as three figures started walking towards the altar.
It was the groom, his mother and his father, walking on either side.
"Whoa, t- that is Art Yate?
He is so handsome..." The ones who hadn't seen him yesterday were the most shocked, but even the ones who had seen him were dazed.
Soon murmurs about Vritra filled the whole place, and again pity rained down on him for marrying some witch or monster.
Vritra walked casually.
He could also faintly feel killing intent coming from different sides.
It was especially from the men whose wives were acting too strange, and also from the three families.
'Oh well, this feels so strange...'
Vritra ignored the murmurs and soon arrived at the altar.
Then Ava and Gunter moved towards their seats, while he climbed up.
Standing beside the priest, he gazed over the large crowd, patiently waiting for the moment of decision.
The priest continued to speak different things.
Vritra ignored most of them.
He was made to put a cloth over his shoulder, hold a glass full of wine, and step onto a metallic board.
The same metallic board was present in front of him, which was probably for the bride.
"Please put a drop of your blood inside it?" the priest said, making Vritra frown.
Then he questioned:
"And what will happen with this wine?"
"You both will be giving your glass to one another and drinking it." The priest explained calmly.
'Is this normal?
Isn't it just like my marriage with you?
Will it even be safe for her?' he wondered.
"Normal... among humans, some do it.
Yeah, it might be more deep than a normal marriage it seems.
And yes, it should be safe." Yasmine shrugged, unsure herself.
But he had to go through with the marriage.
"Hmm..." He nodded but waited.
He was yet to completely agree to the marriage, so he waited for the bride to arrive.
"...Do it." The old priest said with a smile, urging him.
"Aren't you going to call the bride?" Vritra asked.
"She will only arrive after completing a couple more rituals, so do it." The priest replied.
Sigh...
Vritra brought the tip of his finger on top of the glass, then used Null to pull out a drop of his blood.
The colour of his blood was rather difficult to make out; it was like a mess of colours.
But using the Misty Essence, he made it appear red.
TIK
The blood drop fell into the wine and soon mixed in.
The drink remained colourless.
The priest continued to instruct him about a few more things, and Vritra could only follow along.
"It is time to call the bride." The priest's loud voice reverberated.
Everyone's ears perked up.
They were all quite curious to see this witch about whom they had only heard rumours.
Just how grotesque, cursed and weak could a woman be to have such a reputation and be locked by her own family.
They had heard that anyone close to her suffered through one misfortune after another.

Shen and all the others were completely focused.
This moment was of utmost importance.

chapters.title: Chapter 534 The Stealer of Fate
paragraphs: Teresa stepped onto the metallic board, her hands clasped together.
Completely covered, it was really hard to know anything about her. All the eyes in the large hall were fixed on her.
All the people were disappointed. Many tried to use their senses to look, but none succeeded.
In the end, Vritra couldn't hold back his curiosity. Trying to see how monstrous his bride looked, he attempted to look through her veil.
But...

'What? Even I can't see through it? What sort of treasure is this that can even stop a demi god? Or maybe it is done by someone...' he wondered. There was little chance of the Ford family having such a treasure.
The gods probably wouldn't be protecting her, and there was just one being who might be behind it.
'Divine? Why would he do this though? Why is he going out of his way to make me go through this marriage?' Vritra wondered, while the priest began to instruct.
A tray floated before Teresa, a similar glass of wine placed on top of it.
No one came closer to her. Even the priest stood at more than two hands' width.
Her drop of blood was already in the drink. The priest then continued with further rituals.

"First, both of you bow toward one another and always respect and cherish each other in good and bad times," the priest said, while sprinkling some sort of liquid around them in a circle, as if cutting the two off from the world.
Vritra was still deep in thought as he leaned forward slightly before straightening up, though Teresa bowed by nearly thirty to forty degrees.
"Haa, look at that poor boy. It seems he has lost his soul. If that woman wasn't so bad, then why would her family cover her up and keep their distance from her?"
"Yeah, it seems she is really plagued or cursed."
Tiny and her mother weren't present at the event, since the two were busy with some other important task.
After all, the marriage trials of Tiny were about to start.
The priest ignored Vritra's half hearted bow and continued.
While the rituals went on, Vritra suddenly thought of something.
'Divine is using Yenni as my weakness, but don't I also have...' His gaze locked onto his bride and his lips curled up.
"Heh haha." He couldn't help but chuckle lightly, while the audience wondered if he was finally going crazy.

'Divine, she is just an arm's length from me. You are using Yenni to force me into this, and I don't like just following other people's schemes. How about I just snap her neck? Will you still stay silent?'
Raising his left arm, Vritra extended it toward Teresa slowly.
Sir Giant, Shen, Rich, and the others were startled, seeing his hand approach Teresa.
They all expected Vritra to be unhappy with the marriage, but didn't think that he would try to harm her.
All of them were aware that a single touch might result in death or something far worse.
They straightened instantly, killing intent filling the hall.
Shen was closest to the group, standing nearby to protect his sister in case of emergency.
In an instant, he arrived behind Vritra, striking with force enough to at least break his arm.
Vritra's hand was midway, but more than the Fords, someone else was worried.
"Fine, wait, wait!" Divine's hurried voice sounded.
Vritra smiled faintly as his hand suddenly moved closer to Teresa, but instead of touching her, he caught a knife just inches away from her.
The knife had been thrown by none other than a member of the Ford family. Of course, it was all part of Vritra's plan.
Psyche silently disappeared from the shadow of the man, who looked more panicked than anyone else at the venue.
Wondering why his body had suddenly moved, the man had actually come with a motive, but it wasn't killing the bride.
He belonged to the Bone Blood Cult, and Vritra recognized him since he was yet another clone of that bandaged man.
He wasn't someone who would fall for the same trick twice, no matter how perfect it might be.
Thousands of gasps sounded as everyone saw the knife. Shen panicked and hurriedly stopped his arm, almost touching Vritra's arm.
For a moment, the world seemed to pause.
"Alright, tell me what you have to say now. Is she also a part of your future plan?" Vritra questioned, freezing time.
"Haa, no she isn't. For Yennefer's sake, can't you just go along with it?" Divine asked helplessly.
"Hah, no. You'd better explain everything to me properly, then I will make my decision," Vritra said, toying with the knife.
He was sure that if this woman was important to Divine, then there was no way he could kill her. He couldn't even peek at her appearance. It really was Divine behind it all.
"Fine. She is my... sister," Divine answered. He too needed Vritra's help later on, so it wasn't good to be on bad terms with him.
Not to mention, he had already invested far too much in him. There was no other option now.
"Your sister?" Vritra was genuinely surprised. Then he added, "Continue."
Suddenly, the scene around Vritra changed, and he was once again seeing the images he had seen while his new body was being constructed.
It was the time when Divine was summoned to this planet.
Vritra hadn't been able to see it before, but now he could clearly see that with the young Divine, there were two women.
He had two sisters.
Divine was strong, but the abilities his sisters possessed were far more powerful.
They had been able to pass the trials even though the hero at that time had died.
But one of his sisters had the ability to steal, alter, or completely rewrite fate.
After clearing the trial, they were thrown into extremely dangerous games. Yet together, the three continued to grow stronger.
Divine even had a good friendship with the first mythic halo, the Halo of Creation. Although the two weren't bonded, he could still use it.
Then suddenly, Vritra saw the scene where Divine was killed by that very mythic halo.
Yet his sisters sacrificed themselves to protect him.
One sister stole his fate and rewrote it before her death.
The other sister possessed two abilities. One was a soul type ability that allowed her to make any dead being into her servant.
The second ability was so destructive that, despite being far from a god, she had managed to bring one onto the brink of death.
But that cost the second sister her life as well.
'So the first sister is Teresa?' Now it was making more sense.
She was the Stealer of Fate, the witch.
'I think I have heard that name somewhere before...' Vritra couldn't help but wonder.
Like Divine had said, he needed to steal the hero's fate from Jack, so he might need her help.
'Oh right, I remember now. I once got a crown that increased my luck while I was doing those games.'
That treasure had helped him obtain many precious skills and objects.
Skills like Lost, Titan Fall, and so on.
That crown was created by the Witch, the Stealer of Fate.

chapters.title: Chapter 535 The Red Wedding
paragraphs: 'I see...' Vritra nodded as more and more things were making sense now, but the scenes didn't end.
Darius and Teresa were born at the same time, and she had actually stolen the ill fate of her brother.
Which is why she was born blind, when it should have been Darius.
'No wonder why everyone acts as if one touch is enough to kill her.'
"My sister, Teresa, is the kindest soul. Any pain or suffering, she would rather go through it herself than let it happen to others." Divine's voice sounded again, full of tenderness and pity.
Vritra focused on the moving images, the second sister who injured one of the gods heavily and almost sent him into an eternal slumber.
Her body and soul separated, and the next scenes shocked Vritra even more.
Both her body and soul transformed into two mythic halos. One was the demonic Veyll mythic halo, which was supposed to be the most destructive.
While the other was the Nihil Anima mythic halo, with the ability to turn the souls of the dead into soul wraiths.
"W- What?" Vritra had no words for it. Then the battle between the two mythic halos, was it just a normal challenge or was there more to it too?
Yasmine had told him that Nihil Anima was so weakened because of its war against the demonic Veyll, where one of the demon gods too had joined.
That was truly too much information. Vritra couldn't help but question: "Teresa is your first sister, then what about your second sister? Did she get reincarnated too?"
"That's not important right now, so tell me what your decision is. You will marry her, right?" Divine asked, his tone emotional, and before Vritra could reply he added:
"You know, while you were away, I even protected your wife, Fiona, once.
Otherwise, do you think with her strength at that time she would have been able to subdue the 4th mythic halo, the undead, all by herself?"
Vritra remained silent for a few moments. He too felt that just based on luck, Fiona couldn't have taken that mythic halo.
So Divine had helped her.
Thinking all this through and hearing that story, Vritra made his choice.
"I am not demanding too much of you, just marry her. You can do that much, right?" Divine asked again, his tone still emotional.
"...Sigh, I understand, and my answer is still no." Vritra said, as if he would fall for that.
"Tch. Fine. If you marry her, I will tell you Yennefer's location." Divine made his final offer.
"Hmm. Alright, but what if someone else breaks this marriage?" Vritra asked.
"I will tell you about it as long as you aren't the one to break the marriage." Divine added, rolling his eyes.
Vritra nodded as time finally started moving again.
The clone standing among the Fords took a startled step back while Shen remained frozen, Vritra's hand stretched out, holding the knife.
"An ambush?" Sir Giant was the first to react this time. His body buzzed and in the next moment he disappeared along with the clone.
"A- Ah, you were stopping that knife?" Shen awkwardly pulled his arm back. He had almost broken the arm of his future brother in law.
Meanwhile, Teresa just stood there, unmoving.
"Huh?" Vritra's expression changed as he turned and looked at Shen.
"You... you were trying to break my arm? So this is the trust and respect you have for me? If you hate me so much then why don't you cancel this wedding?" he spoke, an expression of hurt on his face.
"N- No, this is a misunderstanding. I didn't mean to..." Shen was at a loss for words. Everyone had clearly seen him trying to attack Vritra.
"Shen, how dare you!!" Gunter rose to his feet, barely stopping himself from attacking Shen.
"Why don't we just continue with the marriage? I- I will personally punish that criminal-"
SLAP
"Hmph. As if things can go like this. You know how scared I was?" Vritra said, giving a hard slap on Shen's face, then another.
SLAP
'Heh, slapping the monarch in front of all these people. I am sure he definitely won't let me marry his sister.' Vritra thought.
One big reason behind his rejection to marry Teresa was that he wanted to get on a equal footing with the Divine, get more information out of him.
What would the gods do if they were to know she was Divine's sister?
All the guests were in a constant state of shock. First the ambush on the bride, then the attack on the groom, and now this.
"Yes, it was all my fault. Forgive me..." Shen tilted his head down. Vritra was his brother in law now, so he didn't mind the slaps.
"Yo-" But just as Vritra was about to beat him up more, the color of the sky changed.
Everything was covered by a layer of darkness as hundreds of portals started forming in the sky.
"Damnit, not now." Sir Giant and Shen both had the same reaction.
"P- Priest, hurry up with the rituals. Finish the marriage." Shen shouted as Sir Giant flew up to delay it.
'Perfect timing.' Vritra almost laughed out loud. He had a score to settle with this family anyway.
Shen was about to fly up too when suddenly Vritra clutched his hair and jerked his head back.
"Where are you going? You think you can attack me and run? Your family sure has good manners."
Vritra remembered lines from some drama. He really wished Shitless was here too.
'What? How is he so strong?' Shen was actually shocked, but he spoke:
"I will properly apologize to you later. This matter is urgent, please let me deal with that first."
"Okay, go ahead then. I am not as low as you." Vritra let go, as Shen combed his disheveled hair with his fingers before flying away.
Many in the crowd were baffled, but there were also some who were enjoying the show.
Just as the two had started to stop the portals, Vritra instead increased the speed.
"Now, pass your glasses to one another and drink it." The priest said hurriedly.
Teresa gently put the glass over the floating tray. Vritra wondered what might be going through her mind right now.
Was she even happy with the marriage? Or like Vritra, was she too forced because of the situation?
'Sigh, it doesn't feel like I can break this marriage...' Vritra knew that it was inevitable, but if he was really going to marry here, then it shouldn't be so quiet.
There should be battles, bloodshed. The marriage should be more exciting.
Vritra too placed his glass over the tray. The two exchanged glasses, each other's glasses stopping before them.
They picked them up as the priest urged them to drink.
With his help, hundreds of portals manifested much faster, and within moments, hundreds of figures rushed out of them.
The sky was filled with a few thousand figures. It was a race Vritra was seeing for the first time.
It was people from the Sea race.
Their physiques were similar to humans but had scales over their bodies, and their faces resembled fish more than humans.
"STOP!! This marriage will not be happening. We are here to take the bride." One of the men, wearing quite a bit of jewelry, stepped forward and announced.
He was the king of his tribe and planned to take Teresa away at any cost.

"I will tell you about it as long as you aren't the one to break the marriage." Divine added, rolling his eyes.
Vritra nodded as time finally started moving again.
The clone standing among the Fords took a startled step back while Shen remained frozen, Vritra's hand stretched out, holding the knife.
"An ambush?" Sir Giant was the first to react this time.
His body buzzed and in the next moment he disappeared along with the clone.
"A- Ah, you were stopping that knife?" Shen awkwardly pulled his arm back.
He had almost broken the arm of his future brother in law.
Meanwhile, Teresa just stood there, unmoving.
"Huh?" Vritra's expression changed as he turned and looked at Shen.
"You... you were trying to break my arm?
So this is the trust and respect you have for me?
If you hate me so much then why don't you cancel this wedding?" he spoke, an expression of hurt on his face.
"N- No, this is a misunderstanding.
I didn't mean to..." Shen was at a loss for words.
Everyone had clearly seen him trying to attack Vritra.
"Shen, how dare you!!" Gunter rose to his feet, barely stopping himself from attacking Shen.
"Why don't we just continue with the marriage?
I- I will personally punish that criminal-"
SLAP
"Hmph.
As if things can go like this.
You know how scared I was?" Vritra said, giving a hard slap on Shen's face, then another.
SLAP
'Heh, slapping the monarch in front of all these people.
I am sure he definitely won't let me marry his sister.' Vritra thought.
One big reason behind his rejection to marry Teresa was that he wanted to get on a equal footing with the Divine, get more information out of him.
What would the gods do if they were to know she was Divine's sister?
All the guests were in a constant state of shock.
First the ambush on the bride, then the attack on the groom, and now this.
"Yes, it was all my fault.
Forgive me..." Shen tilted his head down.
Vritra was his brother in law now, so he didn't mind the slaps.
"Yo-" But just as Vritra was about to beat him up more, the color of the sky changed.
Everything was covered by a layer of darkness as hundreds of portals started forming in the sky.
"Damnit, not now." Sir Giant and Shen both had the same reaction.
"P- Priest, hurry up with the rituals.
Finish the marriage." Shen shouted as Sir Giant flew up to delay it.
'Perfect timing.' Vritra almost laughed out loud.
He had a score to settle with this family anyway.
Shen was about to fly up too when suddenly Vritra clutched his hair and jerked his head back.
"Where are you going?
You think you can attack me and run?
Your family sure has good manners."
Vritra remembered lines from some drama.
He really wished Shitless was here too.
'What?
How is he so strong?' Shen was actually shocked, but he spoke:
"I will properly apologize to you later.
This matter is urgent, please let me deal with that first."
"Okay, go ahead then.
I am not as low as you." Vritra let go, as Shen combed his disheveled hair with his fingers before flying away.
Many in the crowd were baffled, but there were also some who were enjoying the show.
Just as the two had started to stop the portals, Vritra instead increased the speed.
"Now, pass your glasses to one another and drink it." The priest said hurriedly.
Teresa gently put the glass over the floating tray.
Vritra wondered what might be going through her mind right now.
Was she even happy with the marriage?
Or like Vritra, was she too forced because of the situation?
'Sigh, it doesn't feel like I can break this marriage...' Vritra knew that it was inevitable, but if he was really going to marry here, then it shouldn't be so quiet.
There should be battles, bloodshed.
The marriage should be more exciting.
Vritra too placed his glass over the tray.
The two exchanged glasses, each other's glasses stopping before them.
They picked them up as the priest urged them to drink.
With his help, hundreds of portals manifested much faster, and within moments, hundreds of figures rushed out of them.
The sky was filled with a few thousand figures.
It was a race Vritra was seeing for the first time.
It was people from the Sea race.
Their physiques were similar to humans but had scales over their bodies, and their faces resembled fish more than humans.
"STOP!!
This marriage will not be happening.
We are here to take the bride." One of the men, wearing quite a bit of jewelry, stepped forward and announced.
He was the king of his tribe and planned to take Teresa away at any cost.

chapters.title: Chapter 536 Bigshots
paragraphs: "Tyler, how dare you barge into my home!!" Sir Giant roared, stopping before the king of the fishmen.
"Hadn't I already warned you several times before, and you still dared to try and marry your son to my granddaughter, and now you bring your army here?"
Tyler, the king of his tribe, had brought over three thousand men into the Ford realm.
He would go all out if he needed to, just to protect the life of his son.

"You damned bug, I shouldn't have spared you all those years ago. It seems I am getting another chance at correcting my mistake." Sir Giant's body was covered by a deadly presence, his killing intent surging.
Everyone on the ground panicked. Who would have thought things could escalate so fast?
The Trant, Grant, Star, and a few others laughed heartily. This was exactly what they wanted. Now that the chance was here, how could they not join in the fun?
"Hmm, so that's the human you have found for her? Hah, you think any useless human is better than my son?" Tyler laughed out loud.
"That's not for you to decide. Are you sure you want to do this?" Sir Giant calmed himself down, though the killing intent only increased.
Vritra created several barriers around Teresa. He couldn't let her get hurt.
And he had already accepted the marriage. This seemed to be the best option. Not to mention, feelings could develop even after marriage, just like in the case of Yasmine.
After Vritra was sure of her safety, he put the glass back onto the tray and spoke, "My bride, wait a bit for me."
Teresa's grip tightened on her glass. This was probably the first reaction she had displayed.
He even placed Psyche near Teresa, just in case.
But just as he was about to fly up, the priest stopped him. "Wait, you can't step off this until the marriage is complete, or the wedding can't be held today."
"Tsk, guess I can't beat them up until the marriage is complete." Vritra sighed and said, "Fine, let's finish the ritual first."
He picked the glass back up, and the bride and groom raised their glasses to drink the wine.
Teresa did so beneath her veil.
In the sky, Tyler was shaking with rage. He knew that if they really started fighting, most of the army he had brought would be dead.
On top of that, they couldn't break through the Ford defenses, and by the time the battle ended, Teresa would already be married.
So he would have to use the guests to create chaos. Though he would need to reveal a secret for that, it would be worth it.
"STOP!!" Tyler shouted before looking at the guests, especially the Ford family's enemies, and spoke,
"You have heard a lot of rumors about Teresa Ford, but none of you really know her."
Sir Giant's body trembled with rage. Aware of this fishman's plan, he attacked to interrupt him.
But Tyler dodged and moved back before continuing,
"Haha, Teresa Ford is none other than the Stealer of Fate!!"
Right after the announcement, there was complete silence. Vritra and Teresa paused, holding the glasses midway.
"Why is everyone reacting like this?" he wondered.
"She is the Stealer of Fate?!!" Even Yasmine exclaimed in shock.
"What about it?" Vritra was confused. Her ability was quite powerful, but their reaction was completely off.
"The witch, Stealer of Fate, is famous for more than one thing," Yasmine began explaining.

"Aside from her obvious ability to steal fates, she is a very powerful sorceress who can create extremely precious treasures. Remember that crown which could increase luck? She could create objects that even Lords would fight to obtain." After a brief pause, she added,
"And finally, she is the rank one holder of the most beautiful women to ever exist. Hmm, no wonder they covered her up so well. Even in that dream, I couldn't see her appearance clearly."
"Oh." Now it was Vritra's turn to be surprised.
On the other side, Tyler knew people wouldn't just believe him. He also had evidence.
"See, this is Teresa Ford's true appearance!" After shouting, he threw up a glyph, which exploded into countless colors and then formed an image in the sky.
The faint image of a woman appeared in the next moment. It was slightly blurry, and only a light glimpse was visible.
Yet everyone among the guests was mesmerized. Whether or not this was real, the risk was worth it if they could get her.
Their minds were completely clouded.
Tyler's son was fortunate, or perhaps unfortunate, enough to once see a glimpse of her. He hadn't even seen half of her face.
Yet right after that, he went mad, wanting her at any cost.
"And if the information I got is correct, anyone who marries her will be able to partially use her ability to steal someone else's fate."
How could Tyler not want such an amazing woman? In name, it was for his son, but he could get countless sons. There was only one witch.
"This is why you always kept her hidden?!!" The Grant Monarch jumped to his feet, a big grin on his face.
"Now that we think about it, this groom is in no way the right match for her. Aside from his looks, what's good about him?" the Trant Monarch laughed. He too would participate in this battle now.
"Oh my god, she is the Stealer of Fate!! How can someone like him be qualified to marry her?"
"Yeah, he is just from the sinking Yate family. I can't believe he almost married her. Compared to Teresa Ford, he is trash."
Instantly, more and more people started throwing insults at Vritra, fueled by jealousy.
"Oh boy, would you look at that." Vritra chuckled. It truly felt like he had become part of some Chinese drama.
But Yasmine felt extremely angry. She couldn't listen to anyone badmouthing her husband.
First, she scanned the crowd, memorizing the faces of everyone who had spoken, then flew away.
Suddenly, almost all the guests wanted to remove him, and the battle in the sky began.
Sir Giant, Shen, and others started fighting against the fishmen race.
Gunter stood before the altar and engaged in battle against one of the Lords who tried to attack Vritra.
That single glimpse had sent most guests into a frenzy. They were all looking at him now.
Vritra shook his head. He wanted to join in the fun too, but for that, he needed to complete the rituals first.
"Ms. Bride, cheers." Once again, Vritra and Teresa were about to drink when someone announced,
"T- There are more guests!!"
Sir Giant felt like pulling his hair out.
"Who is it now, damn it? What trouble is brewing now?"
"The Empress of the Phoenix Race, Fiona Arclis, is here!" the same person announced as everyone gasped in surprise.
Why would she be here?
The Fords, or rather all five families, were powerful, but they were still part of the human race. Fiona, however, ruled over the entire Phoenix Race, which had many Lords.
Sir Giant had sent the invitation, but he knew they wouldn't come to such a small event.
Soon, a beautiful redhead became visible, entering the hall with a large army following behind.
Then another announcement rang out,
"T- The Empress of the H- Human Race, Diana Arclis, is here!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 537 Face Slapping
paragraphs: Fiona was the first to enter the hall along with a big army, with at least a couple thousand warriors, consisting of a few lords.
Just as the big group had walked midway towards Vritra, another woman entered.
This time it was the goddess, the human empress. Her army was just as big and powerful.
All the humans paused, they had to show respect towards their empress, fully aware of how dangerous she could be.
"Why would these t- two be here?!" Seeing such powerful forces, all the people couldn't help but take a fearful step back.
Even the five families and the battle in the sky paused.
But then...
"Empress of the Succubus Race, Vanessa Arclis has arrived." Another shocking announcement rang out, people felt their hearts palpitate.
Now Vanessa entered, with a big army as well. Despite the fear, the people couldn't help but be shocked by their appearance.
Each of them looked so beautiful, if Teresa didn't exist, they could all easily claim the first position.
"T- Three empresses?! Why would they even come to such a place, a- are they here to get the Stealer of Fate as well? Yeah, that must be it!" someone exclaimed.
After all, the witch was quite a powerful sorceress, and her inventions could easily become world treasures.
"Empress of the Dragon Race, Yasmine Arclis is here!!"
Before they could get over the shock, another announcement rang out, and this time many people truly fell to their knees.
Just recently they had heard that the Dragon Empress had returned, so it really was true.
Everyone knew how dangerous she could be, not to mention the strength of the entire Dragon Race.
"Sigh, am I dreaming? What sort of wedding is this?! D- Don't tell me there is going to be another war like before, are we going to die?"
Yasmine's presence, just like the other women, instantly brought pressure over the entire hall.
The most shocked were Sir Giant, Shen, and the Ford family. They had sent invitations to all the important and powerful people.
But they knew that people of that level wouldn't come.
They were just one powerful family in the human race, but those were on just another level.
"B- But why are they all using the same surname? Arclis... I think I have heard that somewhere."
"Yeah, it isn't too common of a surname. Oh wait, Vritra Arclis, wasn't that the surname of that demon?"
"So they are somehow related to him, hmm I doubt they would publicly show their relation if that was the case."
Yasmine too entered the place, bringing around a thousand dragons along. That would be enough to paint the hall red if she wished.
"T- The leader of the World Information Centre, Maeve Arclis is here!"
And finally, the last announcement rang out, people gasped yet again.
Although this organization couldn't yet be compared to other powerful races, it was easily as powerful as one of the five families.
"She too, Arclis... are they all from the same family?"
Finally, Maeve entered the hall, a couple thousand men following behind her, wearing robes that completely hid their appearances.
All five of the women walked towards the altar amidst the deadly silence, their armies stopped mid hall and spread throughout.
Vritra was a bit surprised by their dramatic entrances, but he wished Yennefer was here too.
'It's fine, I will find her really soon, I just need to finish the marriage.' Vritra thought.
Fiona, Diana, Vanessa, Yasmine, and Maeve all stopped before the altar. The tension was palpable, everyone wondering what their motive was.
"Art, sorry we got late, congratulations on your wedding." Vanessa was the first to speak.
"H- Huh? You know him?" Sir Giant almost fell from the sky as he questioned in even more bafflement.
"Of course, he is like a son to me." The Succubus Empress replied, a naughty glint in her eyes which only Vritra saw.
"Congratulations, Hu- cough, Art. May you two live a very long happy life together. I forgot the time, you aren't mad, right?"
Yasmine spoke, back in her authoritative and scary mode, though her tone was soft when talking to him.
"Congratulations, Master, sorry for being late, hehe." Maeve spoke. Vritra could almost see her tail moving from left to right, but now she had hidden it.
"M- Master? What does that even mean? I- Isn't he some trash from a sinking family who disappeared for so many years?" a young member from one of the three families spoke.
"Congratulations..." Fiona spoke in a mosquito-like voice, feeling extremely jealous. None of them had even gotten a proper ceremony yet.
If she hadn't seen that dream, then the Phoenix Empress would never have let Vritra marry another woman.
"E- Empress, you know Art too?" Sir Giant turned to look at Diana and questioned, wondering what was going on.
"Of course, he is my hu- master." Diana said, meeting Vritra's gaze with a beautiful smile.
"Ughh, this just can't be real. H- How is he related to so many powerful figures?" someone in the crowd muttered.
"Anyway, Master, tell us, why has the marriage paused? Is there some sort of problem?" Maeve asked, her expression turning serious.
"Is any of them causing trouble here?" Diana spoke, turning to glare at everyone present.
All the people shivered, these women could easily wipe off all the guests, the Yates, and the Sea creatures.
Who would dare to act rowdy in front of them?
"Oh right, I did hear a few of them badmouthing Art."
Yasmine clearly remembered every single person who had spoken badly about Vritra earlier, and she wasn't going to let them off easily.
"All of you step forward, how dare you be so rude to my son and even try to stop his marriage!!" Vanessa said. With just a thought, the minds of hundreds of men were controlled by her.
All of them stepped forward and knelt, looking confused for a moment but then came back to their senses.
"Punish them, I will personally deal with those damned families. How dare they badmouth my da- Art." Fiona said, as she took a step forward.
"And you all, start slapping yourselves until both your arms are broken and your faces are destroyed beyond recognition." Vanessa commanded.
The group was especially filled with the young masters from the top three families.
They were speaking ill of Vritra the most, and now this would be traumatic for their lives.
Their bodies moved on their own, and soon hundreds of loud slapping sounds started ringing out.
Each slap was really loud. Within seconds, many had started to bleed as they cried but couldn't stop.
Fiona looked at the two monarchs who were trying to get past Gunter and attack the altar.
The monarchs of the Grant and Trant families looked like mad beasts, fighting as if their lives were on the line.
"Be careful next time. You can't just afford to offend some people. Feel how your impulsive decision brought you nothing but regret and despair." Fiona's expression was chilly as she spoke.
"E- Empress, wait, we weren't-"
The two were terrified and tried to speak, but in the next moment their bodies got swallowed by the Undead Mythic Halo, a flame that could never be extinguished.

They were speaking ill of Vritra the most, and now this would be traumatic for their lives.
Their bodies moved on their own, and soon hundreds of loud slapping sounds started ringing out.
Each slap was really loud.
Within seconds, many had started to bleed as they cried but couldn't stop.
Fiona looked at the two monarchs who were trying to get past Gunter and attack the altar.
The monarchs of the Grant and Trant families looked like mad beasts, fighting as if their lives were on the line.
"Be careful next time.
You can't just afford to offend some people.
Feel how your impulsive decision brought you nothing but regret and despair." Fiona's expression was chilly as she spoke.
"E- Empress, wait, we weren't-"
The two were terrified and tried to speak, but in the next moment their bodies got swallowed by the Undead Mythic Halo, a flame that could never be extinguished.

chapters.title: Chapter 538 Fate Reaver
paragraphs: Instead of giving the two monarchs quick deaths, Fiona wanted them to suffer so they would keep burning for a while before finally dying.
"Uwaaaaah S- Stoppp it!!" the two fell and began to roll over the floor, feeling extreme torment.
The moment they tried to use their mana to extinguish the flame, it only ignited more, as if devouring fuel, and brought even more pain.
Soon the hall was filled with the loud screams of the two monarchs. Despite being powerful lords, they were completely helpless against the Undead mythic Halo.
All the ones who saw shivered, the image of the redhead burning deep into their minds.
Along with the screams, the constant slapping sound kept ringing out.
Fiona and Vanessa felt quite satisfied, they were still letting these people off easily for insulting their man.
Maeve, Yasmine, and Diana looked up at the army of fishmen who were hurriedly trying to open portals.
But the entire Ford realm was now locked.
"You are all here to support Art Yates?" Sir Giant asked in shock. He might be strong, but just Yasmine alone could defeat him.
And how many lords had gathered there now?
Aside from the five women, there were at least ten more lords present among their armies.
"Yes," Yasmine replied, then glared at Shen. "I will deal with you later. I heard you tried to attack Art just now."
"I- It was a misunderstanding..." Shen felt a shiver as the killing intent of the three women focused on him.
"Tyler, it's been quite long since I last saw you. It seems you have grown quite a lot, huh." The dragoness then turned to look at the king of the fishmen tribe.
Of course, Tyler too recognized her. He had seen her a long time ago, and even at that time she had easily beaten his father.
"N- No, I just came here to give my well wishes. Now t- that I am done, it is time for us to leave." Tyler turned, but the portals just would not open.
"Damnit, what are you doing? Open it right now, didn't you all do it quite fast just now?" glaring at his men, the king shouted.

"It is pointless. Getting out of here is impossible now. Anyway, with the limited ability of your fishmen tribe, I doubt you could have gathered this information yourself. So tell me, who told you about her?"
Yasmine questioned, while Diana and Maeve just floated beside her silently, ready to attack at any moment.
"N- No one, I just found it through a coincidence." Tyler replied, shivering.
"You don't sound very convincing. You see, it is fine if you don't want to tell me. Though I will just get the information from your corpse. I can test a new skill I got recently too."
Yasmine said and raised her right hand, pointing it toward Tyler.
On the ground, after a few minutes of torment, the monarchs of two of the most powerful families were dead.
Two lords were killed just like that, and even their souls got devoured soon after.
All the people were terrified by the outcome. These were two of the five top families, and yet they appeared so weak.
On the other side, the several hundred men were crying even as they continued to slap themselves, their cheeks torn and blood soaking their clothes.
But it seemed they would not stop until even their skulls were broken.
Now that the situation had calmed down and everything was under control, Vritra turned back.
"Can you just hurry up? Do it, and I will even help you with making your family stronger." Divine's voice sounded.
Vritra smiled. He was just about to continue anyway, but it was not bad to get more rewards.
'Oh right, I am marrying your sister, so as her brother, shouldn't you be giving us some special gift?' Vritra asked, twirling the wine around in the glass.
"Fine, don't delay any longer." Divine said, rolling his eyes. Vritra sure was greedy and knew how to use the situation to his advantage.
In the sky, Tyler was frightened by the dragon empress and hurriedly spoke while moving behind his men.
"I- It was the Twilight who helped me. They told me everything and even helped with entering this realm."
'No wonder that Red's underling was here. Are they planning to abduct her too?' Yasmine wondered and looked toward Vritra, only to sense that there was something wrong with the altar.
"Again, cheers, my bride." Vritra spoke, then slowed down the world around them except for himself, Teresa, and the priest.
The two brought the glasses to their lips and finally drank the wine, the slightly bitter taste leaving behind a sweet aftertaste.
After gulping it down, they placed the glasses back on the tray. Within moments, a warmth permeated throughout their bodies.
The priest hurriedly asked,
"Vritra Arclis and Teresa Ford, do you accept each other as husband and wife, whether in good or bad times, always loving and supporting one another?"
Vritra used Nihil Anima to make the priest call his real name, though neither Teresa nor the priest himself noticed it.
"I do." Vritra spoke first and waited.
After a brief pause, Teresa spoke, "I do."
Vritra heard her speak for the first time.
'Even her voice is so beautiful. Back on Earth, I doubt anyone could be her match if she decided to be a singer.'
[You have formed an Eternal Bond with the Stealer of Fate, Teresa Ford!]
[You have obtained the Title Husband of Fate Reaver!]
"You two are now married. I wish you both a long and happy life together." The priest said and heaved a sigh of relief. Finally, it was complete.
Without wasting a moment, the priest turned and ran for his life. This place was too chaotic.
Teresa bowed and spoke in her sweet, honey-like mature voice in a low tone, "My lord... please take care of me from now on."
Vritra was a bit surprised by her way of addressing him, but it was fine. She would slowly learn.
He also needed to change her. How could his wife be so meek and fragile?
That too could wait for now.
Time once again returned to its normal flow. Vritra had already sensed the changes under the altar, which was exactly why he slowed time.
In any case, he was married now and could join in on the fun.
"Hubby!!" Yasmine shouted, but after a moment remembered that Vritra was a demigod, so she relaxed.
The Twilight could no longer wait. They had planned to use Tyler to cause chaos and then kidnap Teresa amidst all that.
But because of the appearance of the five women, their plan had failed, so now they could only go all out.
Around Teresa, a barrier formed all of a sudden, appearing like a cage.
While destructive energy surged under the remainder of the altar, enough to even kill a general.
The bride sensed the changes. Although she was blind, with her senses she could see more than most. Still, she could not enjoy the world like others.
Vritra sighed. It seemed the Twilight was soon going to be wiped out. They had made the biggest mistake by targeting his wife.
But everyone else who saw the scene understood the deep scheme. Sir Giant and Shen flew to save Vritra and Teresa, but it was too late.

These fools, they would actually dare to steal what was his.Not in a hurry, he looked at the person who was brave enough to try to grab the cage.Vritra didn't recognise him, his strength being lower than a lord but should be around the 18th Legion, a whole lot stronger than a general.Teresa, being at the lord rank, could clearly sense the changes around her.But she was afraid of hurting others, and with her hands clasped together, she just stood there silently.It wasn't the first time someone had tried to abduct her after all, and it was always her brother or grandfather who had saved her.She was even more afraid of anyone's touch, it brought nightmares, pain, dangers; she could see all the sufferings the other person had gone through or would go through.When she was younger, a maid found out about her secret and touched her.Each of her kids she gave birth to died right after birth because of unknown reasons, but having gotten her ill fate stolen, she finally gave birth to a healthy son.Though Sir Giant found out too late about it and gave the maid a death sentence, the damage was irreversible.It had only been a few times, but Teresa had taken a few bad fates, making other people's lives better.Standing silently in the cage, she was frightened but just needed to wait, only hoping that no one would even accidentally touch her.'One... Two... Three...' she counted in her mind, both her grandfather and brother had promised that whenever she was in trouble, they would come protect her before she finished counting to ten.But this time, before then he flew up, pausing at a safe distance, and then...BOOOOM!The altar exploded violently, the people of the Ford and Yate family were shaken, feeling that the two had been swallowed by the explosion.The Fords knew that Teresa wouldn't die from this, though it might still injure her, but Art would be dead by such a powerful explosion.While the Yates were more worried about Teresa, since experience which should come, since her husband had touched her.Even if someone touched her hand over a glove, her abilities were strong enough to work most times.But seconds passed, and all she felt were his arms holding onto her protectively, wrapped around her waist.Her body pressed against his, she had never been this close to a person, not even her own mother.The confused bride tilted her head and opened her eyes as her senses drifted outwards, and she saw Vritra gazing at her."H- Huh?" Teresa couldn't even see his fate, she wondered what might be the reason."My dear Tess, I will never harm you, whether knowingly or unknowingly. So don't be afraid of getting close to me, okay?" Vritra spoke, his left arm calmly resting over her waist while he moved his right arm.Teresa was still shocked by the situation, she was actually ready for a bad life ahead.Why would anyone love her, what could she even provide. He can't touch her or even see her, since that might make him go crazy.Like others said, she could bring misfortune, so the unfortunate witch knew this marriage was only in name.She would never be close to him, physically or emotionally, and being married off to some stranger only made this fear grow.Yet, the reality was far from her expectation.She was a bit late to register his words, still in shock.But then she felt Vritra's light grasp over her left arm, and before she could say anything, he pulled off her glove.A slender, milky, beautiful arm was revealed, though her dress still covered almost up to her wrist.Vritra gently placed his palm over hers, before entangling his fingers with hers, holding her hand with tenderness.Her skin felt so smooth and soft, truly, this feeling was completely different from everything.It was hard to believe she was just a human and not a higher being.While Teresa's arm remained stiff, slowly she clasped her fingers while feeling his warmth.Somehow, it calmed her heart down, and it felt really good.A long time ago, she was told by her mother that someone more precious and important than anyone in their family would one day come into her life.Someone who would love her unconditionally without expecting anything in return, who would always protect her and stand with her even if the world was against her.But Teresa never believed those words, yet at this moment, it was as if everything in the world had disappeared.She felt... special for the first time.Her husband was supposed to be just another stranger in her life with no impact on her, but now that word felt so intimate.Feeling that she could truly lean onto him, she wanted to experience more of this feeling.She was ready to give herself to him, just hoping that heartbreak didn't await her at the end.All her complex thoughts were interrupted when Vritra spoke:"Do you feel strange?"He was actually a little worried about hurting her, but also felt that Divine would have warned him if his touch could harm her.If Teresa really were to steal his fate, then she might die faster, so he doubted it."..." Teresa remained silent, the pain or anything she expected didn't come, but it brought a good feeling which she felt for the first time.So, after a moment, she nodded, enjoying this strange sensation.❖❖❖

chapters.title: Chapter 540 Hate?
paragraphs: 'He is my husband now...' she thought dazedly, the word and their relation feeling so foreign to her.
Vritra pulled his arm back, startling the bride.
"Ah–" Teresa blinked her eyes, the lingering warmth slowly disappearing.
Vritra let go of her and took a step back, the two floating in front of one another.
'I thought it would be fine, but my touch is hurting her too?
Guess my touch just isn't deadly for her since she can't steal my fate, but it might still bring her pain.' Vritra thought, misunderstanding her answer.
He called out to Divine, but no reply came; the other person left the two to deal with their relationship.
"Sorry, I wasn't careful enough... let's take things slow," Vritra said, smiling warmly towards her.
While his bride remained floating with her arms stretched slightly, she was just enjoying the closeness.
She wanted to correct the misunderstanding but didn't know how to tell it to him.
'He won't touch me anymore...?' Teresa wondered, her mood suddenly sinking.
He knew her life had been traumatic and that she was the most vulnerable among all his wives, so he needed to heal her slowly and carefully.
'And I need to change her. As my wife, she should be more... confident and selfish. At least we both have one thing in common, that is, we both love stealing.'
Vritra thought, but he needed to teach his wife the proper way to steal.
They were only supposed to steal the good stuff. He needed to teach her so much.

"Tess, you know our marriage was, well... quite special. An arranged marriage, and we two don't know much about one another. So there are a few rules we need to set up," Vritra spoke, ignoring everything going on on the ground.
"Mhmm." She nodded. Among the various things taught to her by her late mother, she was taught to be very respectful, believe in him, and follow everything he said.
So whatever he might say, she was ready to follow.

"First, tell me, can you control stealing fate, or does it happen automatically as soon as you come into contact with someone?" Vritra questioned. Based on the answer, he would have to find a solution.
And he just wanted to hear more of her voice, it was so hypnotizing.
"A little, though I can't control seeing someone's fate, both past and future," Teresa replied obediently.
"Hmm, I see. Anyway, rule number one that you must follow: I am always right, so without questioning, you have to follow me, even if I were to stand against your family.
If you don't agree, then it would be better to separate early," Vritra said. It was strange, talking about divorce right after marriage.
After a short pause, Teresa nodded.
"I understand, my lord."
"Secondly, you are not allowed to steal anything without asking me, no matter how pitiful the situation is, okay? You must follow this, or we can just separate," Vritra added.
"Okay." Teresa decided to be even more careful not to touch anyone, so she wouldn't be thrown into that predicament.
She had been locked away in her room for most of her life, so she usually spoke very little.
"Alright, third, you have to prioritize yourself over anyone else, whether it be your family or anyone in the world. You agree? Or it would be—"
Before he could complete his sentence, Teresa interrupted.
"I– I will, my lord."
"Also, stop calling me that, it feels so formal," Vritra said, glancing down at the ground.
While the two newlyweds were having a quiet conversation, many people were going crazy on the ground.
Since both Vritra and Teresa had completely disappeared, it almost looked as if they had been killed by the explosion.
Gunter was still relatively fine, since he knew of Vritra's strength and speed.
But Sir Giant, Shen, and many others truly thought Teresa was dead.
Although she was already a lord, she had never fought before; her strength had reached that point only because of her family.
"Teresaaaa!!" Sir Giant let out a terrified scream, falling to his knees with a fearful expression.
Vritra couldn't help but smile. That was a nice sight, so he decided to delay his return to the chaos a bit.
Teresa felt puzzled and troubled by his last words.
"B– But my mother told me it brings bad luck to call your husband by name."
"Then just use some other title, like..." he pondered, but most titles were already taken by his other wives.
If Teresa were to call him darling, Fiona would certainly be very jealous and upset.
Not to mention, his new bride was quite awkward with conversations, so she needed time to adjust.
"...Just call me husband or something, nothing that formal," Vritra added.
But then Yasmine's voice sounded in his mind.
"Well, I am more than happy to share the title I use. She can call you hubby. Seal of approval from me."
The dragoness was still sharing senses with him, so she could see and hear everything around him.
"Okay, my lor– husband," Teresa corrected herself, still finding it hard to believe that she was actually married.
But then she wondered if Vritra actually hated her. He hadn't even seen her and couldn't expect anything from this marriage.
Not to mention all those ugly rumors and the enormous age difference between the two.
There were far too many negatives in this marriage.
She had seen his clear attempts to cancel the marriage when he slapped her brother, Shen.
And even now, he mentioned separation several times in his rules. She wanted to ask, but could only hold back in the current situation.
"Good job, my Tess." Vritra smiled and patted her head, then paused and pulled back.
"Sigh, sorry, it's a habit. I will try not to—"
Vritra sighed, but Teresa gathered her courage and interrupted.
"Y– Your touch doesn't hurt me. I am fine, so..." she trailed off mid sentence, wondering if it was wrong to demand anything from him.
"That's wonderful to hear." Vritra gently caressed her head once again, Teresa feeling relaxed.
She was so cute. Her awkwardness and hesitation were all new for Vritra too, and he was starting to like her.
Now that even Fiona seemed to have matured, he was quite happy to have Teresa in the family.
Then he took her left hand, gently holding onto it, and finally the two descended.
Fiona had just killed another member of the Twilight, as more than three hundred men burned in her blood red flames.
Killing might have become a new hobby for her.
Everyone was shocked. The marriage had turned into a murder ground.
Even the bride and groom seemed to have perished, or not.
Finally, the two landed on the ground, holding hands, while Teresa was still completely covered except for the glove on her left arm.
"Y– You are fine!!" Everyone finally relaxed upon seeing the two.
But then Shen, Sir Giant, Rich, and many others froze, staring at them in shock.
"D– Didn't we tell you not to touch her? It could put her life in dang—" Shen was both angry and baffled.
Even before the marriage, he had informed Vritra about how fragile she was and warned him not to touch her.
Vritra let go of Teresa's hand, flashed before Shen, and gave him another loud slap.
"Quiet."

sentences.text: 'He is my husband now...' she thought dazedly, the word and their relation feeling so foreign to her.
Vritra pulled his arm back, startling the bride.
"Ah–" Teresa blinked her eyes, the lingering warmth slowly disappearing.
Vritra let go of her and took a step back, the two floating in front of one another.
'I thought it would be fine, but my touch is hurting her too?
Guess my touch just isn't deadly for her since she can't steal my fate, but it might still bring her pain.' Vritra thought, misunderstanding her answer.
He called out to Divine, but no reply came; the other person left the two to deal with their relationship.
"Sorry, I wasn't careful enough... let's take things slow," Vritra said, smiling warmly towards her.
While his bride remained floating with her arms stretched slightly, she was just enjoying the closeness.
She wanted to correct the misunderstanding but didn't know how to tell it to him.
'He won't touch me anymore...?' Teresa wondered, her mood suddenly sinking.
He knew her life had been traumatic and that she was the most vulnerable among all his wives, so he needed to heal her slowly and carefully.
'And I need to change her.
As my wife, she should be more... confident and selfish.
At least we both have one thing in common, that is, we both love stealing.'
Vritra thought, but he needed to teach his wife the proper way to steal.
They were only supposed to steal the good stuff.
He needed to teach her so much.
"Tess, you know our marriage was, well... quite special.
An arranged marriage, and we two don't know much about one another.
So there are a few rules we need to set up," Vritra spoke, ignoring everything going on on the ground.
"Mhmm." She nodded.
Among the various things taught to her by her late mother, she was taught to be very respectful, believe in him, and follow everything he said.
So whatever he might say, she was ready to follow.
"First, tell me, can you control stealing fate, or does it happen automatically as soon as you come into contact with someone?" Vritra questioned.
Based on the answer, he would have to find a solution.
And he just wanted to hear more of her voice, it was so hypnotizing.
"A little, though I can't control seeing someone's fate, both past and future," Teresa replied obediently.
"Hmm, I see.
Anyway, rule number one that you must follow: I am always right, so without questioning, you have to follow me, even if I were to stand against your family.
If you don't agree, then it would be better to separate early," Vritra said.
It was strange, talking about divorce right after marriage.
After a short pause, Teresa nodded.
"I understand, my lord."
"Secondly, you are not allowed to steal anything without asking me, no matter how pitiful the situation is, okay?
You must follow this, or we can just separate," Vritra added.
"Okay." Teresa decided to be even more careful not to touch anyone, so she wouldn't be thrown into that predicament.
She had been locked away in her room for most of her life, so she usually spoke very little.
"Alright, third, you have to prioritize yourself over anyone else, whether it be your family or anyone in the world.
You agree?
Or it would be—"
Before he could complete his sentence, Teresa interrupted.
"I– I will, my lord."
"Also, stop calling me that, it feels so formal," Vritra said, glancing down at the ground.
While the two newlyweds were having a quiet conversation, many people were going crazy on the ground.
Since both Vritra and Teresa had completely disappeared, it almost looked as if they had been killed by the explosion.
Gunter was still relatively fine, since he knew of Vritra's strength and speed.
But Sir Giant, Shen, and many others truly thought Teresa was dead.
Although she was already a lord, she had never fought before; her strength had reached that point only because of her family.
"Teresaaaa!!" Sir Giant let out a terrified scream, falling to his knees with a fearful expression.
Vritra couldn't help but smile.
That was a nice sight, so he decided to delay his return to the chaos a bit.
Teresa felt puzzled and troubled by his last words.
"B– But my mother told me it brings bad luck to call your husband by name."
"Then just use some other title, like..." he pondered, but most titles were already taken by his other wives.
If Teresa were to call him darling, Fiona would certainly be very jealous and upset.
Not to mention, his new bride was quite awkward with conversations, so she needed time to adjust.

"Well, I am more than happy to share the title I use.
She can call you hubby.
Seal of approval from me."

chapters.title: Chapter 541 Blood Rain
paragraphs: The loud slapping sound rang out, but by now that was the least shocking thing.
Two monarchs had died, and this was just a slap.
Then, glancing back at Teresa, Vritra spoke, "Tess, wait a little for me, I gotta deal with a few bugs."
Leaving behind the frozen monarch of the Ford family, Vritra appeared in the sky beside his three wives.
"So you are Tyler, did you come here to abduct my wife?" Vritra folded his arms over his chest.
He couldn't yet reveal his true identity, but nothing stopped him from displaying his strength.
And now that the marriage was complete, he would obtain information about Yennefer's location soon anyway.
"N- No sir, I merely came here to congratulate you and give a gift," Tyler said, even more frightened of Vritra.
The speed at which he had moved was too fast for anyone present there to capture.
"Huh? How is he so fast? He is so young, don't tell me he is already at the lord rank!!" Many lords present in the large hall had the same questions.
Again, the most baffled ones were the members of the Ford family.
Even Teresa was surprised by her husband's strength, wasn't he supposed to be weak?
His age should be just around twenty.
Even earlier, his speed was so fast, though she had heard he had just returned to the family recently.
"Is that so? Guess I heard wrong, then you may leave. I am giving you three whole seconds to disappear, if you still remain in the Ford realm by then..." Vritra left the threat hanging in the air.
All the fishmen trembled in dread and looked at their leader, their long sharp teeth quivering.
They had come here with the objective of munching over human flesh, to surprise the humans with carnage.
"One..." Vritra began.
"Hurry up, open the portals," Tyler shouted, but it was useless.
"Two..." The king then looked at the rift that was still open on the ground, though none of the Twilight members were able to escape through it.
Though some other fishmen had the same idea, they rushed into the rift, but after a moment, pieces of their flesh and bones were thrown back.
And from inside came a grotesque-looking wraith, the chimera.
But before anyone could see or notice it, the wraith disappeared.
Tyler gave up on the rift and tried to escape.
"Three!"
Vritra pulled a long sword from his storage. He could kill them easily, but he wanted it to be more bloody.
So everyone present there could feel the dread, especially the Fords.
He wanted everyone on the continent to know of him, so that the big reveal of his true identity would be even more splendid.
All eyes were fixed on him. Vritra moved slowly, the bodies of the fishmen froze.
His right hand moved smoothly, the black sword easily cutting their bodies apart.
It was as if he was going on a stroll as he kept swinging the sword, pieces of flesh falling onto the floor.
Blood rained down, corpses littered the whole place.
Within a minute, the number of fishmen had been reduced by half.
With her fists tightly clenched, Teresa continued to witness the events in the sky.
Complex thoughts bubbled in her mind.
The world didn't have much colour in her vision, it was a world made from her senses.
Previously, she was happy that she didn't have to see such a cruel world, but now, she wished she could see him properly.
Vritra had effortlessly killed thousands of creatures, and there wasn't even the slightest hint of hesitation. He had certainly killed way more.
Finally, only the king remained.
"So King Tyler, any information you want to give to me?" Vritra asked, removing the sword.
"P- Please spare me, I am begging you. I will tell you whatever I know." The king broke under the dreadful pressure, his mental barriers gone.
"Hmm, alright, this is a happy occasion, so I will grant your wish." Vritra nodded, making the fishman king look at him hopefully.
'Psyche,' Vritra called out in his mind, and in the next instant, Tyler was consumed by darkness and simply disappeared.
The soul wraith could use that body for some time. Although its strength would be slightly restricted, Psyche would have more freedom for a while.
"Alright, and we are done." Vritra said, finally bringing everyone to their senses. There wasn't a drop of blood on his clothes even after the slaughter.
He reappeared beside Teresa and took her warm hand, the sensation of her skin against his was just wonderful.

"A- Alright, that concludes the wedding. Thank you for attending and giving your blessings, you can now leave." Shen hurriedly said. There were a few more events they had planned, but now there was no need for any of it.
They had even prepared so much food.
All the guests hurriedly left, frightened by all the events, but they had a really interesting tale to tell.
Fiona, Diana, Vanessa, Maeve, and Yasmine stayed. They just sent their armies back.
Shen stood behind his grandfather, covering both his red cheeks, and looked at the new couple.
Sir Giant asked while looking at their hands, "Teresa, are you alright?"
"Yes." She replied, her grip tightening slightly.
She understood what they must be thinking, but also knew that Vritra was her new family and more important than the Fords.
Each of her mother's teachings was completely engraved in her mind.
'His touch really isn't harming her?!!' Sir Giant thought in shock, wondering if it was because of the marriage or if there was something special about him.
Teresa's mother had passed a long time ago, but her father had passed just a dozen years or so ago.
When Art wasn't even born, her mother insisted, against everyone's wishes, to let Teresa marry in the future.
Everyone opposed it because of her condition. After all, it might be detrimental to her life, and who knew how her partner would be like.
But still, her mother went against everyone's wishes and made her husband promise her this during her dying moments.
For some reason, she only wanted it to be Gunter's son, and that too after he had passed the age of twenty.
She had the ability to see into the future, though she had kept that hidden from everyone.
To give a better life to her unfortunate daughter, she had exhausted her life force.
And after Art was born, Teresa's father made that god pact according to his late wife's wishes.
For Shen and Sir Giant, this marriage was nothing more than fulfilling that promise.
They still planned to protect her to the best of their abilities, but maybe there was more to it all.
Soon, everyone returned to the Ford palace, they were all seated in a big hall.
Since it was already too late, they would be leaving early the next morning.
Fiona, Yasmine, and all his other wives sat together on one big sofa.
Gunter and Ava were seated together, while Rich, Sir Giant, and Shen were on another sofa.
Vritra and Teresa, still in their wedding dress, were sitting together.
'Now that I think about it, I haven't even seen her face.' Vritra thought, but there was no hurry.
