chapters.title: Chapter 542 Sublime
paragraphs: "Cough, I have made proper arrangements for everyone to sleep, if there is something important we can talk about it tomorrow morning." Shen said, as he stood up and gestured for the servants to lead them.
All of Vritra's women were looking at him, they too wanted a grand wedding, but their complaints could wait.
For now, they decided to leave the newly wed couple alone.
Of course, Yasmine decided to leave the place, only to enter the fourth dimension and float around Vritra.
Vanessa and the others left after talking a bit with Vritra, the four women had their beds placed in a single room.
They planned to talk and enjoy the rare event of them gathering again.
Gunter and Ava too left for their room after a small talk with him.
Finally, Shen walked up to Vritra, and cleared his throat.
"COUGH, I- I have prepared a room for you, Ar- brother in law." He found it strange to address someone so young in such a manner.
Vritra stood up and raised his hand, frightening the monarch, but then he patted his shoulder and spoke:
"Thank you, Shen, but there is no need for that. I will be sleeping in Teresa's room."
"H- Huh, but... that might be dangerous..." he muttered, moving back and standing behind Sir Giant.

"Art, for now, why don't you sleep in a different room? We still aren't sure if you could harm her or not, this is for both of our goo-" Sir Giant spoke, he was sure that Art would agree just to show him respect.
"You don't have to worry about her safety or wellbeing from now on, I will take proper care of her." Vritra replied, of course he planned to take this relationship slow.
Both of them needed to open up to each other, especially Teresa.
She was certainly very smart, most probably the smartest among all his wives or maybe equivalent to Yasmine, but needed to learn so much about normal stuff.
"You- Sigh, I saw that your touch isn't harming her, but-" Sir Giant insisted, originally, Teresa's life wouldn't have any changes even after marriage.
They felt that it was all necessary to protect her, but Vritra wanted her to experience so much more, grow in all ways.
Interrupting the old guy, Vritra pointed towards Teresa and said: "Let's just do as Tess thinks, I will follow her wishes."
"Good, my doll, what do you think?" Sir Giant asked, holding his hands behind his back and more confident now.
Of course, he knew what she would choose, who would even know her better than him.
The bride who was sitting silently tilted her head up, then she stood up.
Without even thinking for a moment, she stepped behind Vritra, lightly holding onto the corner of his sleeve.
"Huh? Teresa, what's wrong? Did he scare you or something?" Sir Giant was so baffled he took a step back and hit Shen, who fell over his butt.
"No, I want to be with my h- husband." She spoke, though it wasn't easy for her.
Vritra's lips curled up, he held her arm.
'She's so sweet...' he could just close his eyes and keep listening to her voice, it was so relaxing.
"Got anything else to say, old guy? If not, please get lost." Vritra spoke, he actually felt happy that she took his side and also enjoyed the hurt and betrayed expressions of her family.
Then, pulling her arm, Vritra and Teresa walked out.
The house was rather big, and her room was located on the second floor.
Teresa was quite nervous as she led him towards her room.
Of course, she still cared about her family but knew Vritra was her future, he was the one who would remain with her till the end, not the family.
Soon they arrived before her room, Teresa pushed the door open and walked inside, scanning the room nervously.
The lights lit up on their own.
Thankfully, everything was presentable, it was properly cleaned too.
Vritra stepped inside and looked around, the room was full of her fragrance and various types of objects.
He closed the door behind then walked up to the items she had placed all over the walls.
Her room was quite big, yet it seemed so full of all these objects.
"Did you create all of them?" he picked a gauntlet, and read its description.
"Yes," Teresa replied, standing silently there.
Vritra was quite shocked upon seeing her creations, she truly was a genius, each of them were top notch treasures.
No wonder the Ford family had grown so much, but he wasn't really interested in any of them.
Turning back to her, he saw his wife stiffly standing there.
Walking closer, he patted her head and spoke: "Why don't you change into something comfortable?"
"Okay..." Teresa nodded before rushing off into the bathroom.
Vritra too changed into comfortable clothes, he just needed to think and Goop transformed.
It was really quite handy.
Then he climbed on the bed and laid back, the day had been quite hectic and exciting.
Staring at the figure floating around in the room, Vritra questioned: 'Wifey, aren't you sleepy?'

"No, I want to sleep with you, I will join once Teresa is asleep." The dragoness replied, she was sleeping with her husband but it was almost as if she was having an affair with someone else's husband.
'Alright.' Vritra nodded, he was feeling sleepy.
Just then, the door to the bathroom was pushed open and Teresa stepped forward.
She was now wearing her nightwear, finally Vritra was able to see her true appearance.
Her black hair fell freely down her back, slightly messy, reaching past her waist.
Teresa's eyes were closed.
Nervously, she was biting onto her lower lip.
Her skin looked creamy, glowing under the faint glow, standing out sharply against the darkness of her lips.
With curves that could even defeat Vanessa, Yasmine and Yennefer.
The thin fabric clung tightly to her body, outlining a voluptuous and perfectly proportioned figure. Every curve, from her breasts to her waist, thighs, and ass looked absolutely delectable.
Her black luscious lips and a face so gorgeous that Vritra stared at her in a daze.
He was a demi god, and her beauty could go through his mental defences, no wonder other people went crazy.
'Goth mommy...?' From her behaviour and voice, such a baddie look would be the last thing he expected.
"Wow, she is far more beautiful than any of the rumours, no wonder, no one has ever been able to take the 1st spot from her." Yasmine too was shocked, staring at that beautiful face.
There were several people occupying the second spot, such as herself, Yennefer though they had removed her from the list recently, and now Vanessa and Fiona.
Maeve had changed her appearance so she wasn't a part of the list, and she was a demon.
After coming to his senses, Vritra found it hard to tear his gaze away from her; but based on her looks he wondered if this was really his meek and awkward wife.
"Uh Tess, what was our first rule?" he questioned.
"You are always right, husband." She answered instantly, her voice as sweet as ever.
'It really is her.' Vritra relaxed a bit but he wondered if this level of beauty is even possible, she wasn't even wearing any makeup.
Just then, he noticed a glass ball, barely visible in the corner of a shelf.
Violent tornadoes were visible inside it, exactly like what he had seen before.

Interrupting the old guy, Vritra pointed towards Teresa and said: "Let's just do as Tess thinks, I will follow her wishes."
"Good, my doll, what do you think?" Sir Giant asked, holding his hands behind his back and more confident now.
Of course, he knew what she would choose, who would even know her better than him.
The bride who was sitting silently tilted her head up, then she stood up.
Without even thinking for a moment, she stepped behind Vritra, lightly holding onto the corner of his sleeve.
"Huh?
Teresa, what's wrong?
Did he scare you or something?" Sir Giant was so baffled he took a step back and hit Shen, who fell over his butt.
"No, I want to be with my h- husband." She spoke, though it wasn't easy for her.
Vritra's lips curled up, he held her arm.
'She's so sweet...' he could just close his eyes and keep listening to her voice, it was so relaxing.
"Got anything else to say, old guy?
If not, please get lost." Vritra spoke, he actually felt happy that she took his side and also enjoyed the hurt and betrayed expressions of her family.
Then, pulling her arm, Vritra and Teresa walked out.
The house was rather big, and her room was located on the second floor.
Teresa was quite nervous as she led him towards her room.
Of course, she still cared about her family but knew Vritra was her future, he was the one who would remain with her till the end, not the family.
Soon they arrived before her room, Teresa pushed the door open and walked inside, scanning the room nervously.
The lights lit up on their own.
Thankfully, everything was presentable, it was properly cleaned too.
Vritra stepped inside and looked around, the room was full of her fragrance and various types of objects.
He closed the door behind then walked up to the items she had placed all over the walls.
Her room was quite big, yet it seemed so full of all these objects.
"Did you create all of them?" he picked a gauntlet, and read its description.
"Yes," Teresa replied, standing silently there.
Vritra was quite shocked upon seeing her creations, she truly was a genius, each of them were top notch treasures.
No wonder the Ford family had grown so much, but he wasn't really interested in any of them.
Turning back to her, he saw his wife stiffly standing there.
Walking closer, he patted her head and spoke: "Why don't you change into something comfortable?"
"Okay..." Teresa nodded before rushing off into the bathroom.
Vritra too changed into comfortable clothes, he just needed to think and Goop transformed.
It was really quite handy.
Then he climbed on the bed and laid back, the day had been quite hectic and exciting.
Staring at the figure floating around in the room, Vritra questioned: 'Wifey, aren't you sleepy?'

"No, I want to sleep with you, I will join once Teresa is asleep." The dragoness replied, she was sleeping with her husband but it was almost as if she was having an affair with someone else's husband.
'Alright.' Vritra nodded, he was feeling sleepy.
Just then, the door to the bathroom was pushed open and Teresa stepped forward.
She was now wearing her nightwear, finally Vritra was able to see her true appearance.
Her black hair fell freely down her back, slightly messy, reaching past her waist.
Teresa's eyes were closed.
Nervously, she was biting onto her lower lip.
Her skin looked creamy, glowing under the faint glow, standing out sharply against the darkness of her lips.
With curves that could even defeat Vanessa, Yasmine and Yennefer.
The thin fabric clung tightly to her body, outlining a voluptuous and perfectly proportioned figure.
Every curve, from her breasts to her waist, thighs, and ass looked absolutely delectable.
Her black luscious lips and a face so gorgeous that Vritra stared at her in a daze.
He was a demi god, and her beauty could go through his mental defences, no wonder other people went crazy.
'Goth mommy...?' From her behaviour and voice, such a baddie look would be the last thing he expected.
"Wow, she is far more beautiful than any of the rumours, no wonder, no one has ever been able to take the 1st spot from her." Yasmine too was shocked, staring at that beautiful face.
There were several people occupying the second spot, such as herself, Yennefer though they had removed her from the list recently, and now Vanessa and Fiona.
Maeve had changed her appearance so she wasn't a part of the list, and she was a demon.
After coming to his senses, Vritra found it hard to tear his gaze away from her; but based on her looks he wondered if this was really his meek and awkward wife.
"Uh Tess, what was our first rule?" he questioned.
"You are always right, husband." She answered instantly, her voice as sweet as ever.
'It really is her.' Vritra relaxed a bit but he wondered if this level of beauty is even possible, she wasn't even wearing any makeup.
Just then, he noticed a glass ball, barely visible in the corner of a shelf.
Violent tornadoes were visible inside it, exactly like what he had seen before.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 Neglected
paragraphs: Vritra was just looking at his wife, words weren't enough to describe her appearance or his feelings.
She was just too stunning, with a light blush, her rosy cheeks seemed even redder.
Just then, he noticed a glass ball, barely visible in the corner of a shelf.
Violent tornadoes were visible inside it, a scene he had seen in the crystal ball of that werewolf.
Oblivion Tornado Realm, this was the clue to finding Yennefer.
So, Divine really wasn't lying, Vritra's attention was instantly pulled from Teresa to the glass ball.
On the other hand, right after stepping out of the bathroom, Teresa felt Vritra's gaze roaming over her body.
Normally, if anyone else looked at her like that it would have made her uncomfortable.
Though strangely, she liked his attention, if only she could see him properly too.
But just after a couple of seconds, his attention shifted away from her, surprising Teresa.
There wasn't much she could offer in this marriage, her appearance was one of the two things she was confident about.
Though very few people had seen her true appearance, all of them were instantly enchanted, yet her husband wasn't interested?
Her shoulders slumped down slightly, the poor bride became a little sad, again wondering if he really hated her.
This was critical damage for her, initially she was afraid that her appearance might hurt him like it did to many.
But her worry was for nothing it seemed...
'He really has no interest in me?' she thought, wondering if she could ever win his affection.
Vritra got off the bed and walked towards the shelf, then pulling off the glass ball he questioned: "You created this too?"
Teresa absentmindedly turned her head, and nodded: "Yes..."
"Yes, hubby, this looks exactly the same." Yasmine added.
"So, what is this?" Vritra continued, finally he could find Yennefer.
"This is sort of a bomb, it could destroy the entire Ford realm." Teresa answered, maybe he was more interested in her talent.
"Oh!" Vritra almost wanted to test it out in the Ford realm but held back.
"This tornado, where did you get that?" he questioned.
"I don't know, it was a gift from... the Star family, but I do know the Star family has been recently expanding their research into various realms."
Teresa answered, initially the Star family probably wanted to use this to create chaos.
But as the most talented sorceress, Teresa was able to control it and create this treasure.
'It seems I really need to meet the Star family.' Vritra was now one step closer, if only he could enter that realm, he would be able to find her.
"Can I borrow it for a while?" Vritra smiled and looked at her.
'He is more interested in this bomb than me?'
"Yes, you can keep it." Teresa said, then she turned and slowly walked over to the bed, before climbing up.
She sat there, her eyes still tightly shut.
"Sigh, hubby, you made Teresa sad, you just saw her for the first time and didn't even give a single compliment." The dragoness interrupted Vritra.
'Ah...' Putting away the glass ball, he turned back and saw her beautiful face. She seemed deep in thought.
Vritra scratched his cheek, in his excitement he forgot all that, showing more interest in a random invention of hers.
Clearing his throat, he walked up to the bed and sat beside her.
"Tess, you look really gorgeous. Can you open your eyes for me?" Rubbing his fingers through her long smooth hair, Vritra placed his palm over her soft rosy cheek.
Her skin was so tender, he was almost afraid that he might end up hurting her.
Vritra remembered her appearance from the visions Divine had shown him, even then she looked beautiful but nowhere near as she did now.
Then he remembered the scene where the two sisters had protected Divine.
Teresa had even stolen the fate of a God, whose looks were far superior to anyone else.
'So, she is kind of the goddess of beauty?' Even that title wouldn't be enough to describe her.
Just by his gentle touch, Teresa relaxed, all worries disappearing.
"Mhm." After a moment, her eyelids trembled then slowly opened.
Revealing eyes so beautiful that they instantly captivated Vritra, it was like he was sinking into her eyes but there was also a hollow feeling.
"So your blindness came from stealing Darius's fate..." he mumbled.
"Yes..." For the first time, was she regretting stealing someone's ill fate?
"Is there a way to reverse it? Can't you give this fate to someone else or something?" Vritra stared at her face from so close, the sight and scent almost made him lose himself.
'She is so beautiful, a being beyond perfection.' He thought.
"No, I don't have a way to do that. And no." It was as if kindness had become a part of Teresa.
After she stole an ill fate, she couldn't give it to someone else or maybe she just didn't want to.
"I see, well I will definitely find a solution to this." Vritra said with resolution, then added: "Anyway, let's sleep now, I am sure you must be exhausted after all that."
Then he leaned forward, pressing his lips against her forehead, after the soft kiss he muttered: "Good night."
"O- Oh uhm... G- Good night." The woman who had never really experienced much affection was overwhelmed by just that.
So, Vritra held back on the idea of kissing her juicy black lips, she really had such a baddie vibe.
Though reluctantly, he didn't want to overwhelm her.
He lay back and turned the lights off, stretching his arms.
Teresa lay back beside him stiffly, her posture rigid, like a soldier at attention, arms locked tightly to her sides.
Vritra smiled, before moving his right arm and gently putting it under her head, Teresa puzzled, just raised her head.
Removing her pillow, now her head rested over his arm.
Then he pulled her closer, turning Teresa to her side as her body softly pressed against his.
Her heart was beating wildly, her hands awkwardly lingered in the air before she slowly put them over his chest.
After a few moments, she relaxed and wriggled against him to get more comfortable, even placing one of her legs over his.
Cuddling like this felt so good, she just might get addicted to this.
Before long, the two were asleep, embracing one another, their bodies entangled in an intimate mess.
Yasmine soon joined him, sleeping on his other side, she was already addicted to sleeping with him.
The night passed quickly, the Fords didn't get much sleep, they were already preparing for various things.
With such important guests in their house, they needed to show proper hospitality.
And needed to do better for the Yates, the news of Art Yates killing thousands of fishmen, which even consisted of a lord, spread rather quickly.
Along with Teresa's identity, it seemed both the Yates and Ford family had lucked out.
Initially, the groom and bride didn't seem anything special, and were even made fun of by many, but now, no one could stop talking about them.
Of course, all that was also going to attract the wrong people, especially Teresa's identity.
There would be so many people who would want her to work for them, both the dark and righteous sides.
In the Golden Moon headquarters, Oracle was seated along with the five others, reading several pieces of information.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 For the Greater Good
paragraphs: Seated in a big hall, Oracle looked over a few papers, reading various reports.
Five other seats were present there; many were killed in the previous war so most of them were new.
Except Oracle and Big Guy, all the others were new, the twins were killed, Pink was killed, and Sir Giant retired.
So four new people had taken the seats, this time Oracle selected everyone whom he could easily control.
Although the overall strength had decreased, there were no pressing threats.
"Twilight... have you discovered any of their bases yet?" he looked at the others and questioned.
Except for Big Guy, everyone was his underling, but even Big Guy, being as dumb as he was, listened to Oracle.
"Yes, we were able to locate a base inside the Quartz continent, it is near the border." One of the four replied, the four lords didn't have any say in important matters.
But they were just happy to be at such high positions.
"Good, recently the succubus and phoenix races have been out of line, they need to be disciplined." Oracle mumbled, he planned to use this chance to attack the two races through a borrowed knife.
"Your orders, sir?" one guy asked, wearing clothes too big for his size.
He too had the ability to grow into a giant, but it was nowhere near as big or strong as Sir Giant.
"Wait a little for now, I have some demons under control. We will use them, and clear all problems at once." He answered, already thinking of a plan to get rid of all threats.
He needed to pressurize all the empresses to put their strength to Golden Moon's use.
"Hmm next... oh!" Oracle suddenly exclaimed, reading the big news.
Finally, the famous witch, stealer of fate, was revealed; whoever could get her on their side, their strength would increase explosively.
"We can't let such a powerful entity be in another organization or family. So she just recently married into the Yate family."
Oracle mumbled, if his thinking wasn't wrong then the Fords wouldn't just let her go.
They would use family love, protection, or whatever reason to keep her there, he was all too familiar with such tactics.
"You, go there and bring Teresa Ford here, it wouldn't be bad to have her take Yennefer's place. There is no room for failure, she must join us.
If anyone objects, you are free to use force or kill, just don't go overboard."
Oracle ordered, after the deaths of so many people, he had increased the overall strength of the Golden Moon by a lot.
And put even more fear of the organization in people's heads.
"Her husband, Art Yates, find more information about him. He killed a lord in the blink of an eye? Interesting..." Oracle gave a few more instructions and then dismissed them all.
He had already gotten a new body for himself, even better and stronger than before, though that needed a few sacrifices for the greater good.
"It seems things are gonna become lively once again." He tried to read into the future but failed.
Back in the Ford realm,
Vritra was sleeping peacefully, Yasmine woke up early and left for a while to deal with something.
Her kingdom was getting better, so that place still needed her presence sometimes.
Teresa was also sleeping very comfortably, snuggling into Vritra's arms, as the two lay facing each other.
In her sleep, all her hesitation was gone, her arms were wrapped around him while her legs were entangled with his.
Her tender breasts were pressed against his body, squished softly.
Hearing the distant noises, Vritra was the first to wake up.
The moment he opened his eyes, her beautiful face greeted him, she looked so innocent and gorgeous...
He just wanted to keep her in his embrace forever and protect her from everything.
'We will be returning home today-' Vritra was just thinking, but then he realized something.
He had no home of his own yet, he had always been running from one place to another and never had a proper place to settle.
For now, they would be returning to the Yate realm, but he certainly needed a house; better than any.
Making a note of that, he remembered.
'Right, I hadn't checked that title I got yesterday, Husband of Fate Reaver.'
Without wasting a moment, he took a deep breath, treating his body with her fragrance and tightening his hug.
Then he opened the status panel and went directly to the title.
[Husband of Fate Reaver]
[Description]: A soul mate to the Stealer of Fate, even apart, you two remain close. Unable to ever be separate, you two weave each other's fate.
Sometimes, you could lessen her burden and be the stealer, be the knight of fate.
No one could alter your fates or see through them. As the Knight of Fate, protect the witch.
(Steal meter: 1 left)
Vritra read the description, a little surprised.
Of course, he was going to protect her, he no longer needed others to remind him of that.
'So I can steal fate one time? What is the way to increase that count? Anyway, do I need to find Jack now?'
Vritra gently caressed her back, absentmindedly rubbing his palms against the soft fabric.
"Mmm..." Teresa finally woke up, she let out a contented sigh; it had been so long since she had slept so well, she didn't have nightmares or was afraid of getting attacked.
Not to mention the lovely feeling of cuddling, after a moment she remembered that she was now married.
Her eyes slowly opened, displaying her black pupils which seemed empty somehow, and sensed Vritra looking at her.
Then she noticed how close the two were, it instantly made her flustered.
"Good morning, my Tess." Vritra said softly, moving one hand, he gently began to caress her head.
"G- Good morning..." because of her embarrassment, she tried to move back a bit.
"What's wrong? You don't like cuddling like this? Fine then-" Vritra let out a disappointed sigh, as he moved his arms.
But remembering the sad feeling from before, she moved closer, muttering in a hurry.
"I like it."
"That's good then." Vritra smiled and pulled her closer, he was understanding her more and more.
"Did you sleep well?" he asked, slowly running his fingers over her back, making her feel all tingly.
"Y- Yes..." she wriggled in his arms, but liked it nonetheless.
"We will be leaving this house soon, are you sad?" Vritra closed his eyes, enjoying her melodic voice like it was some song.
"...Not really, but I would miss Rich and others." Teresa replied, but if her husband was with her, then everything should be fine.
She had already given herself to him, and so far, that seemed to be the best choice.
The two just chatted for a while, not wanting to get out of bed or each other's arms just yet.
Just then, loud knocking was heard from outside.
BANG BANG
Almost as if someone was beating the door and taking their anger out on it.
Frowning, Vritra pulled back and got out of the blanket, he stretched a bit after getting to his feet.
"Oh!" Teresa sat up, looking surprised but also a bit helpless.
Vritra walked up to the door and pulled it open, as a thin woman with an ugly expression came into view.

"Y- Yes..." she wriggled in his arms, but liked it nonetheless.
"We will be leaving this house soon, are you sad?" Vritra closed his eyes, enjoying her melodic voice like it was some song.
"...Not really, but I would miss Rich and others." Teresa replied, but if her husband was with her, then everything should be fine.
She had already given herself to him, and so far, that seemed to be the best choice.
The two just chatted for a while, not wanting to get out of bed or each other's arms just yet.
Just then, loud knocking was heard from outside.
BANG BANG
Almost as if someone was beating the door and taking their anger out on it.
Frowning, Vritra pulled back and got out of the blanket, he stretched a bit after getting to his feet.
"Oh!" Teresa sat up, looking surprised but also a bit helpless.
Vritra walked up to the door and pulled it open, as a thin woman with an ugly expression came into view.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 Bitch
paragraphs: Vritra pulled the door open and found a thin woman standing outside with an ugly, annoyed look on her face.
She had black hair and her face was covered with acne and enlarged pores, all in all she looked quite ugly.
Especially because of her arrogant and annoyed expression.
"What?" Vritra wondered why this woman was acting strangely, maybe there was something urgent and her face was just like that.
The woman was surprised upon seeing Vritra, but then the frown returned to her face and she questioned:
"Hmph! Is Teresa inside?"
After questioning, she started peeking inside.
"Yes, she is. What do you want?" Vritra pulled the door closer and stood in front of her, blocking the view inside.
"I am Sakshi, her sister-in-law," she introduced herself.
"Oh! You aren't a maid? I see, so you are Shen's wife, huh? So why are you here again?" Vritra instantly lost any sort of respect he was showing earlier, though it wasn't much to begin with.
"W- What?!! A maid? How dare you!! I am the wife of the monarch of this family, who do you think you are!" she instantly burst out with rage.
Vritra rolled his eyes. He felt a light poke on his back, and turning back, he saw Teresa standing there.
"Hmm?" he looked at her with a questioning gaze.
"Just let me deal with her, she is... uhm, a bit hot-headed," Teresa spoke, looking helpless, as if she didn't want Vritra to see any of it.
"It is fine, just go freshen up. I will take care of her," Vritra smiled reassuringly at his breathtakingly beautiful wife.
Teresa wanted to say something, she knew how problematic her sister-in-law was. Only Sakshi was the one who had made her life a little difficult.
"You! Get out here, how dare your husband disrespect me!! Did you forget everything after getting married? You wench, get out here!" she shouted, acting as if everyone was beneath her.
As if she was the live representation of beauty and intelligence itself, and everyone had to obey her.
Vritra slowly closed the door behind him and stepped out.
"So what were you saying?" he asked with a small smile.
"Tell her to come out, there was something I had told her to do. Tsk! This blind wench just doesn't know her plac—"
Vritra raised his right hand, and then...
SLAAPPP
The sound was loud enough to ring out across the hallway, and the woman was instantly thrown into the air.
She rolled a couple of times and hit her head against the wall, drawing a thick line of blood against it as her head slid downward.
Hearing the commotion, various guards hurried over. They looked in shock at the figure lying with her butt raised, a pool of blood forming around her head.
But since her strength was quite high, this much shouldn't be enough to kill her, right?
The guards were rather satisfied. They couldn't understand how such a shallow, annoying, and bitchy woman even got to marry into this family.
Or how a calm and talented boy like Rich could be her son.
Everyone hated her; not a single person in the entire Ford family was fond of her.
Over ten guards waited with bated breath, hoping that she would never get up, but they were all disappointed as her body suddenly twitched.
Then she rolled over, and for a few moments was unable to understand anything. Then she registered what had just happened, and even more rage filled her.
Wiping the blood off her face, she sat up, her head spinning badly.
"Y- You bastard! How dare you hit me, do you even know what type of crime you have committed? Don't think you can be saved just because you are the husband of that bl- woman."
Her body was shaking with rage and pain.
Then she got up to her feet and started screaming, ordering the guards to arrest him instantly and calling for more to come.
"What are you doing just standing there? Go and arrest this bastard, I am going to make him pay! Ughhh, so much blood, how could you hit a woman?"
Her cheek and head were hurting badly, but it only made her more furious.
Who had ever dared to touch her like that? Even Sir Giant didn't bother much with her, and the monarch was afraid too.
No matter what, Art Yates had to die, and she would make sure of it. It didn't matter if Teresa became a widow or not, someone like this shouldn't be allowed to live.
"..." The guards hesitated. Not only was Vritra now a part of the family, but unlike Sakshi, they had been present at the wedding and saw what sort of monster he was.
He had made a lord disappear in an instant. What could they even do?
"You pieces of shit, so now you are rebelling? I am going to get all of you killed as well, and then your families for treason!! SHEENNNNNN!! GET HERE NOW!!" she screamed wildly.
The guards looked at one another. They were pushed into only two choices, either get killed directly or get killed along with their families.
So with fearful steps, they started approaching Vritra.
"Sigh, just stand there," Vritra spoke lazily, waiting for her help to arrive.
The guards could no longer take even a single step forward, even if they tried.
Seconds passed. Vritra stood with his arms folded over his chest, wondering if he should just kill her.
But he held back. He needed to know if she had hurt Teresa before in any way, and if she had, then death would be too easy for her.
"Tess, don't worry and just freshen up. We will soon be leaving this place," Vritra sensed his wife's tense figure on the other side of the door.
He could feel how helpless she must be feeling. If Teresa wanted, she could easily kill her and even Shen, but she was just too kind. She couldn't bear to ever hurt anyone.
And Vritra planned to change that, no matter how much time it took.

"Hah! So now you are planning to escape? Don't even think about it, you are going to get buried right here, and she too will have to pay for your crimes!" she said arrogantly, her nose wrinkling and jaw twitching.
It wasn't long before her shouts attracted many. Shen, Sir Giant, Rich, guards, and many more rushed toward the second floor and soon saw the surprising scene.
Vritra was standing there calmly, the guards looked helpless, and on the other side—
"What happened here? How did you get injured so badly?" Shen looked in shock at his wife's condition.
Blood was constantly pouring down her head, her right cheek was already swollen like a ball, and even her nose seemed to be broken.
There was blood on the wall and the ground.
"Shen, this bastard dared to hit me when I just asked him to call Teresa out. Sob, look how badly I am hurt," she instantly ran up to him, crying pitifully.
'Such great acting...' Vritra stared at her in amusement, waiting to see how the others were going to react.
"H- He hit you too?!" Shen unconsciously touched his cheek. Vritra had already slapped him a few times.

chapters.title: Chapter 546 Justice
paragraphs: And now he hit his wife too, but he knew just how mannerless and bitchy a woman his wife is, so he spoke:
"I will punish him later, why don't you go and get treated first?"
"NO! You have to punish him right now, look how badly he injured me. What would people say if they were to know this?
Just kill this bastard, we can find a different man for that bli- cough Teresa." She suggested.
"Sigh. All of you, leave, this is just a small matter." Sir Giant said to the guards, making them disperse.
"No one is allowed to leave, everyone has to witness how one is punished if they dared to attack the wife of the monarch in their own house.
Shen, why are you hesitating, he is just a stranger." Sakshi felt even more enraged. She thought Vritra would be beaten the moment they all arrived, but no one was on her side.
"Fine, don't kill him, but let me hit him too, then we would be even." She compromised, but that too would be fine.
"Don't even think about it, he is our guest. How would it make us look if my grandson-in-law is hit in our territory?" Sir Giant shook his head. He too knew that she must have said something.
But knowing Sakshi, she wouldn't let the matter rest easily.

"Ughh. What about me? My respect? Are you not going to do anything? At least make him apologize..." the thin woman was growing angrier by the moment. It was the first time her own family was acting like this towards her.
"Mother, just leave. I am sure you must have said something about Aunty.
Guards, please gently escort my mother to her room and get someone to seal her mout- I mean heal her." Rich spoke, gesturing to the guards.
Rich and Teresa had both greatly contributed to the family's explosive growth. Rich was a business genius, he alone possessed wealth more than the other four families combined.
While Teresa had helped with all her treasures.
Although Rich didn't interfere much in family affairs, he just didn't like his mother's behavior.
"Rich!! How can you talk to your own mother in such a manner? Everything aside, he hit me, so at least shouldn't he apologize to me?" Sakshi shouted.
"Enough, leave now." Shen shouted. Vritra had even slapped him, what could he even say.
"B- But..." Sakshi tried to speak, but there wasn't anyone supporting her, so she could only use her last resort.
"Shen, if you don't make him apologize now, then..." she made a gesture with her eyes, as if reminding him of something.
"Ughh." Shen grimaced. Sir Giant and Rich turned and left, leaving Shen to handle it all.
The monarch of the Ford family stood silently for a few moments, torn between the two hard choices.
"Um, B- Brother-in-law, would you just quickly apologize to her?" he asked.
"No, and stop wasting my time. Drag this bitch away. Haa, it feels like my eyes got dirty just looking at her. I need to heal by looking at Tess." Vritra said.
This was definitely the most annoying woman he had seen in his life.
And she had just claimed a spot on his list along with several names like Oracle and others.
The more he looked at her face, the more annoyed he became.
With a thought, he snapped her bones near her knee as her leg bent backward, and she suddenly fell forward.
Her face smashed straight into the floor. If her nose wasn't broken earlier, then it surely was now.
"Uwaaaaah." Vritra enjoyed the scene for a few seconds, then she got dragged away by the guards.
"I- I apologize on her behalf-" Shen was speaking, but Vritra just shooed him away.
"Get lost, I don't have time for your family drama." Then he walked back inside and shut the door with a loud bang.
'Sigh... wasn't he supposed to be pretty meek? But how did her leg break? He didn't move nor use any mana?' Shen wondered as he finally walked away, ordering someone to clean the place.
Teresa was still nervously standing there. She knew how vicious Sakshi was and was worried for Vritra.
But the scene outside shocked her.
Vritra stepped back into the room and looked at Teresa.
"Has she always been like this?" he asked instead of directly asking the main question.
"...Yes, my brother was forced into the marriage because her father helped us once, and Grandpa made a promise to her father to return the favor." Teresa answered, relaxing a little.
Just talking normally like this was quite abnormal for her. She and her family always had to be careful not to come in contact.
"Oh, don't tell me she made you steal her bad fate?" Vritra asked dramatically.
"No, she didn't. Brother and Grandpa always made sure of that, she never got to enter my room." Teresa added.
"That's good. So she only made your life difficult with her taunts, curses, and such? Maybe hurting indirectly?" Vritra said casually. He knew perfectly how to get her to say it.
Normally she might not have answered. Being as kind as she was, Teresa wouldn't want anyone to be hurt or sad.
"Yeah..." she nodded, not thinking much of it.
'So that bitch did make Tess suffer. I will turn her life into a living nightmare.' He thought.
"I see. Go ahead and take a bath, we will be leaving soon." Vritra said, patting her head.
Teresa nodded and walked away.
Before long, Vritra, Gunter, Ava, Rich, and the others were all seated in a dining hall.
Food was served for them. For a while, they ate in silence. Sakshi was there too, her leg and head already healed.
Teresa stayed in her room. It would be too dangerous for her to go out in the open.

"I apologize for any mistakes we made and our shortcomings. Now that our two families have become one, we will be present if you were to face any problems in the future." Shen spoke calmly as everyone finished eating.
"Haha. Of course, helping each other is only natural. Thank you for everything." Gunter replied. Initially, he was quite upset that his son was getting forced into this marriage.
But now, the guilt was driven away, and even Vritra seemed to like her.
Though knowing her real identity, this relationship would be anything but normal.
Everyone knew her now. Many might try to assassinate or abduct her, and even before that, would the Ford family let her leave?
"Brother-in-law, you can live here from no-" Shen was just speaking, but Vritra, who was poking his empty plate with a fork, accidentally used too much force.
The fork flew away from his hand accidentally, and then it directly went inside Sakshi's mouth, who had opened her mouth wide to take a bite of her dish.
COUGH
It pierced into her flesh, cutting off her uvula.
Her mouth was left open, eyes wide with shock, as a sudden wave of pain assaulted her senses.
She choked, coughing blood, and started spasming wildly.
"Oops, sorry." Vritra said, as if he had only dropped his spoon and it wasn't a big deal.
For a few moments, everyone stared in shock while the woman continued to spasm.
Then they hurriedly took her away for treatment.

chapters.title: Chapter 547 A Favour
paragraphs: Sakshi was hurriedly taken away, everyone was shocked seeing the fork plunged into her mouth.
They could tell this certainly wasn't an accident, and felt that Vritra was taking things a bit too far.
But none of them said anything, Gunter apologized, wondering why his son was suddenly acting like that.
"I- It is fine, it was just an accident and she will be fine... probably." Shen spoke, he hadn't said anything to Vritra the previous time since his wife must have been at fault.
But this time she did nothing.
Before long, they started preparing for the departure of the Yate family.
Vritra returned to Teresa's room and informed her about leaving, so she took whatever important stuff she wanted and left some.
Sitting over his bed, Vritra was deep in thought.
Until Teresa is capable enough to take care of herself, he would have to keep her close and protect her.
He also needed to head to the Star family as soon as possible, with the glass ball in his possession, he was even closer to finding Yennefer.
The revenge against all those from the war could come after that, he would just let them enjoy their peace and luxury for now.
Aside from all that, he also wanted to build himself a nice and big house, for his family.
But Vritra wasn't sure where to build it and how exactly to go about it.
Just then, the Divine's voice appeared in his mind, while Teresa was busy going through her stuff.
"Well well, congratulations, you have bought a ticket to a world of trouble by marrying her, are you regretting it?"
'No, and I am used to it now. Anyway, thank you.' Vritra replied, he was happy to have met such a wonderful woman.

"Oh don't mention it. Right, I promised to help your family, right? So, here is something to help them out, I will give the rest later." Divine said and instantly, two objects appeared in his inventory.
Vritra was a bit surprised by the sudden gifts, the stuff from Divine has always been great after all.
He checked the first item, which was a small ancient looking door, it looked more like a toy though made of metal.
"That's for Diana, it will be of great help to her." Divine added proudly, even gods would fight to obtain things such as these.
Vritra read its name.
'Tomb of the Gods, oh!' he could sense the vast energy present inside that small door.
"Just give it to her and she will figure out how to use it." Divine added, now that his sister was with Vritra, he was happier to help him more.
Though he wondered how their life would be, as both attracted a lot of trouble.
Then Vritra focused on the second object, it was just a piece of cloth, a reddish cloth.
"And what is this?" he questioned after failing to obtain any info through its name.
"This is a really special weapon which will suit your mother very well and help her increase her level, let her use it, she will figure it out." Divine explained, waiting for his thank you.
'Alright, where are the rest?' Vritra asked, observing the cloth, based on his feeling it didn't seem any weaker than that door.
"Tsk, I will give more soon, such treasures aren't easy to find or transfer. Oh right, I got some good stuff for your underlings too." Divine said and two additional things appeared in his inventory.
One was a greenish bell, which too seemed small in size and its name was rather strange.
'Hit me harder? What is this now?' Vritra read the name, he couldn't tell its use, wondering if it was some protective treasure.
"Hit me harder, this bell is for that monk, if he keeps hitting the bell with his head, fist or feet, his body's defences and strength will keep rising to a certain limit." Divine explained lazily.
'Hmm not bad, and finally...' Vritra glanced at the final object which was a map.
'What about this map? There is no information.'
"This map will lead Onest to a place which is best suited for him, life will be difficult but he will also grow stronger." Divine replied.
'Good, I am sure he can handle a little difficulty, bring more next time for all my wives.' Vritra said.
Shitless and Onest followed him and had been helping his wives, so it was better to let them grow too.
Onest was not too far away from the lord rank but Shitless was very weak, going forward the challenges they would be facing would be far more dangerous.
"Sigh, how greedy, asking for dowry for my sister..." Divine mumbled.
'That's gifts, and what you promised me. Anyway, if there is nothing else, then leave.' Vritra said, it was almost time for them to head back to the Yate realm.

But as she grew up and saw more of the world, she just resigned herself to her fate, whatever it may bring.
Earlier she had created two matching rings, but as soon as she became more apathetic to her surroundings, she just forgot them.

At that time, her capabilities were limited so she couldn't add anything more.

Divine said and before waiting for his reply, he continued, sensing his sister was just about to approach Vritra.
"Anyway, now that the danger is gone, can you do one more task for me? It won't be as dangerous, you just need to deal with a demi god-"
And his words instantly pissed Vritra off, previously this bastard announced his identity and location to the entire world, because of which the war happened.
Indirectly it was because of him that Yennefer was still lost somewhere and he dared to ask for a favour?
"Husband, look at th-"
"Get lost!" Vritra shouted, enraged at Divine's words, if that guy was here then Vritra would have certainly beaten him to a pulp.
But then he paused, slowly turned his head to the side.
Teresa's body trembled as she heard Vritra's shout, frozen with her hands outstretched.
Her eyes instantly began to tear up, looking at Vritra, lips shivering lightly.
"Wait I didn't mean yo-" but it was already too late, the poor woman who had stayed alone in her room most of her life started crying.
"I- I knew you SOB SOB h- hate me... you don't SOB want m- me either..." even while crying she looked so cute and beautiful but Vritra put those thoughts away, now was not the time for that.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 Her Safety?
paragraphs: 'Divine, you bastard, I will get back at you for everything you have done.' Vritra cursed, he had definitely done this knowingly.
Then, getting to his feet, Vritra hurried closer to Teresa. She was sobbing, and it made him feel really bad even if it was just a misunderstanding.
Pulling her into his arms, Vritra began to gently caress her back, as Teresa buried her face into his chest.
"Sorry, I wasn't shouting at you. I was... talking to someone else, and he made me angry. I would never shout at you." Vritra spoke gently.
She was ready to leave everything behind just for him, so he didn't want to see her cry or be sad at all.
"I- I was SOB only one here, SOB there is n- no one else..." Teresa said through her sobs, clutching his clothes tightly in her fists.
Her cheeks puffed up.
"It's an ability of mine to talk telepathically, so stop crying, it makes me feel sad too." Vritra continued to console her for a while.
Only after a few minutes had passed did she finally calm down.
The two were embracing each other, Teresa's hands wrapped around him, her face nuzzled close to his neck.
Vritra was still caressing her head as he questioned: "But why would you think I hate you?"

"I know how you were trying to cancel our wedding before; you didn't want to marry me. I am so much older than you, I am blind, I can't have kids, and my family put so many conditions..." Teresa mumbled.
She could understand why he would hate her.
Vritra chuckled, hugged her tighter, and spoke: "You silly girl, I would never hate you. And as for marriage, there are a few things that you still don't know. I will explain everything to you soon."
That was a lot for her, so he decided to tell her everything slowly.
They remained silent for a moment, then Vritra thought of something and asked: "You said I didn't want to marry, you are saying it as if you wanted to marry me from before."
"Yes, I wanted to." Teresa said softly.
"Hmm, but you didn't even know me. So if it was someone else, you would want to marry him?" Vritra decided to tease her to lighten the mood, speaking in a slightly upset tone.
He found it intriguing, maybe she also knew something.
"Huh? No, I wouldn't!" Teresa pulled back and said hurriedly, her beautiful face so close to his.
"So, you knew your groom was me? I have disappeared for quite some time, what would you even know?" Vritra asked, though he already had a few guesses.
"Uhm... let's talk about it once we are somewhere else." Teresa said.
"Alright, Tess, let's do that. Anyway, what were you showing me earlier?" he asked, glad that he was able to understand her insecurities early on.
"Oh, these rings, do you like them?" Tess finally remembered. She picked the rings up from the floor and showed them to him.
"Wow, they are as pretty as my Tess. I love them." Vritra said as he picked one of the rings, then took her hand and gently put the ring on her finger.
"Here, help me with it now." Vritra said, putting his palm over hers.
Although her senses allowed her to see the world somewhat, Vritra wanted her to be able to see everything. He really needed to find a solution soon.
The two wore the silver coloured rings. Putting their hands together, they looked really good.
They talked for a bit longer, feeling closer than before.
"Are you ready?" Vritra asked, as Teresa put on a veil and wore clothes that completely hid her from top to bottom.
She looked cute wearing loose clothes like that.
"Yes!" Tess said excitedly, ready to step into her new life.
Taking her hand, the two walked out of the room. She was wearing gloves on only one hand, while with the other she held his hand.
Gunter and the others were already waiting outside, talking with Shen and the others.
"You are here." Ava looked at her son and daughter in law, but since Tess was completely hidden, she couldn't really see her.
"Yes, let's go." Vritra nodded, walking out of the Ford palace. Various vehicles were lined up for them.
The Fords were sending them back with a lot of gifts. One vehicle was especially luxurious and decorated, in which the Yates planned to bring Vritra and his bride back.
Sakshi was there too, her neck bandaged, and she couldn't open her mouth for a while.
But the Fords were surprised to see Teresa walk out in the open. Sir Giant stepped forward and spoke: "Teresa, what are you doing here? It is too dangerous, return to your room now!"
"Of course she would be out here, after all she is going with me." Vritra said. He had created several layers of barrier so no one could even get close to her.
Even his other wives wouldn't end up touching her accidentally.
"What? There is no way, that is just too dangerous. She has to stay in the Ford realm. If you want, you can stay here with her.
But for her safety, we can't allow her to leave. Do you know how dangerous it is for her just to walk out like this? If she accidentally even touched an insect, her life might be in danger."
Sir Giant pressed on, adamant about keeping Teresa locked in her room.
"Don't worry, even the air she breathes will have to go through a security check. She will be much safer with me than in this realm." Vritra replied.
"Art, you should understand, this is about her safety. Can't you just live here?" Shen said, standing behind Sir Giant.
"No, let's just ask whether she wants to stay here or go with me." Vritra said as everyone turned to look at Teresa.
"Sure, let's do tha..." Sir Giant started confidently, but then he paused. Who knows what sorcery this boy had done, Teresa was so obedient to him.
"I will g-" Teresa was about to answer, but Sir Giant interrupted.

"No matter what, it is about her safety. We can't take any risks. I am sure we can find a solution if we just talk it out calmly, like maybe you can stay here or come meet her every now and then?" He suggested.
Rich stood silently, he didn't have any opinion. Sakshi also stood silently since she couldn't speak.
Otherwise, she too would have wanted Teresa to stay. Why would she want such a genius slave to leave?
Gunter stepped forward and spoke: "Sir Giant, we understand your concerns, but we will do our utmost to protect her. You don't have to worry. She is now like a daughter to me."

"No, no, no. You know nothing about it, and you won't be able to protect her from outside threats, especially since her identity is known now. So just-" Sir Giant was speaking when suddenly black smoke rose not too far away.
It attracted their attention as they all quieted down and looked.
Soon, a person stepped out of the smoke, wearing a black outfit and a golden mask.
"I am one of the seats of the Golden Moon, Smog. I am here to bring Teresa Ford to our organization." The man announced, as his gaze focused on Teresa.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 Submissive
paragraphs: "Are you Teresa Ford?" Smog looked at the woman completely covered by clothes and questioned.
"Sigh, she isn't going to go with you." Sir Giant spoke, he might have retired but he knew Golden Moon pretty well and wouldn't want his granddaughter to go there.
"It is direct orders from the Oracle, I have no say in it." Smog said, seeing how several of them stepped in front of that woman, he was certain she was Teresa.
"Bring him here if you want, but my granddaughter is not going anywhere." Sir Giant said firmly.
'I can't defeat Sir Giant with my strength, not to mention there are so many lords here. It seems I have to choose some other tactic.'
After thinking for a moment, he decided to target Teresa directly.

"Teresa Ford, come willingly with me or your entire family will be in trouble. With your status and abilities, it is unfortunate but you can't enjoy a normal life. So for your family, come and just have a talk with the Oracle." Smog said.
"Oh, are you threatening us now? That brat Oracle sure has grown. Go back, I will be there soon to pay him a visit." Sir Giant spoke, his voice full of anger.
They knew how kind Teresa was, she always helped others and never wanted to hurt anyone.
Going there would either mean a life worse than death, slaving away or just death, by stealing others' misfortunes.
"You are misunder-" Smog couldn't go back just like that, but suddenly he was interrupted.
"You want to bring Teresa away? Alright, go ahead, but how are you going to bring her there?" Vritra asked, shocking everyone present around.
"What are you-" Shen questioned in a loud voice.
"You know, we don't stand a chance against the Golden Moon or the Divine Kage. If we don't surrender, both of our families will be destroyed."
Vritra answered, then turning his gaze to one of the seats.

"Oh, uhm, good choice. You must be her husband. I heard you are pretty strong and it seems you are smart too. As for going back, she can just follow me by flying." Smog replied, nodding in satisfaction.
Finally, there seemed to be a way to succeed.
"No no, that won't work. You know how weak Tess is, and you expect her to fly so far? Not to mention the danger if she accidentally touched anyone."
Vritra shook his head, as if her safety was his biggest concern.
"Oh, then what do you suggest?" Smog questioned, he hadn't really thought much about this. He wasn't even sure if he could succeed.
Shen, Sir Giant, Gunter and many tried to speak, but Vritra just shushed them, not allowing them to speak.
"Don't worry, I have to take proper care of my wife, so I have already thought of a way." Vritra said as he created a long and heavy chain from dust and turned it into metal.
But to others, it seemed as if he had taken it out of his inventory.
Then he walked away and tied one end of the chain around Teresa's feet under her baffled gaze and then brought the other side to Smog.
"Just use this, fly as fast as you can. With your support, she will be able to manage." Vritra said, as Smog took the chain.
He had a feeling that something was wrong, but he just couldn't put his finger on it.
Nearby, Vanessa and the others were also present, they could barely hold back their laughter as they watched the scene.
"What do you think you are doing? Weren't you just boasting about protecting her? And at the first sign of danger you are just going to-"
Sir Giant was about to snatch the chain away but Vritra just pushed him back.
"Old guy, don't buzz too much. You don't have much battery left in you anyway. It wouldn't feel good if you died the next day of our wedding, right?" Vritra spoke, then looked at Smog.
"What are you waiting for now? Go ahead or they will try to stop you. Go as fast as possible, don't stop until you are at your headquarters."
As soon as Smog heard that, he was filled with joy. He had so easily completed such an important mission.
Entering the Ford realm and then taking their daughter away was a life threatening mission, but he succeeded.
So Smog turned and, with all his might, flew up. Within moments, he was out of the Ford realm.
"Aaaaaaaaah! S- Saveeeee meeeee!"
The illusion broke, Teresa was still standing at her original position.
The chain pulled the other person along, almost ripping their leg apart as Sakshi got dragged away, her face hitting the ground.
She tried to stop herself but only ended up hurting her fingers and nails, she was nowhere near as strong as Smog.
Under everyone's baffled gazes, Sakshi disappeared from the Ford realm, skidding all over the ground and smashing into all sorts of things.
"Now that this is taken care of, we will be leaving." Vritra spoke as he walked back to his original place and took Teresa's hand.
She too was just as surprised as the others. Teresa wasn't under the illusion earlier and she clearly saw what her husband was doing.
Unlike what others were thinking, he protected her again.
"T- That!" Shen hurriedly flew away, he still needed to save that woman.
But her screams continued to ring out even as she travelled far, her throat was already injured, so it sounded very hoarse.
Gunter, Ava, Fiona, Diana and the others sat inside the vehicles. Vritra's women had decided to go together with them.
Vritra and Teresa were still outside, they would be going back in a different vehicle.
After getting over his shock, Sir Giant turned and spoke, "You saw that right? Now that her identity is exposed, more and more people will be coming for her. So she will have to stay here."
"Haa, enough. Do you think she is some tool you should keep here and make her keep working for you? If you stop me once more, I will make you regret it." Vritra said, his face emotionless.
"Let's go." Tess tugged at his sleeve, she didn't want to see them fight.
Vritra first helped Teresa sit inside carefully, then sat beside her.
But Sir Giant, partly because he was worried about her and also since without her the Ford family's strength would reduce a lot, couldn't allow Teresa to leave.
"No matter what, she is not going to leave this realm-" Shaking his head, he spoke.
But his words were cut off as Vritra suddenly flashed before Sir Giant, then a light punch headed towards his chest.
It seemed so slow, yet came close to his chest in an instant.
Sir Giant had no time to dodge, the most he could do was increase his defence.
Instantly, his body got covered by greyish skin, his size increasing slightly.
BOOOOOOM!!
The moment the light punch landed on Sir Giant's body, his strong defences collapsed.
A big hole appeared in his torso, even blasting away a big part of the palace behind them while throwing his body dozens of kilometres away.
Vritra had only used a little force, the difference between a demi god and a lord was way too big.

"Oh, are you threatening us now?
That brat Oracle sure has grown.
Go back, I will be there soon to pay him a visit." Sir Giant spoke, his voice full of anger.
They knew how kind Teresa was, she always helped others and never wanted to hurt anyone.
Going there would either mean a life worse than death, slaving away or just death, by stealing others' misfortunes.
"You are misunder-" Smog couldn't go back just like that, but suddenly he was interrupted.
"You want to bring Teresa away?
Alright, go ahead, but how are you going to bring her there?" Vritra asked, shocking everyone present around.
"What are you-" Shen questioned in a loud voice.
"You know, we don't stand a chance against the Golden Moon or the Divine Kage.
If we don't surrender, both of our families will be destroyed."
Vritra answered, then turning his gaze to one of the seats.
"Oh, uhm, good choice.
You must be her husband.
I heard you are pretty strong and it seems you are smart too.
As for going back, she can just follow me by flying." Smog replied, nodding in satisfaction.
Finally, there seemed to be a way to succeed.
"No no, that won't work.
You know how weak Tess is, and you expect her to fly so far?
Not to mention the danger if she accidentally touched anyone."
Vritra shook his head, as if her safety was his biggest concern.
"Oh, then what do you suggest?" Smog questioned, he hadn't really thought much about this.
He wasn't even sure if he could succeed.
Shen, Sir Giant, Gunter and many tried to speak, but Vritra just shushed them, not allowing them to speak.
"Don't worry, I have to take proper care of my wife, so I have already thought of a way." Vritra said as he created a long and heavy chain from dust and turned it into metal.
But to others, it seemed as if he had taken it out of his inventory.
Then he walked away and tied one end of the chain around Teresa's feet under her baffled gaze and then brought the other side to Smog.
"Just use this, fly as fast as you can.
With your support, she will be able to manage." Vritra said, as Smog took the chain.
He had a feeling that something was wrong, but he just couldn't put his finger on it.
Nearby, Vanessa and the others were also present, they could barely hold back their laughter as they watched the scene.
"What do you think you are doing?
Weren't you just boasting about protecting her?
And at the first sign of danger you are just going to-"
Sir Giant was about to snatch the chain away but Vritra just pushed him back.
"Old guy, don't buzz too much.
You don't have much battery left in you anyway.
It wouldn't feel good if you died the next day of our wedding, right?" Vritra spoke, then looked at Smog.
"What are you waiting for now?
Go ahead or they will try to stop you.
Go as fast as possible, don't stop until you are at your headquarters."
As soon as Smog heard that, he was filled with joy.
He had so easily completed such an important mission.
Entering the Ford realm and then taking their daughter away was a life threatening mission, but he succeeded.
So Smog turned and, with all his might, flew up.
Within moments, he was out of the Ford realm.
"Aaaaaaaaah!
S- Saveeeee meeeee!"
The illusion broke, Teresa was still standing at her original position.
The chain pulled the other person along, almost ripping their leg apart as Sakshi got dragged away, her face hitting the ground.
She tried to stop herself but only ended up hurting her fingers and nails, she was nowhere near as strong as Smog.
Under everyone's baffled gazes, Sakshi disappeared from the Ford realm, skidding all over the ground and smashing into all sorts of things.
"Now that this is taken care of, we will be leaving." Vritra spoke as he walked back to his original place and took Teresa's hand.
She too was just as surprised as the others.
Teresa wasn't under the illusion earlier and she clearly saw what her husband was doing.
Unlike what others were thinking, he protected her again.
"T- That!" Shen hurriedly flew away, he still needed to save that woman.
But her screams continued to ring out even as she travelled far, her throat was already injured, so it sounded very hoarse.
Gunter, Ava, Fiona, Diana and the others sat inside the vehicles.
Vritra's women had decided to go together with them.
Vritra and Teresa were still outside, they would be going back in a different vehicle.
After getting over his shock, Sir Giant turned and spoke, "You saw that right?
Now that her identity is exposed, more and more people will be coming for her.
So she will have to stay here."
"Haa, enough.
Do you think she is some tool you should keep here and make her keep working for you?
If you stop me once more, I will make you regret it." Vritra said, his face emotionless.
"Let's go." Tess tugged at his sleeve, she didn't want to see them fight.
Vritra first helped Teresa sit inside carefully, then sat beside her.
But Sir Giant, partly because he was worried about her and also since without her the Ford family's strength would reduce a lot, couldn't allow Teresa to leave.
"No matter what, she is not going to leave this realm-" Shaking his head, he spoke.
But his words were cut off as Vritra suddenly flashed before Sir Giant, then a light punch headed towards his chest.
It seemed so slow, yet came close to his chest in an instant.
Sir Giant had no time to dodge, the most he could do was increase his defence.
Instantly, his body got covered by greyish skin, his size increasing slightly.
BOOOOOOM!!
The moment the light punch landed on Sir Giant's body, his strong defences collapsed.
A big hole appeared in his torso, even blasting away a big part of the palace behind them while throwing his body dozens of kilometres away.
Vritra had only used a little force, the difference between a demi god and a lord was way too big.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 Humbled
paragraphs: Teresa was sitting peacefully in the car, imagining her new life with her husband, unaware of the fight outside.
Vritra again teleported in front of the broken old man, who was coughing and had such a bad injury, but it wasn't life threatening.
Leaning forward, he held Sir Giant by his head and pulled him out of the rubble.
"Since you are so confident about being able to protect her, then let's see if you truly can."
Then he activated an innate ability of his new race.
[Devouring the Giant's Physique!]
Instantly, the place was filled with Sir Giant's painful groans as his body began to deteriorate, and energy started flowing into Vritra's body.
It wasn't mana, but the very energy that made up his body. His physique was getting stolen.
"S- Stop, cough..." Sir Giant couldn't even speak properly as he coughed out blood, feeling weaker and weaker.
Vritra wondered if he should take out his core too, but that would certainly kill this old man.
So for now, he decided to let the core be.
Using Null, he created a sphere around them where the speed was far faster than the outside.
Sir Giant soon started to look more shriveled, he was still a lord but a whole lot weaker now.
It was that physique of his that made him so strong, but now it was gone.
[You have successfully stolen the Giant's Physique!]
[Your Physique grows stronger.]
Vritra finally let go of Sir Giant, as the old man weakly fell back into the rubble.
Sensing the changes, Vritra could feel that this was even better than Dago's physique. The feeling of growing even slightly was quite good.
"Oh Grandpa, what happened to you? Who did this to you?"
A worried expression appeared on Vritra's face as he knelt down and pulled out one of the best healing potions, created by Diana.
He poured it all into the dazed old man's mouth, as his injuries started healing instantly.
His complexion got better within a minute, after all he was still a lord.
"Are you okay? At your age, you should be resting. What are you doing going around and picking fights with young people?"
Vritra helped Sir Giant up, the old guy completely terrified of him.
'W- What sort of monster is he?! D- Did we make a mistake by marrying Teresa to him? He is a complete psycho...'
Seeing Vritra help him, Sir Giant felt a shiver run down his spine.
Within moments, Sir Giant's injuries were gone. Although he still looked a bit weak and more aged, he was fine now.
It was only his strength that had decreased greatly.
"Hurry up and get changed. You can't send off your dear granddaughter like that, right? And make sure to behave properly, or the Fords might become extinct."
Vritra said, patting his shoulder.
Then he walked back toward the vehicle, leaving Sir Giant shivering.
"...Did Grandpa agree?" Teresa asked as Vritra sat inside the vehicle.
"Why wouldn't he? I just showed a bit of my super strength and he allowed it. Who could protect you better than me?"
Vritra said, looking into her pitch black eyes.
After a minute, Sir Giant reappeared, this time in a different set of clothes.
All the people present there had been frozen when the fight between Vritra and Sir Giant took place.
So they were all unaware of the short battle, and in a span of moments, the strongest man of the Ford family was beaten up.
'Just who is he? His strength is terrifying. Is he someone from the Divine Kage or some powerful hidden organization?'
Sir Giant's hands were shivering as he stopped in front of the decorated vehicle.
"Teresa, take care of yourself. I- I will come to meet you soon. J- Just promise me that you will protect her."
Sir Giant spoke as his gaze shifted from Teresa to Vritra.
"Of course I will. Goodbye, enjoy your rest."
Vritra said, and within moments the vehicles started moving.
"Great Grandpa, what's wrong?" Rich looked at Sir Giant and asked. The old guy suddenly looked more aged.
"...It is nothing, I am just sad about her departure."
Sir Giant said, then looked at the building behind him, which was still broken.
Vritra had actually destroyed Teresa's room, showing she would never be coming back there.
Smog flew at full speed, Shen couldn't catch up to him no matter how fast he went.
The overconfident seat only increased his speed upon seeing Shen, thinking he was trying to stop his mission.
"Wait, wait, that's not Teresa!!" Shen shouted, seeing his wife hitting things left and right.
Sakshi continued to scream, and before long they arrived near the headquarters of the Golden Moon.
"Oracle, I have brought Teresa Ford along with me, the Stealer of Fate. But her brother won't stop following me."
Smog shouted, running into a building, Sakshi getting dragged along.
But now she was foaming at the mouth, her body twitching. She was completely covered in wounds.
"Oh, good job-"
Oracle, who was busy looking into the future, walked out of the hall.
But he paused upon seeing the woman behind Smog. First, he slapped Smog hard.
"You idiot! I told you to bring her here respectfully. What the hell have you done? Why did you drag her here?"
Oracle shouted in rage.
Rubbing his cheek, Smog looked back in shock. Wasn't she a lord?
How could she not even fly?
"Wait, are you Teresa Ford?" Oracle walked closer and questioned. He couldn't feel anything special from this ugly woman.
She wasn't even at the Ford realm.
"Of course she is not. She is Sakshi Ford, my wife. I was trying to stop him but he wouldn't listen to me."
Shen finally arrived, his heart chilling upon seeing her condition.
SLAP
Oracle slapped Smog again. These stupid people could never do one thing right.
"We are sorry for the confusion. I will properly punish him. Please take your wife back."
Oracle said respectfully, this was Sir Giant's family after all.
"Sigh. You people... Sakshi, are you alright?"
Shen clicked his tongue and pulled the chain off her feet.
"...h- hate him, k- kill him, ughh cough, s- save me..."
She kept muttering like a broken radio. Sighing, Shen glared at the two men and then took her away.
Inside the car, Vritra and Teresa sat close, hand in hand, as they enjoyed the scenery around them.
"Hubby, I am finally done with work here. Sigh, I missed such a good show."
Yasmine's voice sounded in his ear.
'Yeah, but there will be more to come for the Ford family. Anyway, we are now returning to the Yate realm, let's meet there directly.'
Vritra replied, his head resting on Teresa's shoulder.
"Alright, I am missing you already. Plus I need you to fill me again. Don't forget your first wife. Sob, poor me has to fight for your affection against so many women."
Yasmine said dramatically.
'Yes, yes, my queen. We will do as you say.'
Vritra said, shaking his head.
"Husband..." Teresa called out softly, she was feeling a little homesick already.
Vritra gave a light, gentle squeeze to her hand, before bringing it to his lips and kissing the back of her hand.
"Hmm."
He hummed. He liked her even more when she took his side against her family.
Now that she was all his, he was going to spoil her rotten with his love.
